text_en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ , the Son of God .
text_la: Initium Evangelii Jesu Christi, Filii Dei.
text_pt: Princípio do Evangelho de Jesus Cristo, Filho de Deus;
text_el: Ἀρχὴ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

text_en: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet : Behold I send my angel before your face, who shall prepare the way before you.
text_la: Sicut scriptum est in Isaia propheta : Ecce ego mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam, qui præparabit viam tuam ante te.
text_pt: Como está escrito nos profetas: Eis que eu envio o meu anjo ante a tua face, o qual preparará o teu caminho diante de ti.
text_el: καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ Ἠσαΐᾳ τῷ προφήτῃ: ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου, ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου:

text_en: A voice of one crying in the desert : Prepare the way of the Lord ; make straight his paths.
text_la: Vox clamantis in deserto : Parate viam Domini, rectas facite semitas ejus.
text_pt: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor, Endireitai as suas veredas.
text_el: φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ: ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.

text_en: John was in the desert , baptizing and preaching the baptism of penance , unto remission of sins .
text_la: Fuit Joannes in deserto baptizans, et prædicans baptismum pœnitentiæ in remissionem peccatorum.
text_pt: Apareceu João batizando no deserto, e pregando o batismo de arrependimento, para remissão dos pecados.
text_el: ἐγένετο Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτίζων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν.

text_en: And there went out to him all the country of Judea and all they of Jerusalem and were baptized by him in the river of Jordan , confessing their sins .
text_la: Et egrediebatur ad eum omnis Judææ regio, et Jerosolymitæ universi, et baptizabantur ab illo in Jordanis flumine, confitentes peccata sua.
text_pt: E toda a província da Judéia e os de Jerusalém iam ter com ele; e todos eram batizados por ele no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία χώρα καὶ οἱ Ἱεροσολυμῖται πάντες, καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ὑπ' αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

text_en: And John was clothed with camel's hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins; and he ate locusts and wild honey.
text_la: Et erat Joannes vestitus pilis cameli, et zona pellicea circa lumbos ejus, et locustas et mel silvestre edebat.
text_pt: E João andava vestido de pêlos de camelo, e com um cinto de couro em redor de seus lombos, e comia gafanhotos e mel silvestre.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ Ἰωάννης ἐνδεδυμένος τρίχας καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐσθίων ἀκρίδας καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.

text_en: And he preached, saying: There comes after me one mightier than I , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and loose.
text_la: Et prædicabat dicens : Venit fortior post me, cujus non sum dignus procumbens solvere corrigiam calceamentorum ejus.
text_pt: E pregava, dizendo: Após mim vem aquele que é mais forte do que eu, do qual não sou digno de, abaixando-me, desatar a correia das suas alparcas.
text_el: καὶ ἐκήρυσσεν λέγων: ἔρχεται ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου ὀπίσω [μου], οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς κύψας λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ:

text_en: I have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Ego baptizavi vos aqua, ille vero baptizabit vos Spiritu Sancto.
text_pt: Eu, em verdade, tenho-vos batizado com água; ele, porém, vos batizará com o Espírito Santo.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐβάπτισα ὑμᾶς ὕδατι, αὐτὸς δὲ βαπτίσει ὑμᾶς πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.

text_en: And it came to pass, in those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan .
text_la: Et factum est : in diebus illis venit Jesus a Nazareth Galilææ : et baptizatus est a Joanne in Jordane.
text_pt: E aconteceu naqueles dias que Jesus, tendo ido de Nazaré da Galiléia, foi batizado por João, no Jordão.
text_el: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲτ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη εἰς τὸν Ἰορδάνην ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου.

text_en: And forthwith coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens open and the Spirit as a dove descending and remaining on him.
text_la: Et statim ascendens de aqua, vidit cælos apertos, et Spiritum tamquam columbam descendentem, et manentem in ipso.
text_pt: E, logo que saiu da água, viu os céus abertos, e o Espírito, que como pomba descia sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀναβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος εἶδεν σχιζομένους τοὺς οὐρανοὺς καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα ὡς περιστερὰν καταβαῖνον εἰς αὐτόν.

text_en: And there came a voice from heaven : You are my beloved Son ; in you I am well pleased.
text_la: Et vox facta est de cælis : Tu es Filius meus dilectus, in te complacui.
text_pt: E ouviu-se uma voz dos céus, que dizia: Tu és o meu Filho amado em quem me comprazo.
text_el: καὶ φωνὴ [ἐγένετο] ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν: σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα.

text_en: And immediately the Spirit drove him out into the desert .
text_la: Et statim Spiritus expulit eum in desertum.
text_pt: E logo o Espírito o impeliu para o deserto.
text_el: Καὶ εὐθὺς τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτὸν ἐκβάλλει εἰς τὴν ἔρημον.

text_en: And he was in the desert forty days and forty nights, and was tempted by Satan . And he was with beasts: and the angels ministered to him.
text_la: Et erat in deserto quadraginta diebus, et quadraginta noctibus : et tentabatur a Satana : eratque cum bestiis, et angeli ministrabant illi.
text_pt: E ali esteve no deserto quarenta dias, tentado por Satanás. E vivia entre as feras, e os anjos o serviam.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ, καὶ ἦν μετὰ τῶν θηρίων, καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι διηκόνουν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And after that John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee , preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God ,
text_la: Postquam autem traditus est Joannes, venit Jesus in Galilæam, prædicans Evangelium regni Dei,
text_pt: E, depois que João foi entregue à prisão, veio Jesus para a Galiléia, pregando o evangelho do reino de Deus,
text_el: Καὶ Μετὰ τὸ παραδοθῆναι τὸν Ἰωάννην ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: and saying: The time is accomplished and the kingdom of God is at hand. Repent and believe the gospel .
text_la: et dicens : Quoniam impletum est tempus, et appropinquavit regnum Dei : pœnitemini, et credite Evangelio.
text_pt: E dizendo: O tempo está cumprido, e o reino de Deus está próximo. Arrependei-vos, e crede no evangelho.
text_el: [καὶ λέγων] ὅτι πεπλήρωται ὁ καιρὸς καὶ ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ: μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ.

text_en: And passing by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother, casting nets into the sea for they were fishermen.
text_la: Et præteriens secus mare Galilææ, vidit Simonem, et Andream fratrem ejus, mittentes retia in mare (erant enim piscatores),
text_pt: E, andando junto do mar da Galiléia, viu Simão, e André, seu irmão, que lançavam a rede ao mar, pois eram pescadores.
text_el: Καὶ παράγων παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν Σίμωνα καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν Σίμωνος ἀμφιβάλλοντας ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ: ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλιεῖς.

text_en: And Jesus said to them: Come after me; and I will make you to become fishers of men .
text_la: et dixit eis Jesus : Venite post me, et faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum.
text_pt: E Jesus lhes disse: Vinde após mim, e eu farei que sejais pescadores de homens.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου, καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς γενέσθαι ἁλιεῖς ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: And immediately leaving their nets, they followed him.
text_la: Et protinus relictis retibus, secuti sunt eum.
text_pt: E, deixando logo as suas redes, o seguiram.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And going on from thence a little farther, he saw James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, who also were mending their nets in the ship:
text_la: Et progressus inde pusillum, vidit Jacobum Zebedæi, et Joannem fratrem ejus, et ipsos componentes retia in navi:
text_pt: E, passando dali um pouco mais adiante, viu Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e João, seu irmão, que estavam no barco consertando as redes,
text_el: καὶ προβὰς ὀλίγον εἶδεν Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα,

text_en: And forthwith he called them. And leaving their father Zebedee in the ship with his hired men , they followed him.
text_la: et statim vocavit illos. Et relicto patre suo Zebedæo in navi cum mercenariis, secuti sunt eum.
text_pt: E logo os chamou. E eles, deixando o seu pai Zebedeu no barco com os jornaleiros, foram após ele.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς: καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν Ζεβεδαῖον ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ τῶν μισθωτῶν ἀπῆλθον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And they entered into Capharnaum : and forthwith upon the sabbath days going into the synagogue , he taught them.
text_la: Et ingrediuntur Capharnaum : et statim sabbatis ingressus in synagogam, docebat eos.
text_pt: Entraram em Cafarnaum e, logo no sábado, indo ele à sinagoga, ali ensinava.
text_el: Καὶ εἰσπορεύονται εἰς Καφαρναούμ: καὶ εὐθὺς τοῖς σάββασιν εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν. ἐδίδασκεν

text_en: And they were astonished at his doctrine. For he was teaching them as one having power, and not as the scribes .
text_la: Et stupebant super doctrina ejus : erat enim docens eos quasi potestatem habens, et non sicut scribæ.
text_pt: E maravilharam-se da sua doutrina, porque os ensinava como tendo autoridade, e não como os escribas.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ: ἦν γὰρ διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐξουσίαν ἔχων, καὶ οὐχ ὡς οἱ γραμματεῖς.

text_en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit ; and he cried out,
text_la: Et erat in synagoga eorum homo in spiritu immundo : et exclamavit,
text_pt: E estava na sinagoga deles um homem com um espírito imundo, o qual exclamou,
text_el: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἦν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν ἄνθρωπος ἐν πνεύματι ἀκαθάρτῳ, καὶ ἀνέκραξεν

text_en: saying: What have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth ? Are you come to destroy us? I know who you are, the Holy One of God .
text_la: dicens : Quid nobis et tibi, Jesu Nazarene? venisti perdere nos? scio qui sis, Sanctus Dei.
text_pt: Dizendo: Ah! que temos contigo, Jesus Nazareno? Vieste destruir-nos? Bem sei quem és: o Santo de Deus.
text_el: λέγων: τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί, Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ; ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς: οἶδά σε τίς εἶ, ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And Jesus threatened him, saying: Speak no more, and go out of the man .
text_la: Et comminatus est ei Jesus, dicens : Obmutesce, et exi de homine.
text_pt: E repreendeu-o Jesus, dizendo: Cala-te, e sai dele.
text_el: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: [λέγων] φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the unclean spirit , tearing him and crying out with a loud voice, went out of him.
text_la: Et discerpens eum spiritus immundus, et exclamans voce magna, exiit ab eo.
text_pt: Então o espírito imundo, convulsionando-o, e clamando com grande voz, saiu dele.
text_el: καὶ σπαράξαν αὐτὸν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον καὶ φωνῆσαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And they were all amazed insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying: What thing is this? What is this new doctrine? For with power he commands even the unclean spirits : and they obey him.
text_la: Et mirati sunt omnes, ita ut conquirerent inter se dicentes : Quidnam est hoc? quænam doctrina hæc nova? quia in potestate etiam spiritibus immundis imperat, et obediunt ei.
text_pt: E todos se admiraram, a ponto de perguntarem entre si, dizendo: Que é isto? Que nova doutrina é esta? Pois com autoridade ordena aos espíritos imundos, e eles lhe obedecem!
text_el: καὶ ἐθαμβήθησαν ἅπαντες, ὥστε συζητεῖν αὐτοὺς λέγοντας: τί ἐστιν τοῦτο; διδαχὴ καινὴ κατ' ἐξουσίαν: καὶ τοῖς πνεύμασι τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις ἐπιτάσσει, καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And the fame of him was spread forthwith into all the country of Galilee .
text_la: Et processit rumor ejus statim in omnem regionem Galilææ.
text_pt: E logo correu a sua fama por toda a província da Galiléia.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εὐθὺς πανταχοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν περίχωρον τῆς Γαλιλαίας.

text_en: And immediately going out of the synagogue they came into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .
text_la: Et protinus egredientes de synagoga, venerunt in domum Simonis et Andreæ, cum Jacobo et Joanne.
text_pt: E logo, saindo da sinagoga, foram à casa de Simão e de André com Tiago e João.
text_el: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐξελθόντες ἦλθον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος καὶ Ἀνδρέου μετὰ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου.

text_en: And Simon's wife's mother lay in a fit of a fever: and forthwith they tell him of her.
text_la: Decumbebat autem socrus Simonis febricitans : et statim dicunt ei de illa.
text_pt: E a sogra de Simão estava deitada com febre; e logo lhe falaram dela.
text_el: ἡ δὲ πενθερὰ Σίμωνος κατέκειτο πυρέσσουσα, καὶ εὐθὺς λέγουσιν αὐτῷ περὶ αὐτῆς.

text_en: And coming to her, he lifted her up, taking her by the hand; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
text_la: Et accedens elevavit eam, apprehensa manu ejus : et continuo dimisit eam febris, et ministrabat eis.
text_pt: Então, chegando-se a ela, tomou-a pela mão, e levantou-a; e imediatamente a febre a deixou, e servia-os.
text_el: καὶ προσελθὼν ἤγειρεν αὐτὴν κρατήσας τῆς χειρός: καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός, καὶ διηκόνει αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And when it was evening, after sunset, they brought to him all that were ill and that were possessed with devils .
text_la: Vespere autem facto cum occidisset sol, afferebant ad eum omnes male habentes, et dæmonia habentes:
text_pt: E, tendo chegado a tarde, quando já se estava pondo o sol, trouxeram-lhe todos os que se achavam enfermos, e os endemoninhados.
text_el: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης, ὅτε ἔδυσεν ὁ ἥλιος, ἔφερον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας καὶ τοὺς δαιμονιζομένους:

text_en: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
text_la: et erat omnis civitas congregata ad januam.
text_pt: E toda a cidade se ajuntou à porta.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὅλη ἡ πόλις ἐπισυνηγμένη πρὸς τὴν θύραν.

text_en: And he healed many that were troubled with divers diseases. And he cast out many devils : and he suffered them not to speak, because they knew him.
text_la: Et curavit multos, qui vexabantur variis languoribus, et dæmonia multa ejiciebat, et non sinebat ea loqui, quoniam sciebant eum.
text_pt: E curou muitos que se achavam enfermos de diversas enfermidades, e expulsou muitos demônios, porém não deixava falar os demônios, porque o conheciam.
text_el: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις, καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλεν, καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν λαλεῖν τὰ δαιμόνια, ὅτι ᾔδεισαν αὐτόν [Χριστὸν εἶναι].

text_en: And rising very early, going out, he went into a desert place : and there he prayed .
text_la: Et diluculo valde surgens, egressus abiit in desertum locum, ibique orabat.
text_pt: E, levantando-se de manhã, muito cedo, fazendo ainda escuro, saiu, e foi para um lugar deserto, e ali orava.
text_el: Καὶ πρωῒ ἔννυχα λίαν ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν [καὶ ἀπῆλθεν] εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κἀκεῖ προσηύχετο.

text_en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
text_la: Et prosecutus est eum Simon, et qui cum illo erant.
text_pt: E seguiram-no Simão e os que com ele estavam.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξεν αὐτὸν Σίμων καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And when they had found him, they said to him: All seek for you.
text_la: Et cum invenissent eum, dixerunt ei : Quia omnes quærunt te.
text_pt: E, achando-o, lhe disseram: Todos te buscam.
text_el: καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν, καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ὅτι πάντες ζητοῦσίν σε.

text_en: And he says to them: Let us go into the neighbouring towns and cities, that I may preach there also; for to this purpose am I come.
text_la: Et ait illis : Eamus in proximos vicos, et civitates, ut et ibi prædicem : ad hoc enim veni.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Vamos às aldeias vizinhas, para que eu ali também pregue; porque para isso vim.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἄγωμεν ἀλλαχοῦ εἰς τὰς ἐχομένας κωμοπόλεις, ἵνα καὶ ἐκεῖ κηρύξω: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐξῆλθον.

text_en: And he was preaching in their synagogues and in all Galilee and casting out devils .
text_la: Et erat prædicans in synagogis eorum, et in omni Galilæa, et dæmonia ejiciens.
text_pt: E pregava nas sinagogas deles, por toda a Galiléia, e expulsava os demônios.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν εἰς ὅλην τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐκβάλλων.

text_en: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him and kneeling down, said to him: If you will you can make me clean .
text_la: Et venit ad eum leprosus deprecans eum : et genu flexo dixit ei : Si vis, potes me mundare.
text_pt: E aproximou-se dele um leproso que, rogando-lhe, e pondo-se de joelhos diante dele, lhe dizia: Se queres, bem podes limpar-me.
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λεπρὸς παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν [καὶ γονυπετῶν] λέγων αὐτῷ ὅτι ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι.

text_en: And Jesus , having compassion on him, stretched forth his hand and touching him said to him: I will. Be made clean .
text_la: Jesus autem misertus ejus, extendit manum suam : et tangens eum, ait illi : Volo : mundare.
text_pt: E Jesus, movido de grande compaixão, estendeu a mão, e tocou-o, e disse-lhe: Quero, sê limpo.
text_el: καὶ σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἥψατο καὶ λέγει: αὐτῷ θέλω, καθαρίσθητι.

text_en: And when he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him: and he was made clean .
text_la: Et cum dixisset, statim discessit ab eo lepra, et mundatus est.
text_pt: E, tendo ele dito isto, logo a lepra desapareceu, e ficou limpo.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα, καὶ ἐκαθαρίσθη.

text_en: And he strictly charged him and forthwith sent him away.
text_la: Et comminatus est ei, statimque ejecit illum,
text_pt: E, advertindo-o severamente, logo o despediu.
text_el: καὶ ἐμβριμησάμενος αὐτῷ εὐθὺς ἐξέβαλεν αὐτόν,

text_en: And he said to him: See that you tell no one; but go, show yourself to the high priest and offer for your cleansing the things that Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.
text_la: et dicit ei : Vide nemini dixeris : sed vade, ostende te principi sacerdotum, et offer pro emundatione tua, quæ præcepit Moyses in testimonium illis.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Olha, não digas nada a ninguém; porém vai, mostra-te ao sacerdote, e oferece pela tua purificação o que Moisés determinou, para lhes servir de testemunho.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: ὅρα μηδενὶ μηδὲν εἴπῃς, ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκε περὶ τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ σου ἃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς, εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.

text_en: But he being gone out, began to publish and to blaze abroad the word: so that he could not openly go into the city, but was without in desert places . And they flocked to him from all sides.
text_la: At ille egressus cœpit prædicare, et diffamare sermonem, ita ut jam non posset manifeste introire in civitatem, sed foris in desertis locis esset, et conveniebant ad eum undique.
text_pt: Mas, tendo ele saído, começou a apregoar muitas coisas, e a divulgar o que acontecera; de sorte que Jesus já não podia entrar publicamente na cidade, mas conservava-se fora em lugares desertos; e de todas as partes iam ter com ele.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐξελθὼν ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν πολλὰ καὶ διαφημίζειν τὸν λόγον, ὥστε μηκέτι αὐτὸν δύνασθαι φανερῶς εἰς πόλιν εἰσελθεῖν, ἀλλ' ἔξω ἐπ' ἐρήμοις τόποις [ἦν], καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντοθεν.

text_en: And again he entered into Capharnaum after some days.
text_la: Et iterum intravit Capharnaum post dies,
text_pt: E alguns dias depois entrou outra vez em Cafarnaum, e soube-se que estava em casa.
text_el: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν πάλιν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ δι' ἡμερῶν ἠκούσθη ὅτι ἐν οἴκῳ ἐστίν.

text_en: And it was heard that he was in the house. And many came together, so that there was no room: no, not even at the door. And he spoke to them the word.
text_la: et auditum est quod in domo esset, et convenerunt multi, ita ut non caperet neque ad januam, et loquebatur eis verbum.
text_pt: E logo se ajuntaram tantos, que nem ainda nos lugares junto à porta cabiam; e anunciava-lhes a palavra.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πολλοὶ, ὥστε μηκέτι χωρεῖν μηδὲ τὰ πρὸς τὴν θύραν, καὶ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον.

text_en: And they came to him, bringing one sick of the palsy, who was carried by four.
text_la: Et venerunt ad eum ferentes paralyticum, qui a quatuor portabatur.
text_pt: E vieram ter com ele conduzindo um paralítico, trazido por quatro.
text_el: καὶ ἔρχονται φέροντες πρὸς αὐτὸν παραλυτικὸν αἰρόμενον ὑπὸ τεσσάρων.

text_en: And when they could not offer him unto him for the multitude, they uncovered the roof where he was: and opening it, they let down the bed wherein the man sick of the palsy lay.
text_la: Et cum non possent offerre eum illi præ turba, nudaverunt tectum ubi erat : et patefacientes submiserunt grabatum in quo paralyticus jacebat.
text_pt: E, não podendo aproximar-se dele, por causa da multidão, descobriram o telhado onde estava, e, fazendo um buraco, baixaram o leito em que jazia o paralítico.
text_el: καὶ μὴ δυνάμενοι προσενέγκαι αὐτῷ διὰ τὸν ὄχλον ἀπεστέγασαν τὴν στέγην ὅπου ἦν, καὶ ἐξορύξαντες χαλῶσι τὸν κράβαττον ὅπου ὁ παραλυτικὸς κατέκειτο.

text_en: And when Jesus had seen their faith , he says to the sick of the palsy: Son, your sins are forgiven you.
text_la: Cum autem vidisset Jesus fidem illorum, ait paralytico : Fili, dimittuntur tibi peccata tua.
text_pt: E Jesus, vendo a fé deles, disse ao paralítico: Filho, perdoados estão os teus pecados.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὴν πίστιν αὐτῶν λέγει τῷ παραλυτικῷ: τέκνον, ἀφίενταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι.

text_en: And there were some of the scribes sitting there and thinking in their hearts:
text_la: Erant autem illic quidam de scribis sedentes, et cogitantes in cordibus suis:
text_pt: E estavam ali assentados alguns dos escribas, que arrazoavam em seus corações, dizendo:
text_el: ἦσαν δέ τινες τῶν γραμματέων ἐκεῖ καθήμενοι καὶ διαλογιζόμενοι ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν:

text_en: Why does this man speak thus? He blasphemes . Who can forgive sins , but God only?
text_la: Quid hic sic loquitur? blasphemat. Quis potest dimittere peccata, nisi solus Deus?
text_pt: Por que diz este assim blasfêmias? Quem pode perdoar pecados, senão Deus?
text_el: τί οὗτος οὕτως λαλεῖ; βλασφημεῖ: τίς δύναται ἀφιέναι ἁμαρτίας εἰ μὴ εἷς ὁ θεός;

text_en: Which Jesus presently knowing in his spirit that they so thought within themselves, says to them: Why think you these things in your hearts?
text_la: Quo statim cognito Jesus spiritu suo, quia sic cogitarent intra se, dicit illis : Quid ista cogitatis in cordibus vestris?
text_pt: E Jesus, conhecendo logo em seu espírito que assim arrazoavam entre si, lhes disse: Por que arrazoais sobre estas coisas em vossos corações?
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐπιγνοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ πνεύματι αὐτοῦ ὅτι [οὕτως] διαλογίζονται ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λέγει [αὐτοῖς]: τί ταῦτα διαλογίζεσθε ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν;

text_en: Which is easier, to say to the sick of the palsy: Your sins are forgiven you; or to say: Arise, take up your bed and walk?
text_la: Quid est facilius dicere paralytico : Dimittuntur tibi peccata : an dicere : Surge, tolle grabatum tuum, et ambula?
text_pt: Qual é mais fácil? dizer ao paralítico: Estão perdoados os teus pecados; ou dizer-lhe: Levanta-te, e toma o teu leito, e anda?
text_el: τί ἐστιν εὐκοπώτερον, εἰπεῖν τῷ παραλυτικῷ: ἀφίενταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι, ἢ εἰπεῖν: ἐγείρου [καὶ] ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει;

text_en: But that you may know that the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins (he says to the sick of the palsy):
text_la: Ut autem sciatis quia Filius hominis habet potestatem in terra dimittendi peccata (ait paralytico),
text_pt: Ora, para que saibais que o Filho do homem tem na terra poder para perdoar pecados (disse ao paralítico),
text_el: ἵνα δὲ εἰδῆτε ὅτι ἐξουσίαν ἔχει ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀφιέναι ἁμαρτίας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, λέγει τῷ παραλυτικῷ:

text_en: I say to you: Arise. Take up your bed and go into your house.
text_la: tibi dico : Surge, tolle grabatum tuum, et vade in domum tuam.
text_pt: A ti te digo: Levanta-te, toma o teu leito, e vai para tua casa.
text_el: σοὶ λέγω, ἔγειρε ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου.

text_en: And immediately he arose and, taking up his bed, went his way in the sight of all: so that all wondered and glorified God , saying: We never saw the like.
text_la: Et statim surrexit ille : et, sublato grabato, abiit coram omnibus, ita ut mirarentur omnes, et honorificent Deum, dicentes : Quia numquam sic vidimus.
text_pt: E levantou-se e, tomando logo o leito, saiu em presença de todos, de sorte que todos se admiraram e glorificaram a Deus, dizendo: Nunca tal vimos.
text_el: καὶ ἠγέρθη καὶ εὐθὺς ἄρας τὸν κράβαττον ἐξῆλθεν ἔμπροσθεν πάντων, ὥστε ἐξίστασθαι πάντας καὶ δοξάζειν τὸν θεὸν [λέγοντας] ὅτι οὕτως οὐδέποτε εἴδομεν.

text_en: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
text_pt: E tornou a sair para o mar, e toda a multidão ia ter com ele, e ele os ensinava.
text_el: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πάλιν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς.

text_en: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the {son} of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him. {at the...: or, at the place where the custom was received}
text_pt: E, passando, viu Levi, filho de Alfeu, sentado na alfândega, e disse-lhe: Segue-me. E, levantando-se, o seguiu.
text_el: καὶ παράγων εἶδεν Λευὶν τὸν τοῦ Ἁλφαίου καθήμενον ἐπὶ τὸ τελώνιον, καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: ἀκολούθει μοι. καὶ ἀναστὰς ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, estando sentado à mesa em casa deste, também estavam sentados à mesa com Jesus e seus discípulos muitos publicanos e pecadores; porque eram muitos, e o tinham seguido.
text_el: καὶ γίνεται κατακεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ πολλοὶ τελῶναι καὶ ἁμαρτωλοὶ συνανέκειντο τῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ: ἦσαν γὰρ πολλοὶ καὶ ἠκολούθουν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And he entered again into the synagogue : and there was a man there who had a withered hand.
text_la: Et introivit iterum in synagogam : et erat ibi homo habens manum aridam.
text_pt: E outra vez entrou na sinagoga, e estava ali um homem que tinha uma das mãos mirrada.
text_el: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πάλιν εἰς συναγωγήν, καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπος ἐξηραμμένην ἔχων τὴν χεῖρα:

text_en: And they watched him whether he would heal on the sabbath days , that they might accuse him.
text_la: Et observabant eum, si sabbatis curaret, ut accusarent illum.
text_pt: E estavam observando-o securaria no sábado, para o acusarem.
text_el: καὶ παρετήρουν αὐτὸν εἰ τοῖς σάββασιν θεραπεύσει αὐτόν, ἵνα κατηγορήσωσιν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he said to the man who had the withered hand: Stand up in the midst.
text_la: Et ait homini habenti manum aridam : Surge in medium.
text_pt: E disse ao homem que tinha a mão mirrada: Levanta-te e vem para o meio.
text_el: καὶ λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ τὴν χεῖρα ἔχοντι: ξηρὰν ἔγειρε εἰς τὸ μέσον.

text_en: And he says to them: Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days , or to do evil ? To save life , or to destroy? But they held their peace.
text_la: Et dicit eis : Licet sabbatis benefacere, an male? animam salvam facere, an perdere? At illi tacebant.
text_pt: E perguntou-lhes: É lícito no sábado fazer bem, ou fazer mal? salvar a vida, ou matar? E eles calaram-se.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν ἀγαθοποιῆσαι ἢ κακοποιῆσαι, ψυχὴν σῶσαι ἢ ἀποκτεῖναι; οἱ δὲ ἐσιώπων.

text_en: And looking round about on them with anger , being grieved for the blindness of their hearts, he says to the man : Stretch forth your hand. And he stretched it forth: and his hand was restored unto him.
text_la: Et circumspiciens eos cum ira, contristatus super cæcitate cordis eorum, dicit homini : Extende manum tuam. Et extendit, et restituta est manus illi.
text_pt: E, olhando para eles em redor com indignação, condoendo-se da dureza do seu coração, disse ao homem: Estende a tua mão. E ele a estendeu, e foi-lhe restituída a sua mão, sã como a outra.
text_el: καὶ περιβλεψάμενος αὐτοὺς μετ' ὀργῆς, συλλυπούμενος ἐπὶ τῇ πωρώσει τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν, λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ: ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρα. σου: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν, καὶ ἀπεκατεστάθη ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the Pharisees going out, immediately made a consultation with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
text_la: Exeuntes autem pharisæi, statim cum Herodianis consilium faciebant adversus eum quomodo eum perderent.
text_pt: E, tendo saído os fariseus, tomaram logo conselho com os herodianos contra ele, procurando ver como o matariam.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθόντες οἱ Φαρισαῖοι εὐθὺς μετὰ τῶν Ἡρῳδιανῶν συμβούλιον ἐδίδουν κατ' αὐτοῦ ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀπολέσωσιν.

text_en: But Jesus retired with his disciples to the sea ; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee and Judea ,
text_la: Jesus autem cum discipulis suis secessit ad mare : et multa turba a Galilæa et Judæa secuta est eum,
text_pt: E retirou-se Jesus com os seus discípulos para o mar, e seguia-o uma grande multidão da Galiléia e da Judéia,
text_el: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἀνεχώρησεν πρὸς τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ πολὺ πλῆθος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἠκολούθησεν καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας,

text_en: and from Jerusalem , and from Idumea and from beyond the Jordan . And they about Tyre and Sidon , a great multitude, hearing the things which he did, came to him.
text_la: et ab Jerosolymis, et ab Idumæa, et trans Jordanem : et qui circa Tyrum et Sidonem multitudo magna, audientes quæ faciebat, venerunt ad eum.
text_pt: E de Jerusalém, e da Iduméia, e de além do Jordão, e de perto de Tiro e de Sidom; uma grande multidão que, ouvindo quão grandes coisas fazia, vinha ter com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰδουμαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου καὶ περὶ Τύρον καὶ Σιδῶνα, πλῆθος πολύ, ἀκούοντες ὅσα ποιεῖ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτόν.

text_en: And he spoke to his disciples that a small ship should wait on him, because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
text_la: Et dicit discipulis suis ut navicula sibi deserviret propter turbam, ne comprimerent eum:
text_pt: E ele disse aos seus discípulos que lhe tivessem sempre pronto um barquinho junto dele, por causa da multidão, para que o não oprimisse,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ἵνα πλοιάριον προσκαρτερῇ αὐτῷ διὰ τὸν ὄχλον, ἵνα μὴ θλίβωσιν αὐτόν:

text_en: For he healed many, so that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had evils .
text_la: multos enim sanabat, ita ut irruerent in eum ut illum tangerent, quotquot habebant plagas.
text_pt: Porque tinha curado a muitos, de tal maneira que todos quantos tinham algum mal se arrojavam sobre ele, para lhe tocarem.
text_el: πολλοὺς γὰρ ἐθεράπευσεν, ὥστε ἐπιπίπτειν αὐτῷ, ἵνα αὐτοῦ ἅψωνται, ὅσοι εἶχον μάστιγας.

text_en: And the unclean spirits , when they saw him, fell down before him: and they cried, saying:
text_la: Et spiritus immundi, cum illum videbant, procidebant ei : et clamabant, dicentes:
text_pt: E os espíritos imundos vendo-o, prostravam-se diante dele, e clamavam, dizendo: Tu és o Filho de Deus.
text_el: καὶ τὰ πνεύματα τὰ ἀκάθαρτα, ὅταν αὐτὸν ἐθεώρουν, προσέπιπτον αὐτῷ καὶ ἔκραζον λέγοντα ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: You are the Son of God . And he strictly charged them that they should not make him known .
text_la: Tu es Filius Dei. Et vehementer comminabatur eis ne manifestarent illum.
text_pt: E ele os ameaçava muito, para que não o manifestassem.
text_el: καὶ πολλὰ ἐπετίμα αὐτοῖς ἵνα μὴ αὐτὸν φανερὸν ποιήσωσιν.

text_en: And going up into a mountain, he called unto him whom he would himself: and they came to him.
text_la: Et ascendens in montem vocavit ad se quos voluit ipse: et venerunt ad eum.
text_pt: E subiu ao monte, e chamou para si os que ele quis; e vieram a ele.
text_el: Καὶ ἀναβαίνει εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ προσκαλεῖται οὓς ἤθελεν αὐτός, καὶ ἀπῆλθον πρὸς αὐτόν.

text_en: And he made that twelve should be with him, and that he might send them to preach.
text_la: Et fecit ut essent duodecim cum illo : et ut mitteret eos prædicare.
text_pt: E nomeou doze para que estivessem com ele e os mandasse a pregar,
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν δώδεκα, οὓς καὶ ἀποστόλους ὠνόμασεν ἵνα ὦσιν μετ' αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἵνα ἀποστέλλῃ αὐτοὺς κηρύσσειν

text_en: And he gave them power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils .
text_la: Et dedit illis potestatem curandi infirmitates et ejiciendi dæmonia.
text_pt: E para que tivessem o poderde curar as enfermidades e expulsar os demônios:
text_el: καὶ ἔχειν ἐξουσίαν ἐκβάλλειν τὰ δαιμόνια:

text_en: And to Simon he gave the name Peter :
text_la: Et imposuit Simoni nomen Petrus:
text_pt: A Simão, a quem pôs o nome de Pedro,
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τοὺς δώδεκα, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ὄνομα τῷ Σίμωνι Πέτρον:

text_en: And James the son of Zebedee , and John the brother of James; and he named them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder .
text_la: et Jacobum Zebedæi, et Joannem fratrem Jacobi, et imposuit eis nomina Boanerges, quod est, Filii tonitrui:
text_pt: E a Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e a João, irmão de Tiago, aos quais pôs o nome de Boanerges, que significa: Filhos do trovão;
text_el: καὶ Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν τοῦ Ἰακώβου, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτοῖς ὄνομα Βοανηργές, ὅ ἐστιν υἱοὶ βροντῆς:

text_en: And Andrew and Philip , and Bartholomew and Matthew , and Thomas and James of Alpheus , and Thaddeus and Simon the Cananean :
text_la: et Andræam, et Philippum, et Bartholomæum, et Matthæum, et Thomam, et Jacobum Alphæi, et Thaddæum, et Simonem Cananæum,
text_pt: E a André, e a Filipe, e a Bartolomeu, e a Mateus, e a Tomé, e a Tiago, filho de Alfeu, e a Tadeu, e a Simão, o Cananita,
text_el: καὶ Ἀνδρέαν καὶ Φίλιππον καὶ Βαρθολομαῖον καὶ Μαθθαῖον καὶ Θωμᾶν καὶ Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ἁλφαίου καὶ Θαδδαῖον καὶ Σίμωνα τὸν Καναναῖον

text_en: And Judas Iscariot , who also betrayed him.
text_la: et Judam Iscariotem, qui et tradidit illum.
text_pt: E a Judas Iscariotes, o que o entregou.
text_el: καὶ Ἰούδαν Ἰσκαριώθ, ὃς καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτόν.

text_en: And they come to a house, and the multitude comes together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
text_la: Et veniunt ad domum : et convenit iterum turba, ita ut non possent neque panem manducare.
text_pt: E foram para uma casa. E afluiu outra vez a multidão, de tal maneira que nem sequer podiam comer pão.
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχεται εἰς οἶκον: καὶ συνέρχεται πάλιν ὁ ὄχλος, ὥστε μὴ δύνασθαι αὐτοὺς μηδὲ ἄρτον φαγεῖν.

text_en: And when his friends had heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him. For they said: He has become mad.
text_la: Et cum audissent sui, exierunt tenere eum : dicebant enim : Quoniam in furorem versus est.
text_pt: E, quando os seus ouviram isto, saíram para o prender; porque diziam: Está fora de si.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ παρ' αὐτοῦ ἐξῆλθον κρατῆσαι αὐτόν: ἔλεγον γὰρ ὅτι ἐξέστη.

text_en: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem , said: He has Beelzebub , and by the prince of devils he casts out devils .
text_la: Et scribæ, qui ab Jerosolymis descenderant, dicebant : Quoniam Beelzebub habet, et quia in principe dæmoniorum ejicit dæmonia.
text_pt: E os escribas, que tinham descido de Jerusalém, diziam: Tem Belzebu, e pelo príncipe dos demônios expulsa os demônios.
text_el: καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς οἱ ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων καταβάντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Βεελζεβοὺλ ἔχει, καὶ ὅτι ἐν τῷ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια.

text_en: And after he had called them together, he said to them in parables : How can Satan cast out Satan ?
text_la: Et convocatis eis in parabolis dicebat illis: Quomodo potest Satanas Satanam ejicere?
text_pt: E, chamando-os a si, disse-lhes por parábolas: Como pode Satanás expulsar Satanás?
text_el: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς ἐν παραβολαῖς ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: πῶς δύναται Σατανᾶς Σατανᾶν ἐκβάλλειν;

text_en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
text_la: Et si regnum in se dividatur, non potest regnum illud stare.
text_pt: E, se um reino se dividir contra si mesmo, tal reino não pode subsistir;
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν βασιλεία ἐφ' ἑαυτὴν μερισθῇ, οὐ δύναται σταθῆναι ἡ βασιλεία ἐκείνη.

text_en: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
text_la: Et si domus super semetipsam dispertiatur, non potest domus illa stare.
text_pt: E, se uma casa se dividir contra si mesma, tal casa não pode subsistir.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν οἰκία ἐφ' ἑαυτὴν μερισθῇ, οὐ δυνήσεται ἡ οἰκία ἐκείνη στῆναι.

text_en: And if Satan be risen up against himself, he is divided, and cannot stand, but has an end.
text_la: Et si Satanas consurrexerit in semetipsum, dispertitus est, et non poterit stare, sed finem habet.
text_pt: E, se Satanás se levantar contra si mesmo, e for dividido, não pode subsistir; antes tem fim.
text_el: καὶ εἰ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἀνέστη ἐφ' ἑαυτὸν καὶ, ἐμερίσθη οὐ δύναται στῆναι ἀλλὰ τέλος ἔχει.

text_en: No man can enter into the house of a strong man and rob him of his goods , unless he first bind the strong man , and then shall he plunder his house.
text_la: Nemo potest vasa fortis ingressus in domum diripere, nisi prius fortem alliget, et tunc domum ejus diripiet.
text_pt: Ninguém pode roubar os bens do valente, entrando-lhe em sua casa, se primeiro não maniatar o valente; e então roubará a sua casa.
text_el: ἀλλ' οὐ δύναται οὐδεὶς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἰσχυροῦ εἰσελθὼν τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ διαρπάσαι, ἐὰν μὴ πρῶτον τὸν ἰσχυρὸν δήσῃ, καὶ τότε τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ διαρπάσει.

text_en: Amen I say to you that all sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men , and the blasphemies wherewith they shall blaspheme :
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quoniam omnia dimittentur filiis hominum peccata, et blasphemiæ quibus blasphemaverint:
text_pt: Na verdade vos digo que todos os pecados serão perdoados aos filhos dos homens, e toda a sorte de blasfêmias, com que blasfemarem;
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πάντα ἀφεθήσεται τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων τὰ ἁμαρτήματα καὶ αἱ βλασφημίαι, ὅσα ἐὰν βλασφημήσωσιν:

text_en: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost , shall never have forgiveness , but shall be guilty of an everlasting sin .
text_la: qui autem blasphemaverit in Spiritum Sanctum, non habebit remissionem in æternum, sed reus erit æterni delicti.
text_pt: Qualquer, porém, que blasfemar contra o Espírito Santo, nunca obterá perdão, mas será réu do eterno juízo
text_el: ὃς δ' ἂν βλασφημήσῃ εἰς τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, οὐκ ἔχει ἄφεσιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ἀλλὰ ἔνοχός ἐστιν αἰωνίου ἁμαρτήματος

text_en: Because they said: He has an unclean spirit .
text_la: Quoniam dicebant : Spiritum immundum habet.
text_pt: (Porque diziam: Tem espírito imundo).
text_el: ὅτι ἔλεγον: πνεῦμα ἀκάθαρτον ἔχει.

text_en: And his mother and his brethren came; and standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
text_la: Et veniunt mater ejus et fratres: et foris stantes miserunt ad eum vocantes eum,
text_pt: Chegaram, então, seus irmãos e sua mãe; e, estando fora, mandaram-no chamar.
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχονται ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔξω στήκοντες ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτὸν καλοῦντες αὐτόν.

text_en: And the multitude sat about him; and they say to him: Behold your mother and your brethren without seek for you.
text_la: et sedebat circa eum turba : et dicunt ei : Ecce mater tua et fratres tui foris quærunt te.
text_pt: E a multidão estava assentada ao redor dele, e disseram-lhe: Eis que tua mãe e teus irmãos te procuram, e estão lá fora.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθητο περὶ αὐτὸν ὄχλος, καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου ἔξω ζητοῦσίν σε.

text_en: And answering them, he said: Who is my mother and my brethren ?
text_la: Et respondens eis, ait : Quæ est mater mea et fratres mei?
text_pt: E ele lhes respondeu, dizendo: Quem é minha mãe e meus irmãos?
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτοῖς λέγει: τίς ἐστιν ἡ μήτηρ μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί;

text_en: And looking round about on them who sat about him, he says: Behold my mother and my brethren.
text_la: Et circumspiciens eos, qui in circuitu ejus sedebant, ait : Ecce mater mea et fratres mei.
text_pt: E, olhando em redor para os que estavam assentados junto dele, disse: Eis aqui minha mãe e meus irmãos.
text_el: καὶ περιβλεψάμενος τοὺς περὶ αὐτὸν κύκλῳ καθημένους λέγει: ἴδε ἡ μήτηρ μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου.

text_en: For whosoever shall do the will of God , he is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
text_la: Qui enim fecerit voluntatem Dei, hic frater meus, et soror mea, et mater est.
text_pt: Porquanto, qualquer que fizer a vontade de Deus, esse é meu irmão, e minha irmã, e minha mãe.
text_el: ὃς ἂν ποιήσῃ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, οὗτος ἀδελφός μου καὶ ἀδελφὴ καὶ μήτηρ ἐστίν.

text_en: And again he began to teach by the sea side; and a great multitude was gathered together unto him, so that he went up into a ship and sat in the sea: and all the multitude was upon the land by the sea side.
text_la: Et iterum cœpit docere ad mare : et congregata est ad eum turba multa, ita ut navim ascendens sederet in mari, et omnis turba circa mare super terram erat:
text_pt: E outra vez começou a ensinar junto do mar, e ajuntou-se a ele grande multidão, de sorte que ele entrou e assentou-se num barco, sobre o mar; e toda a multidão estava em terra junto do mar.
text_el: Καὶ πάλιν ἤρξατο διδάσκειν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν. καὶ συνάγεται πρὸς αὐτὸν ὄχλος πλεῖστος, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς πλοῖον ἐμβάντα καθῆσθαι ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος πρὸς τὴν θάλασσαν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἦσαν.

text_en: And he taught them many things in parables , and said unto them in his doctrine:
text_la: et docebat eos in parabolis multa, et dicebat illis in doctrina sua:
text_pt: E ensinava-lhes muitas coisas por parábolas, e lhes dizia na sua doutrina:
text_el: καὶ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν παραβολαῖς πολλά, καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ:

text_en: Hear: Behold, the sower went out to sow.
text_la: Audite: ecce exiit seminans ad seminandum.
text_pt: Ouvi: Eis que saiu o semeador a semear.
text_el: ἀκούετε. ἰδοὺ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρων σπεῖραι.

text_en: And whilst he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the birds of the air came and ate it up.
text_la: Et dum seminat, aliud cecidit circa viam, et venerunt volucres cæli, et comederunt illud.
text_pt: E aconteceu que semeando ele, uma parte da semente caiu junto do caminho, e vieram as aves do céu, e a comeram;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ σπείρειν ὃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, καὶ ἦλθεν τὰ πετεινὰ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτό.

text_en: And other some fell upon stony ground, where it had not much earth; and it shot up immediately, because it had no depth of earth.
text_la: Aliud vero cecidit super petrosa, ubi non habuit terram multam : et statim exortum est, quoniam non habebat altitudinem terræ:
text_pt: E outra caiu sobre pedregais, onde não havia muita terra, e nasceu logo, porque não tinha terra profunda;
text_el: καὶ ἄλλο ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸ πετρῶδες, [καὶ] ὅπου οὐκ εἶχεν γῆν πολλήν, καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξανέτειλεν διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν βάθος γῆς:

text_en: And when the sun was risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
text_la: et quando exortus est sol, exæstuavit : et eo quod non habebat radicem, exaruit.
text_pt: Mas, saindo o sol, queimou-se; e, porque não tinha raiz, secou-se.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἀνέτειλεν ὁ ἥλιος, ἐκαυματίσθη, καὶ διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν ῥίζαν ἐξηράνθη.

text_en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
text_la: Et aliud cecidit in spinas : et ascenderunt spinæ, et suffocaverunt illud, et fructum non dedit.
text_pt: E outra caiu entre espinhos e, crescendo os espinhos, a sufocaram e não deu fruto.
text_el: καὶ ἄλλο ἔπεσεν εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας, καὶ ἀνέβησαν αἱ ἄκανθαι καὶ συνέπνιξαν αὐτό, καὶ καρπὸν οὐκ ἔδωκεν.

text_en: And some fell upon good ground; and brought forth fruit that grew up, and increased and yielded, one thirty, another sixty, and another a hundred.
text_la: Et aliud cecidit in terram bonam : et dabat fructum ascendentem et crescentem, et afferebat unum triginta, unum sexaginta, et unum centum.
text_pt: E outra caiu em boa terra e deu fruto, que vingou e cresceu; e um produziu trinta, outro sessenta, e outro cem.
text_el: καὶ ἄλλα ἔπεσεν εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν καλήν, καὶ ἐδίδου καρπὸν ἀναβαίνοντα καὶ αὐξανόμενα, καὶ ἔφερεν εἰς τριάκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑξήκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑκατόν.

text_en: And he said: He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
text_la: Et dicebat : Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν: ὃς ἔχει ὦτα ἀκούειν, ἀκουέτω.

text_en: And when he was alone, the twelve that were with him asked him the parable .
text_la: Et cum esset singularis, interrogaverunt eum hi qui cum eo erant duodecim, parabolam.
text_pt: E, quando se achou só, osque estavam junto dele com os doze interrogaram-no acerca da parábola.
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο κατὰ μόνας, ἠρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν σὺν τοῖς δώδεκα τὰς παραβολάς.

text_en: And he said to them: To you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God : but to them that are without, all things are done in parables :
text_la: Et dicebat eis : Vobis datum est nosse mysterium regni Dei : illis autem, qui foris sunt, in parabolis omnia fiunt:
text_pt: E ele disse-lhes: A vós vos é dado saber os mistérios do reino de Deus, mas aos que estão de fora todas estas coisas se dizem por parábolas,
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: ὑμῖν τὸ μυστήριον δέδοται τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ: ἐκείνοις δὲ τοῖς ἔξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὰ πάντα γίνεται,

text_en: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted , and their sins should be forgiven them.
text_la: ut videntes videant, et non videant : et audientes audiant, et non intelligant : nequando convertantur, et dimittantur eis peccata.
text_pt: Para que, vendo, vejam, e não percebam; e, ouvindo, ouçam, e não entendam; para que não se convertam, e lhes sejam perdoados os pecados.
text_el: ἵνα βλέποντες βλέπωσιν καὶ μὴ ἴδωσιν, καὶ ἀκούοντες ἀκούωσιν καὶ μὴ συνιῶσιν, μήποτε ἐπιστρέψωσιν καὶ ἀφεθῇ αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And he says to them: Are you ignorant of this parable ? And how shall you know all parables ?
text_la: Et ait illis : Nescitis parabolam hanc? Et quomodo omnes parabolas cognoscetis?
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Não percebeis esta parábola? Como, pois, entendereis todas as parábolas?
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην, καὶ πῶς πάσας τὰς παραβολὰς γνώσεσθε;

text_en: He that sows, sows the word .
text_la: Qui seminat, verbum seminat.
text_pt: O que semeia, semeia a palavra;
text_el: ὁ σπείρων τὸν λόγον σπείρει.

text_en: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown, and as soon as they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in their hearts.
text_la: Hi autem sunt, qui circa viam, ubi seminatur verbum, et cum audierint, confestim venit Satanas, et aufert verbum, quod seminatum est in cordibus eorum.
text_pt: E, os que estão junto do caminho são aqueles em quem a palavra é semeada; mas, tendo-a eles ouvido, vem logo Satanás e tira a palavra que foi semeada nos seus corações.
text_el: οὗτοι δέ εἰσιν οἱ παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ὅπου σπείρεται ὁ λόγος, καὶ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν εὐθὺς ἔρχεται ὁ Σατανᾶς καὶ αἴρει τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐσπαρμένον εἰς αὐτούς.

text_en: And these likewise are they that are sown on the stony ground: who when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with joy .
text_la: Et hi sunt similiter, qui super petrosa seminantur : qui cum audierint verbum, statim cum gaudio accipiunt illud:
text_pt: E da mesma forma os que recebem a semente sobre pedregais; os quais, ouvindo a palavra, logo com prazer a recebem;
text_el: καὶ οὗτοί εἰσιν ὁμοίως οἱ ἐπὶ τὰ πετρώδη σπειρόμενοι, οἳ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς μετὰ χαρᾶς λαμβάνουσιν αὐτόν,

text_en: And they have no root in themselves, but are only for a time: and then when tribulation and persecution arises for the word they are presently scandalized .
text_la: et non habent radicem in se, sed temporales sunt : deinde orta tribulatione et persecutione propter verbum, confestim scandalizantur.
text_pt: Mas não têm raiz em si mesmos, antes são temporãos; depois, sobrevindo tribulação ou perseguição, por causa da palavra, logo se escandalizam.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν ῥίζαν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἀλλὰ πρόσκαιροί εἰσιν, εἶτα γενομένης θλίψεως ἢ διωγμοῦ διὰ τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς σκανδαλίζονται.

text_en: And others there are who are sown among thorns: these are they that hear the word ,
text_la: Et alii sunt qui in spinas seminantur : hi sunt qui verbum audiunt,
text_pt: E outros são os que recebem a semente entre espinhos, os quais ouvem a palavra;
text_el: καὶ ἄλλοι εἰσὶν οἱ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας σπειρόμενοι: οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ τὸν λόγον ἀκούσαντες,

text_en: and the cares of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts after other things entering in choke the word, and it is made fruitless.
text_la: et ærumnæ sæculi, et deceptio divitiarum, et circa reliqua concupiscentiæ introëuntes suffocant verbum, et sine fructu efficitur.
text_pt: Mas os cuidados deste mundo, e os enganos das riquezas e as ambições de outras coisas, entrando, sufocam a palavra, e fica infrutífera.
text_el: καὶ αἱ μέριμναι τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἡ ἀπάτη τοῦ πλούτου καὶ αἱ περὶ τὰ λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι εἰσπορευόμεναι συμπνίγουσιν τὸν λόγον, καὶ ἄκαρπος γίνεται.

text_en: And these are they who are sown upon the good ground, who hear the word , and receive it, and yield fruit, the one thirty, another sixty, and another a hundred.
text_la: Et hi sunt qui super terram bonam seminati sunt, qui audiunt verbum, et suscipiunt, et fructificant, unum triginta, unum sexaginta, et unum centum.
text_pt: E estes são os que foram semeados em boa terra, os que ouvem a palavra e a recebem, e dão fruto, um trinta, e outro sessenta, e outro cem.
text_el: καὶ ἐκεῖνοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τὴν καλὴν σπαρέντες, οἵτινες ἀκούουσιν τὸν λόγον καὶ παραδέχονται καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἓν τριάκοντα καὶ [ἐν] ἑξήκοντα καὶ [ἓν] ἑκατόν.

text_en: And he said to them: Does a candle come in to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? And not to be set on a candlestick?
text_la: Et dicebat illis : Numquid venit lucerna ut sub modo ponatur, aut sub lecto? nonne ut super candelabrum ponatur?
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Vem porventura a candeia para se meter debaixo do alqueire, ou debaixo da cama? não vem antes para se colocar no velador?
text_el: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι μήτι ἔρχεται ὁ λύχνος ἵνα ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον τεθῇ ἢ ὑπὸ τὴν κλίνην; οὐχ ἵνα ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν τεθῇ;

text_en: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be made manifest: neither was it made secret, but that it may come abroad.
text_la: Non est enim aliquid absconditum, quod non manifestetur : nec factum est occultum, sed ut in palam veniat.
text_pt: Porque nada há encoberto que não haja de ser manifesto; e nada se faz para ficar oculto, mas para ser descoberto.
text_el: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν κρυπτὸν, ἐὰν μὴ ἵνα φανερωθῇ: οὐδὲ ἐγένετο ἀπόκρυφον, ἀλλ' ἵνα ἔλθῃ εἰς φανερόν.

text_en: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
text_la: Si quis habet aures audiendi, audiat.
text_pt: Se alguém tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
text_el: εἴ τις ἔχει ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω.

text_en: And he said to them: Take heed what you hear. In what measure you shall mete, it shall be measured to you again, and more shall be given to you.
text_la: Et dicebat illis : Videte quid audiatis. In qua mensura mensi fueritis, remetietur vobis, et adjicietur vobis.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Atendei ao que ides ouvir. Com a medida com que medirdes vos medirão a vós, e ser-vos-á ainda acrescentada a vós que ouvis.
text_el: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: βλέπετε τί ἀκούετε. ἐν ᾧ μέτρῳ μετρεῖτε μετρηθήσεται ὑμῖν καὶ προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν.

text_en: For he that has, to him shall be given: and he that has not, that also which he has shall be taken away from him.
text_la: Qui enim habet, dabitur illi : et qui non habet, etiam quod habet auferetur ab eo.
text_pt: Porque ao que tem, ser-lhe-á dado; e, ao que não tem, até o que tem lhe será tirado.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ ἔχει, δοθήσεται αὐτῷ: καὶ ὃς οὐκ ἔχει, καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he said: So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the earth,
text_la: Et dicebat : Sic est regnum Dei, quemadmodum si homo jaciat sementem in terram,
text_pt: E dizia: O reino de Deus é assim como se um homem lançasse semente à terra.
text_el: Καὶ ἔλεγεν: οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ, ὡς ἄνθρωπος βάλῃ τὸν σπόρον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,

text_en: and should sleep, and rise, night and day, and the seed should spring, and grow up whilst he knows not.
text_la: et dormiat, et exsurgat nocte et die, et semen germinet, et increscat dum nescit ille.
text_pt: E dormisse, e se levantasse de noite ou de dia, e a semente brotasse e crescesse, não sabendo ele como.
text_el: καὶ καθεύδῃ καὶ ἐγείρηται νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν, καὶ ὁ σπόρος βλαστᾷ καὶ μηκύνηται ὡς οὐκ οἶδεν αὐτός.

text_en: For the earth of itself brings forth fruit, first the blade, then the ear, afterwards the full corn in the ear.
text_la: Ultro enim terra fructificat, primum herbam, deinde spicam, deinde plenum frumentum in spica.
text_pt: Porque a terra por si mesma frutifica, primeiro a erva, depois a espiga, por último o grão cheio na espiga.
text_el: αὐτομάτη ἡ γῆ καρποφορεῖ, πρῶτον χόρτον, εἶτεν στάχυν, εἶτεν πλήρη σῖτον ἐν τῷ στάχυϊ.

text_en: And when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.
text_la: Et cum produxerit fructus, statim mittit falcem, quoniam adest messis.
text_pt: E, quando já o fruto se mostra, mete-se-lhe logo a foice, porque está chegada a ceifa.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ παραδοῖ ὁ καρπός, εὐθὺς ἀποστέλλει τὸ δρέπανον, ὅτι παρέστηκεν ὁ θερισμός.

text_en: And he said: To what shall we liken the kingdom of God ? Or to what parable shall we compare it?
text_la: Et dicebat : Cui assimilabimus regnum Dei? aut cui parabolæ comparabimus illud?
text_pt: E dizia: A que assemelhare-mos o reino de Deus? ou com que parábola o representaremos?
text_el: Καὶ ἔλεγεν: πῶς ὁμοιώσωμεν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἢ ἐν τίνι αὐτὴν παραβολῇ θῶμεν;

text_en: It is as a grain of mustard seed: which when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that are in the earth:
text_la: Sicut granum sinapis, quod cum seminatum fuerit in terra, minus est omnibus seminibus, quæ sunt in terra:
text_pt: É como um grão de mostarda, que, quando se semeia na terra, é a menor de todas as sementes que há na terra;
text_el: ὡς κόκκῳ σινάπεως, ὃς ὅταν σπαρῇ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, μικρότερον ὂν πάντων τῶν σπερμάτων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,

text_en: And when it is sown, it grows up, and becomes greater than all herbs, and shoots out great branches, so that the birds of the air may dwell under the shadow thereof.
text_la: et cum seminatum fuerit, ascendit, et fit majus omnibus oleribus, et facit ramos magnos, ita ut possint sub umbra ejus aves cæli habitare.
text_pt: Mas, tendo sido semeado, cresce; e faz-se a maior de todas as hortaliças, e cria grandes ramos, de tal maneira que as aves do céu podem aninhar-se debaixo da sua sombra.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν σπαρῇ, ἀναβαίνει καὶ γίνεται μεῖζον πάντων τῶν λαχάνων, καὶ ποιεῖ κλάδους μεγάλους, ὥστε δύνασθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σκιὰν αὐτοῦ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνοῦν.

text_en: And with many such parables , he spoke to them the word , according as they were able to hear.
text_la: Et talibus multis parabolis loquebatur eis verbum, prout poterant audire:
text_pt: E com muitas parábolas tais lhes dirigia a palavra, segundo o que podiam compreender.
text_el: Καὶ τοιαύταις παραβολαῖς πολλαῖς ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον, καθὼς ἠδύναντο ἀκούειν:

text_en: And without parable he did not speak unto them; but apart, he explained all things to his disciples .
text_la: sine parabola autem non loquebatur eis: seorsum autem discipulis suis disserebat omnia.
text_pt: E sem parábolas nunca lhes falava; porém, tudo declarava em particular aos seus discípulos.
text_el: χωρὶς δὲ παραβολῆς οὐκ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς, κατ' ἰδίαν δὲ τοῖς ἰδίοις μαθηταῖς ἐπέλυεν πάντα.

text_en: And he says to them that day, when evening had come: Let us pass over to the other side.
text_la: Et ait illis in illa die, cum sero esset factum : Transeamus contra.
text_pt: E, naquele dia, sendo já tarde, disse-lhes: Passemos para o outro lado.
text_el: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὀψίας γενομένης: διέλθωμεν εἰς τὸ πέραν.

text_en: And sending away the multitude, they take him even as he was in the ship: and there were other ships with him.
text_la: Et dimittentes turbam, assumunt eum ita ut erat in navi : et aliæ naves erant cum illo.
text_pt: E eles, deixando a multidão, o levaram consigo, assim como estava, no barco; e havia também com ele outros barquinhos.
text_el: καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν ὄχλον παραλαμβάνουσιν αὐτὸν ὡς ἦν ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ, καὶ ἄλλα πλοῖα ἦν μετ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that the ship was filled.
text_la: Et facta est procella magna venti, et fluctus mittebat in navim, ita ut impleretur navis.
text_pt: E levantou-se grande temporal de vento, e subiam as ondas por cima do barco, de maneira que já se enchia.
text_el: καὶ γίνεται λαῖλαψ μεγάλη ἀνέμου, καὶ τὰ κύματα ἐπέβαλλεν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, ὥστε ἤδη γεμίζεσθαι τὸ πλοῖον.

text_en: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, sleeping upon a pillow; and they awake him, and say to him: Master, does it not concern you that we perish?
text_la: Et erat ipse in puppi super cervical dormiens : et excitant eum, et dicunt illi : Magister, non ad te pertinet, quia perimus?
text_pt: E ele estava na popa, dormindo sobre uma almofada, e despertaram-no, dizendo-lhe: Mestre, não se te dá que pereçamos?
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν ἐν τῇ πρύμνῃ ἐπὶ τὸ προσκεφάλαιον καθεύδων: καὶ ἐγείρουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: διδάσκαλε, οὐ μέλει σοι ὅτι ἀπολλύμεθα;

text_en: And rising up, he rebuked the wind, and said to the sea: Peace, be still. And the wind ceased: and there was made a great calm.
text_la: Et exsurgens comminatus est vento, et dixit mari : Tace, obmutesce. Et cessavit ventus : et facta est tranquillitas magna.
text_pt: E ele, despertando, repreendeu o vento, e disse ao mar: Cala-te, aquieta-te. E o vento se aquietou, e houve grande bonança.
text_el: καὶ διεγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ ἀνέμῳ καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θαλάσσῃ: σιώπα, πεφίμωσο. καὶ ἐκόπασεν ὁ ἄνεμος, καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη.

text_en: And he said to them: Why are you fearful? Have you not faith yet?
text_la: Et ait illis : Quid timidi estis? necdum habetis fidem?
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Por que sois tão tímidos? Ainda não tendes fé?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τί δειλοί ἐστε οὔπω; ἔχετε πίστιν;

text_en: And they feared exceedingly: and they said one to another: Who is this (do you think) that both wind and sea obey him?
text_la: et timuerunt timore magno, et dicebant ad alterutrum : Quis, putas, est iste, quia et ventus et mare obediunt ei?
text_pt: E sentiram um grande temor, e diziam uns aos outros: Mas quem é este, que até o vento e o mar lhe obedecem?
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν, καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἀλλήλους: τίς ἄρα οὗτός ἐστιν, ὅτι καὶ ὁ ἄνεμος καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ὑπακούει αὐτῷ;

text_en: And they came over the strait of the sea, into the country of the Gerasens .
text_la: Et venerunt trans fretum maris in regionem Gerasenorum.
text_pt: E chegaram ao outro lado do mar, à província dos gadarenos.
text_el: Καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὸ πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γερασηνῶν.

text_en: And as he went out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the monuments a man with an unclean spirit ,
text_la: Et exeunti ei de navi, statim occurrit de monumentis homo in spiritu immundo,
text_pt: E, saindo ele do barco, lhe saiu logo ao seu encontro, dos sepulcros, um homem com espírito imundo;
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθόντος αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ πλοίου, [εὐθὺς] ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν μνημείων ἄνθρωπος ἐν πνεύματι ἀκαθάρτῳ,

text_en: who had his dwelling in the tombs , and no man now could bind him, not even with chains.
text_la: qui domicilium habebat in monumentis, et neque catenis jam quisquam poterat eum ligare:
text_pt: O qual tinha a sua morada nos sepulcros, e nem ainda com cadeias o podia alguém prender;
text_el: ὃς τὴν κατοίκησιν εἶχεν ἐν τοῖς μνήμασιν, καὶ οὐδὲ ἁλύσει οὐκέτι οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο αὐτὸν δῆσαι,

text_en: For having been often bound with fetters and chains, he had burst the chains, and broken the fetters in pieces, and no one could tame him.
text_la: quoniam sæpe compedibus et catenis vinctus, dirupisset catenas, et compedes comminuisset, et nemo poterat eum domare:
text_pt: Porque, tendo sido muitas vezes preso com grilhões e cadeias, as cadeias foram por ele feitas em pedaços, e os grilhões em migalhas, e ninguém o podia amansar.
text_el: διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν πολλάκις πέδαις καὶ ἁλύσεσιν δεδέσθαι καὶ διεσπάσθαι ὑπ' αὐτοῦ τὰς ἁλύσεις καὶ τὰς πέδας συντετρῖφθαι, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἴσχυεν αὐτὸν δαμάσαι,

text_en: And he was always day and night in the monuments and in the mountains, crying and cutting himself with stones.
text_la: et semper die ac nocte in monumentis, et in montibus erat, clamans, et concidens se lapidibus.
text_pt: E andava sempre, de dia e de noite, clamando pelos montes, e pelos sepulcros, e ferindo-se com pedras.
text_el: καὶ διὰ παντὸς νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐν τοῖς μνήμασιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν ἦν κράζων καὶ κατακόπτων ἑαυτὸν λίθοις.

text_en: And seeing Jesus afar off, he ran and adored him.
text_la: Videns autem Jesum a longe, cucurrit, et adoravit eum:
text_pt: E, quando viu Jesus ao longe, correu e adorou-o.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἔδραμεν καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτόν,

text_en: And crying with a loud voice, he said: What have I to do with you, Jesus the Son of the most high God ? I adjure you by God that you torment me not.
text_la: et clamans voce magna dixit : Quid mihi et tibi, Jesu Fili Dei altissimi? adjuro te per Deum, ne me torqueas.
text_pt: E, clamando com grande voz, disse: Que tenho eu contigo, Jesus, Filho do Deus Altíssimo? conjuro-te por Deus que não me atormentes.
text_el: καὶ κράξας φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγει: τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί, Ἰησοῦ υἱὲ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ὑψίστου; ὁρκίζω σε τὸν θεόν, μή με βασανίσῃς.

text_en: For he said unto him: Go out of the man , you unclean spirit .
text_la: Dicebat enim illi: Exi spiritus immunde ab homine.
text_pt: (Porque lhe dizia: Sai deste homem, espírito imundo.)
text_el: ἔλεγεν γὰρ αὐτῷ: ἔξελθε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον ἐκ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: And he asked him: What is your name ? And he said to him: My name is Legion, for we are many.
text_la: Et interrogabat eum : Quod tibi nomen est? Et dicit ei : Legio mihi nomen est, quia multi sumus.
text_pt: E perguntou-lhe: Qual é o teu nome? E lhe respondeu, dizendo: Legião é o meu nome, porque somos muitos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν: τί ὄνομά σοι; καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: λεγιὼν ὄνομά μοι, ὅτι πολλοί ἐσμεν.

text_en: And he besought him much, that he would not drive him away out of the country.
text_la: Et deprecabatur eum multum, ne se expelleret extra regionem.
text_pt: E rogava-lhe muito que os não enviasse para fora daquela província.
text_el: καὶ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν πολλὰ ἵνα μὴ αὐτὰ ἀποστείλῃ ἔξω τῆς χώρας.

text_en: And there was there near the mountain a great herd of swine, feeding.
text_la: Erat autem ibi circa montem grex porcorum magnus, pascens.
text_pt: E andava ali pastando no monte uma grande manada de porcos.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ πρὸς τῷ ὄρει ἀγέλη χοίρων μεγάλη βοσκομένη:

text_en: And the spirits besought him, saying: Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
text_la: Et deprecabantur eum spiritus, dicentes : Mitte nos in porcos ut in eos introëamus.
text_pt: E todos aqueles demônios lhe rogaram, dizendo: Manda-nos para aqueles porcos, para que entremos neles.
text_el: καὶ παρεκάλεσαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες: πέμψον ἡμᾶς εἰς τοὺς χοίρους, ἵνα εἰς αὐτοὺς εἰσέλθωμεν.

text_en: And Jesus immediately gave them leave. And the unclean spirits going out , entered into the swine: and the herd with great violence was carried headlong into the sea, being about two thousand, were stifled in the sea.
text_la: Et concessit eis statim Jesus. Et exeuntes spiritus immundi introierunt in porcos : et magno impetu grex præcipitatus est in mare ad duo millia, et suffocati sunt in mari.
text_pt: E Jesus logo lho permitiu. E, saindo aqueles espíritos imundos, entraram nos porcos; e a manada se precipitou por um despenhadeiro no mar (eram quase dois mil), e afogaram-se no mar.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέτρεψεν αὐτοῖς. καὶ ἐξελθόντα τὰ πνεύματα τὰ ἀκάθαρτα εἰσῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους, καὶ ὥρμησεν ἡ ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, ὡς δισχίλιοι, καὶ ἐπνίγοντο ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ.

text_en: And they that fed them fled, and told it in the city and in the fields. And they went out to see what was done:
text_la: Qui autem pascebant eos, fugerunt, et nuntiaverunt in civitatem et in agros. Et egressi sunt videre quid esset factum:
text_pt: E os que apascentavam os porcos fugiram, e o anunciaram na cidade e nos campos; e saíram muitos a ver o que era aquilo que tinha acontecido.
text_el: καὶ οἱ βόσκοντες αὐτοὺς ἔφυγον καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ εἰς τοὺς ἀγρούς: καὶ ἦλθον ἰδεῖν τί ἐστιν τὸ γεγονός.

text_en: And they came to Jesus , and they see him that was troubled with the devil , sitting, clothed, and well in his wits, and they were afraid.
text_la: et veniunt ad Jesum : et vident illum qui a dæmonio vexabatur, sedentem, vestitum, et sanæ mentis, et timuerunt.
text_pt: E foram ter com Jesus, e viram o endemoninhado, o que tivera a legião, assentado, vestido e em perfeito juízo, e temeram.
text_el: καὶ ἔρχονται πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ θεωροῦσιν τὸν δαιμονιζόμενον καθήμενον ἱματισμένον καὶ σωφρονοῦντα, τὸν ἐσχηκότα τὸν λεγιῶνα, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν.

text_en: And they that had seen it, told them, in what manner he had been dealt with who had the devil ; and concerning the swine.
text_la: Et narraverunt illis, qui viderant, qualiter factum esset ei qui dæmonium habuerat, et de porcis.
text_pt: E os que aquilo tinham visto contaram-lhes o que acontecera ao endemoninhado, e acerca dos porcos.
text_el: καὶ διηγήσαντο αὐτοῖς οἱ ἰδόντες πῶς ἐγένετο τῷ δαιμονιζομένῳ καὶ περὶ τῶν χοίρων.

text_en: And they began to pray him that he would depart from their coasts.
text_la: Et rogare cœperunt eum ut discederet de finibus eorum.
text_pt: E começaram a rogar-lhe que saísse dos seus termos.
text_el: καὶ ἤρξαντο παρακαλεῖν αὐτὸν ἀπελθεῖν ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν.

text_en: And when he went up into the ship, he that had been troubled with the devil , began to beseech him that he might be with him.
text_la: Cumque ascenderet navim, cœpit illum deprecari, qui a dæmonio vexatus fuerat, ut esset cum illo,
text_pt: E, entrando ele no barco, rogava-lhe o que fora endemoninhado que o deixasse estar com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐμβαίνοντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πλοῖον παρεκάλει αὐτὸν ὁ δαιμονισθεὶς ἵνα μετ' αὐτοῦ ᾖ.

text_en: And he admitted him not, but said to him: Go into your house to your friends, and tell them how great things the Lord has done for you, and has had mercy on you.
text_la: et non admisit eum, sed ait illi : Vade in domum tuam ad tuos, et annuntia illis quanta tibi Dominus fecerit, et misertus sit tui.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, não lho permitiu, mas disse-lhe: Vai para tua casa, para os teus, e anuncia-lhes quão grandes coisas o Senhor te fez, e como teve misericórdia de ti.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκεν αὐτόν, ἀλλὰ λέγει αὐτῷ: ὕπαγε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου πρὸς τοὺς σούς, καὶ ἀπάγγειλον αὐτοῖς ὅσα ὁ κύριός σοι πεποίηκεν καὶ ἠλέησέν σε.

text_en: And he went his way, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men wondered.
text_la: Et abiit, et cœpit prædicare in Decapoli, quanta sibi fecisset Jesus : et omnes mirabantur.
text_pt: E ele foi, e começou a anunciar em Decápolis quão grandes coisas Jesus lhe fizera; e todos se maravilharam.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν, καὶ ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν ἐν τῇ Δεκαπόλει ὅσα ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ πάντες ἐθαύμαζον.

text_en: And when Jesus had passed again in the ship over the strait, a great multitude assembled together unto him, and he was near unto the sea.
text_la: Et cum transcendisset Jesus in navi rursum trans fretum, convenit turba multa ad eum, et erat circa mare.
text_pt: E, passando Jesus outra vez num barco para o outro lado, ajuntou-se a ele uma grande multidão; e ele estava junto do mar.
text_el: Καὶ διαπεράσαντος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ πάλιν εἰς τὸ πέραν, συνήχθη ὄχλος πολὺς ἐπ' αὐτόν, καὶ ἦν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν.

text_en: And there comes one of the rulers of the synagogue named Jairus: and seeing him, falls down at his feet.
text_la: Et venit quidam de archisynagogis nomine Jairus, et videns eum procidit ad pedes ejus,
text_pt: E eis que chegou um dos principais da sinagoga, por nome Jairo, e, vendo-o, prostrou-se aos seus pés,
text_el: καὶ ἔρχεται εἷς τῶν ἀρχισυναγώγων, ὀνόματι Ἰάϊρος, καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν πίπτει πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And he besought him much, saying: My daughter is at the point of death, come, lay your hand upon her, that she may be safe, and may live.
text_la: et deprecabatur eum multum, dicens : Quoniam filia mea in extremis est, veni, impone manum super eam, ut salva sit, et vivat.
text_pt: E rogava-lhe muito, dizendo: Minha filha está à morte; rogo-te que venhas e lhe imponhas as mãos, para que sare, e viva.
text_el: καὶ παρακαλεῖ αὐτὸν πολλὰ λέγων ὅτι τὸ θυγάτριόν μου ἐσχάτως ἔχει, ἵνα ἐλθὼν ἐπιθῇς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῇ ἵνα σωθῇ καὶ ζήσῃ.

text_en: And he went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they thronged him.
text_la: Et abiit cum illo, et sequebatur eum turba multa, et comprimebant eum.
text_pt: E foi com ele, e seguia-o uma grande multidão, que o apertava.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν μετ' αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς, καὶ συνέθλιβον αὐτόν.

text_en: And a woman who was under an issue of blood twelve years,
text_la: Et mulier, quæ erat in profluvio sanguinis annis duodecim,
text_pt: E certa mulher que, havia doze anos, tinha um fluxo de sangue,
text_el: καὶ γυνὴ οὖσα ἐν ῥύσει αἵματος δώδεκα ἔτη,

text_en: and had suffered many things from many physicians; and had spent all that she had, and was nothing the better, but rather worse,
text_la: et fuerat multa perpessa a compluribus medicis : et erogaverat omnia sua, nec quidquam profecerat, sed magis deterius habebat:
text_pt: E que havia padecido muito com muitos médicos, e despendido tudo quanto tinha, nada lhe aproveitando isso, antes indo a pior;
text_el: καὶ πολλὰ παθοῦσα ὑπὸ πολλῶν ἰατρῶν καὶ δαπανήσασα τὰ παρ' αὐτῆς πάντα, καὶ μηδὲν ὠφεληθεῖσα ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εἰς τὸ χεῖρον ἐλθοῦσα,

text_en: when she had heard of Jesus , came in the crowd behind him, and touched his garment.
text_la: cum audisset de Jesu, venit in turba retro, et tetigit vestimentum ejus:
text_pt: Ouvindo falar de Jesus, veio por detrás, entre a multidão, e tocou na sua veste.
text_el: ἀκούσασα τὰ περὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ἐλθοῦσα ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ ὄπισθεν ἥψατο τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ:

text_en: For she said: If I shall touch but his garment, I shall be whole.
text_la: dicebat enim : Quia si vel vestimentum ejus tetigero, salva ero.
text_pt: Porque dizia: Se tão-somente tocar nas suas vestes, sararei.
text_el: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ὅτι ἐὰν ἅψωμαι κἂν τῶν ἱματίων αὐτοῦ σωθήσομαι.

text_en: And forthwith the fountain of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of the evil .
text_la: Et confestim siccatus est fons sanguinis ejus : et sensit corpore quia sanata esset a plaga.
text_pt: E logo se lhe secou a fonte do seu sangue; e sentiu no seu corpo estar já curada daquele mal.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξηράνθη ἡ πηγὴ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς, καὶ ἔγνω τῷ σώματι ὅτι ἴαται ἀπὸ τῆς μάστιγος.

text_en: And immediately Jesus knowing in himself the virtue that had proceeded from him, turning to the multitude, said: Who has touched my garments?
text_la: Et statim Jesus in semetipso cognoscens virtutem quæ exierat de illo, conversus ad turbam, aiebat : Quis tetigit vestimenta mea?
text_pt: E logo Jesus, conhecendo que a virtude de si mesmo saíra, voltou-se para a multidão, e disse: Quem tocou nas minhas vestes?
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐπιγνοὺς ἐν ἑαυτῷ τὴν ἐξ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν ἐξελθοῦσαν, ἐπιστραφεὶς ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ ἔλεγεν: τίς μου ἥψατο τῶν ἱματίων;

text_en: And his disciples said to him: You see the multitude thronging you, and you asked who has touched me?
text_la: Et dicebant ei discipuli sui : Vides turbam comprimentem te, et dicis : Quis me tetigit?
text_pt: E disseram-lhe os seus discípulos: Vês que a multidão te aperta, e dizes: Quem me tocou?
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ: βλέπεις τὸν ὄχλον συνθλίβοντά σε, καὶ λέγεις: τίς μου ἥψατο;

text_en: And he looked about to see her who had done this.
text_la: Et circumspiciebat videre eam, quæ hoc fecerat.
text_pt: E ele olhava em redor, para ver a que isto fizera.
text_el: καὶ περιεβλέπετο ἰδεῖν τὴν τοῦτο ποιήσασαν.

text_en: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth .
text_la: Mulier vero timens et tremens, sciens quod factum esset in se, venit et procidit ante eum, et dixit ei omnem veritatem.
text_pt: Então a mulher, que sabia o que lhe tinha acontecido, temendo e tremendo, aproximou-se, e prostrou-se diante dele, e disse-lhe toda a verdade.
text_el: ἡ δὲ γυνὴ φοβηθεῖσα καὶ τρέμουσα, εἰδυῖα ὃ γέγονεν αὐτῇ, ἦλθεν καὶ προσέπεσεν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀλήθειαν.

text_en: And he said to her: Daughter, your faith has made you whole: go in peace, and be whole of your disease.
text_la: Ille autem dixit ei : Filia, fides tua te salvam fecit : vade in pace, et esto sana a plaga tua.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Filha, a tua fé te salvou; vai em paz, e sê curada deste teu mal.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ: θυγάτηρ, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε: ὕπαγε εἰς εἰρήνην, καὶ ἴσθι ὑγιὴς ἀπὸ τῆς μάστιγός σου.

text_en: While he was yet speaking, some come from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying: Your daughter is dead: why do you trouble the master any further?
text_la: Adhuc eo loquente, veniunt ab archisynagogo, dicentes : Quia filia tua mortua est : quid ultra vexas magistrum?
text_pt: Estando ele ainda falando, chegaram alguns do principal da sinagoga, a quem disseram: A tuafilha está morta; para que enfadas mais o Mestre?
text_el: ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἔρχονται ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου λέγοντες ὅτι ἡ θυγάτηρ σου ἀπέθανεν, τί ἔτι σκύλλεις τὸν διδάσκαλον;

text_en: But Jesus having heard the word that was spoken, says to the ruler of the synagogue : Fear not, only believe .
text_la: Jesus autem audito verbo quod dicebatur, ait archisynagogo : Noli timere : tantummodo crede.
text_pt: E Jesus, tendo ouvido estas palavras, disse ao principal da sinagoga: Não temas, crê somente.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς παρακούσας τὸν λόγον λαλούμενον λέγει τῷ ἀρχισυναγώγῳ: μὴ φοβοῦ, μόνον πίστευε.

text_en: And he admitted not any man to follow him, but Peter , and James , and John the brother of James .
text_la: Et non admisit quemquam se sequi nisi Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem fratrem Jacobi.
text_pt: E não permitiu que alguém o seguisse, a não ser Pedro, Tiago, e João, irmão de Tiago.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκεν οὐδένα μετ' αὐτοῦ συνακολουθῆσαι εἰ μὴ τὸν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν Ἰακώβου.

text_en: And they came to the house of the ruler of the synagogue ; and he saw a tumult, and people weeping and wailing much.
text_la: Et veniunt in domum archisynagogi, et videt tumultum, et flentes, et ejulantes multum.
text_pt: E, tendo chegado à casa do principal da sinagoga, viu o alvoroço, e os que choravam muito e pranteavam.
text_el: καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου, καὶ θεωρεῖ θόρυβον καὶ κλαίοντας καὶ ἀλαλάζοντας πολλά,

text_en: And going in, he said to them, Why do you make this ado, and weep? The damsel is not dead, but sleeps.
text_la: Et ingressus, ait illis : Quid turbamini, et ploratis? puella non est mortua, sed dormit.
text_pt: E, entrando, disse-lhes: Por que vos alvoroçais e chorais? A menina não está morta, mas dorme.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελθὼν λέγει αὐτοῖς: τί θορυβεῖσθε καὶ κλαίετε; τὸ παιδίον οὐκ ἀπέθανεν ἀλλὰ καθεύδει.

text_en: And they laughed him to scorn. But he having put them all out, took the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entered in where the damsel was lying.
text_la: Et irridebant eum. Ipse vero ejectis omnibus assumit patrem, et matrem puellæ, et qui secum erant, et ingreditur ubi puella erat jacens.
text_pt: E riam-se dele; porém ele, tendo-os feito sair, tomou consigo o pai e a mãe da menina, e os que com ele estavam, e entrou onde a menina estava deitada.
text_el: καὶ κατεγέλων αὐτοῦ. αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκβαλὼν πάντας παραλαμβάνει τὸν πατέρα τοῦ παιδίου καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ τοὺς μετ' αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἰσπορεύεται ὅπου ἦν τὸ παιδίον.

text_en: And taking the damsel by the hand, he said to her: Talitha cumi , which is, being interpreted: Damsel (I say to you) arise.
text_la: Et tenens manum puellæ, ait illi : Talitha cumi, quod est interpretatum : Puella (tibi dico), surge.
text_pt: E, tomando a mão da menina, disse-lhe: Talita cumi; que, traduzido, é: Menina, a ti te digo, levanta-te.
text_el: καὶ κρατήσας τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ παιδίου λέγει αὐτῇ: ταλιθα κουμ, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον: τὸ κοράσιον, σοὶ λέγω, ἔγειρε.

text_en: And immediately the damsel rose up, and walked: and she was twelve years old: and they were astonished with a great astonishment.
text_la: Et confestim surrexit puella, et ambulabat : erat autem annorum duodecim : et obstupuerunt stupore magno.
text_pt: E logo a menina se levantou, e andava, pois já tinha doze anos; e assombraram-se com grande espanto.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέστη τὸ κοράσιον καὶ περιεπάτει: ἦν γὰρ ἐτῶν δώδεκα: καὶ ἐξέστησαν εὐθὺς ἐκστάσει μεγάλῃ.

text_en: And he charged them strictly that no man should know it: and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
text_la: Et præcepit illis vehementer ut nemo id sciret : et dixit dari illi manducare.
text_pt: E mandou-lhes expressamente que ninguém o soubesse; e disse que lhe dessem de comer.
text_el: καὶ διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς πολλὰ ἵνα μηδεὶς γνοῖ τοῦτο, καὶ εἶπεν δοθῆναι αὐτῇ φαγεῖν.

text_en: And going out from thence, he went into his own country; and his disciples followed him.
text_la: Et egressus inde, abiit in patriam suam : et sequebantur eum discipuli sui:
text_pt: E, partindo dali, chegou à sua pátria, e os seus discípulos o seguiram.
text_el: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν, καὶ ἔρχεται εἰς τὴν πατρίδα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀκολουθοῦσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And when the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue : and many hearing him were in admiration at his doctrine, saying: How came this man by all these things? And what wisdom is this that is given to him, and such mighty works as are wrought by his hands?
text_la: et facto sabbato cœpit in synagoga docere : et multi audientes admirabantur in doctrina ejus, dicentes : Unde huic hæc omnia? et quæ est sapientia, quæ data est illi, et virtutes tales, quæ per manus ejus efficiuntur?
text_pt: E, chegando o sábado, começou a ensinar na sinagoga; e muitos, ouvindo-o, se admiravam, dizendo: De onde lhe vêm estas coisas? e que sabedoria é esta que lhe foi dada? e como se fazem tais maravilhas por suas mãos?
text_el: καὶ γενομένου σαββάτου ἤρξατο διδάσκειν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ: καὶ οἱ πολλοὶ ἀκούοντες ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες, πόθεν: τούτῳ ταῦτα καὶ, τίς ἡ σοφία ἡ δοθεῖσα τούτῳ καὶ; αἱ δυνάμεις τοιαῦται διὰ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ γινόμεναι;

text_en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James , and Joseph, and Jude , and Simon? Are not also his sisters here with us? And they were scandalized in regard of him.
text_la: Nonne hic est faber, filius Mariæ, frater Jacobi, et Joseph, et Judæ, et Simonis? nonne et sorores ejus hic nobiscum sunt? Et scandalizabantur in illo.
text_pt: Não é este o carpinteiro, filho de Maria, e irmão de Tiago, e de José, e de Judas e de Simão? e não estão aqui conosco suas irmãs? E escandalizavam-se nele.
