text_el: οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τέκτων, ὁ υἱὸς τῆς Μαρίας καὶ ἀδελφὸς Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωσῆτος καὶ Ἰούδα καὶ Σίμωνος; καὶ οὐκ εἰσὶν αἱ ἀδελφαὶ αὐτοῦ ὧδε πρὸς ἡμᾶς; καὶ ἐσκανδαλίζοντο ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And Jesus said to them: A prophet is not without honour , but in his own country, and in his own house, and among his own kindred .
text_la: Et dicebat illis Jesus : Quia non est propheta sine honore nisi in patria sua, et in domo sua, et in cognatione sua.
text_pt: E Jesus lhes dizia: Não há profeta sem honra senão na suapátria, entre os seus parentes, e na sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν προφήτης ἄτιμος εἰ μὴ ἐν τῇ πατρίδι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τοῖς συγγενεῦσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he could not do any miracles there, only that he cured a few that were sick, laying his hands upon them.
text_la: Et non poterat ibi virtutem ullam facere, nisi paucos infirmos impositis manibus curavit:
text_pt: E não podia fazer ali nenhuma obra maravilhosa; somente curou alguns poucos enfermos, impondo-lhes as mãos.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐδύνατο ἐκεῖ ποιῆσαι οὐδεμίαν δύναμιν, εἰ μὴ ὀλίγοις ἀρρώστοις ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας ἐθεράπευσεν.

text_en: And he wondered because of their unbelief, and he went through the villages round about teaching.
text_la: et mirabatur propter incredulitatem eorum, et circuibat castella in circuitu docens.
text_pt: E estava admirado da incredulidade deles. E percorreu as aldeias vizinhas, ensinando.
text_el: καὶ ἐθαύμασεν διὰ τὴν ἀπιστίαν αὐτῶν. Καὶ περιῆγεν τὰς κώμας κύκλῳ διδάσκων.

text_en: And he called the twelve; and began to send them two and two, and gave them power over unclean spirits .
text_la: Et vocavit duodecim : et cœpit eos mittere binos, et dabat illis potestatem spirituum immundorum.
text_pt: Chamou a si os doze, e começou a enviá-los a dois e dois, e deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos;
text_el: Καὶ προσκαλεῖται τοὺς δώδεκα, καὶ ἤρξατο αὐτοὺς ἀποστέλλειν δύο δύο, καὶ ἐδίδου αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν ἀκαθάρτων,

text_en: And he commanded them that they should take nothing for the way, but a staff only; no scrip, no bread, nor money in their purse,
text_la: Et præcepit eis ne quid tollerent in via, nisi virgam tantum : non peram, non panem, neque in zona æs,
text_pt: E ordenou-lhes que nada tomassem para o caminho, senão somente um bordão; nem alforje, nem pão, nem dinheiro no cinto;
text_el: καὶ παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδὲν αἴρωσιν εἰς ὁδὸν εἰ μὴ ῥάβδον μόνον, μὴ ἄρτον, μὴ πήραν, μὴ εἰς τὴν ζώνην χαλκόν,

text_en: but to be shod with sandals, and that they should not put on two coats.
text_la: sed calceatos sandaliis, et ne induerentur duabus tunicis.
text_pt: Mas que calçassem alparcas, e que não vestissem duas túnicas.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ὑποδεδεμένους σανδάλια καὶ μὴ ἐνδύσασθαι δύο χιτῶνας.

text_en: And he said to them: Wheresoever you shall enter into an house, there abide till you depart from that place.
text_la: Et dicebat eis : Quocumque introieritis in domum, illic manete donec exeatis inde:
text_pt: E dizia-lhes: Na casa em que entrardes, ficai nela até partirdes dali.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: ὅπου ἐὰν εἰσέλθητε εἰς οἰκίαν, ἐκεῖ μένετε ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθητε ἐκεῖθεν.

text_en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you; going forth from thence, shake off the dust from your feet for a testimony to them.
text_la: et quicumque non receperint vos, nec audierint vos, exeuntes inde, excutite pulverem de pedibus vestris in testimonium illis.
text_pt: E tantos quantos vos não receberem, nem vos ouvirem, saindo dali, sacudi o pó que estiver debaixo dos vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles. Em verdade vos digo que haverá mais tolerância no dia de juízo para Sodoma e Gomorra, do que para os daquela cidade.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν τόπος μὴ δέξηται ὑμᾶς μηδὲ ἀκούσωσιν ὑμῶν, ἐκπορευόμενοι ἐκεῖθεν ἐκτινάξατε τὸν χοῦν τὸν ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And going forth they preached men should do penance :
text_la: Et exeuntes prædicabant ut pœnitentiam agerent:
text_pt: E, saindo eles, pregavam que se arrependessem.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθόντες ἐκήρυξαν ἵνα μετανοῶσιν,

text_en: And they cast out many devils , and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
text_la: et dæmonia multa ejiciebant, et ungebant oleo multos ægros, et sanabant.
text_pt: E expulsavam muitos demônios, e ungiam muitos enfermos com óleo, e os curavam.
text_el: καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλλον, καὶ ἤλειφον ἐλαίῳ πολλοὺς ἀρρώστους καὶ ἐθεράπευον.

text_en: And King Herod heard, (for his name was made manifest), and he said: John the Baptist is risen again from the dead , and therefore mighty works show forth themselves in him.
text_la: Et audivit rex Herodes (manifestum enim factum est nomen ejus), et dicebat : Quia Joannes Baptista resurrexit a mortuis : et propterea virtutes operantur in illo.
text_pt: E ouviu isto o rei Herodes (porque o nome de Jesus se tornara notório), e disse: João, o que batizava, ressuscitou dentre os mortos, e por isso estas maravilhas operam nele.
text_el: Καὶ ἤκουσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἡρῴδης, φανερὸν γὰρ ἐγένετο τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτίζων ἐγήγερται ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ἐνεργοῦσιν αἱ δυνάμεις ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And others said: It is Elias . But others said: It is a prophet , as one of the prophets .
text_la: Alii autem dicebant : Quia Elias est; alii vero dicebant : Quia propheta est, quasi unus ex prophetis.
text_pt: Outros diziam: É Elias. E diziam outros: É um profeta, ou como um dos profetas.
text_el: ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἠλίας ἐστίν: ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον ὅτι προφήτης ὡς εἷς τῶν προφητῶν.

text_en: Which Herod hearing, said: John whom I beheaded, he is risen again from the dead .
text_la: Quo audito Herodes ait : Quem ego decollavi Joannem, hic a mortuis resurrexit.
text_pt: Herodes, porém, ouvindo isto, disse: Este é João, que mandei degolar; ressuscitou dentre os mortos.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἡρῴδης ἔλεγεν, ὃν ἐγὼ ἀπεκεφάλισα Ἰωάννην, οὗτος ἠγέρθη.

text_en: For Herod himself had sent and apprehended John , and bound him prison for the sake of Herodias the wife of Philip his brother, because he had married her.
text_la: Ipse enim Herodes misit, ac tenuit Joannem, et vinxit eum in carcere propter Herodiadem uxorem Philippi fratris sui, quia duxerat eam.
text_pt: Porquanto o mesmo Herodes mandara prender a João, e encerrá-lo maniatado no cárcere, por causa de Herodias, mulher de Filipe, seu irmão, porquanto tinha casado com ela.
text_el: Αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ Ἡρῴδης ἀποστείλας ἐκράτησεν τὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸν ἐν φυλακῇ διὰ Ἡρῳδιάδα τὴν γυναῖκα Φιλίππου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι αὐτὴν ἐγάμησεν:

text_en: For John said to Herod : It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife.
text_la: Dicebat enim Joannes Herodi : Non licet tibi habere uxorem fratris tui.
text_pt: Pois João dizia a Herodes: Não te é lícito possuir a mulher de teu irmão.
text_el: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ὁ Ἰωάννης τῷ Ἡρῴδῃ ὅτι οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἔχειν τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου.

text_en: Now Herodias laid snares for him: and was desirous to put him to death and could not.
text_la: Herodias autem insidiabatur illi : et volebat occidere eum, nec poterat.
text_pt: E Herodias o espiava, e queria matá-lo, mas não podia.
text_el: ἡ δὲ Ἡρῳδιὰς ἐνεῖχεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἤθελεν αὐτὸν ἀποκτεῖναι, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο:

text_en: For Herod feared John , knowing him to be a just and holy man : and kept him, and when he heard him, did many things: and he heard him willingly.
text_la: Herodes enim metuebat Joannem, sciens eum virum justum et sanctum : et custodiebat eum, et audito eo multa faciebat, et libenter eum audiebat.
text_pt: Porque Herodes temia a João, sabendo que era homem justo e santo; e guardava-o com segurança, e fazia muitas coisas, atendendo-o, e de boa mente o ouvia.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ Ἡρῴδης ἐφοβεῖτο τὸν Ἰωάννην, εἰδὼς αὐτὸν ἄνδρα δίκαιον καὶ ἅγιον, καὶ συνετήρει αὐτόν, καὶ ἀκούσας αὐτοῦ πολλὰ ἠπόρει, καὶ ἡδέως αὐτοῦ ἤκουεν.

text_en: And when a convenient day had come, Herod made a supper for his birthday, for the princes, and tribunes, and chief men of Galilee .
text_la: Et cum dies opportunus accidisset, Herodes natalis sui cœnam fecit principibus, et tribunis, et primis Galilææ:
text_pt: E, chegando uma ocasião favorável em que Herodes, no dia dos seus anos, dava uma ceia aos grandes, e tribunos, e príncipes da Galiléia,
text_el: καὶ γενομένης ἡμέρας εὐκαίρου, ὅτε Ἡρῴδης τοῖς γενεσίοις αὐτοῦ δεῖπνον ἐποίησεν τοῖς μεγιστᾶσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῖς χιλιάρχοις καὶ τοῖς πρώτοις τῆς Γαλιλαίας,

text_en: And when the daughter of the same Herodias had come in, and had danced , and pleased Herod , and them that were at table with him, the king said to the damsel: Ask of me what you will, and I will give it you.
text_la: cumque introisset filia ipsius Herodiadis, et saltasset, et placuisset Herodi, simulque recumbentibus, rex ait puellæ : Pete a me quod vis, et dabo tibi:
text_pt: Entrou a filha da mesma Herodias, e dançou, e agradou a Herodes e aos que estavam com ele à mesa. Disse então o rei à menina: Pede-me o que quiseres, e eu to darei.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελθούσης τῆς θυγατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἡρῳδιάδος καὶ ὀρχησαμένης, ἤρεσεν τῷ Ἡρῴδῃ καὶ τοῖς συνανακειμένοις. ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς εἶπεν τῷ κορασίῳ: αἴτησόν με ὃ ἐὰν θέλῃς, καὶ δώσω σοι:

text_en: And he swore to her: Whatsoever you shall ask I will give you, though it be the half of my kingdom.
text_la: et juravit illi : Quia quidquid petieris dabo tibi, licet dimidium regni mei.
text_pt: E jurou-lhe, dizendo: Tudo o que me pedires te darei, até metade do meu reino.
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτῇ ὅ τι ἐάν με αἰτήσῃς δώσω σοι ἕως ἡμίσους τῆς βασιλείας μου.

text_en: Who when she had gone out, said to her mother, What shall I ask? But her mother said: The head of John the Baptist .
text_la: Quæ cum exisset, dixit matri suæ : Quid petam? At illa dixit : Caput Joannis Baptistæ.
text_pt: E, saindo ela, perguntou a sua mãe: Que pedirei? E ela disse: A cabeça de João o Batista.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθοῦσα εἶπεν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῆς: τί αἰτήσωμαι; ἡ δὲ εἶπεν: τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰωάννου τοῦ βαπτίζοντος.

text_en: And when she had come in immediately with haste to the king, she asked, saying: I will that forthwith you give me in a dish, the head of John the Baptist .
text_la: Cumque introisset statim cum festinatione ad regem, petivit dicens : Volo ut protinus des mihi in disco caput Joannis Baptistæ.
text_pt: E, entrando logo, apressadamente, pediu ao rei, dizendo: Quero que imediatamente me dês num prato a cabeça de João o Batista.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελθοῦσα εὐθὺς μετὰ σπουδῆς πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ᾐτήσατο λέγουσα: θέλω ἵνα ἐξαυτῆς δῷς μοι ἐπὶ πίνακι τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰωάννου τοῦ βαπτιστοῦ.

text_en: And the king was struck sad. Yet because of his oath , and because of them that were with him at table, he would not displease her:
text_la: Et contristatus est rex : propter jusjurandum, et propter simul discumbentes, noluit eam contristare:
text_pt: E o rei entristeceu-se muito; todavia, por causa do juramento e dos que estavam com ele à mesa, não lha quis negar.
text_el: καὶ περίλυπος γενόμενος ὁ βασιλεὺς διὰ τοὺς ὅρκους καὶ τοὺς ἀνακειμένους οὐκ ἠθέλησεν ἀθετῆσαι αὐτήν.

text_en: But sending an executioner, he commanded that his head should be brought in a dish.
text_la: sed misso spiculatore præcepit afferri caput ejus in disco. Et decollavit eum in carcere,
text_pt: E, enviando logo o rei o executor, mandou que lhe trouxessem ali a cabeça de João. E ele foi, e degolou-o na prisão;
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀποστείλας ὁ βασιλεὺς σπεκουλάτορα ἐπέταξεν ἐνέγκαι τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἀπεκεφάλισεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ,

text_en: And he beheaded him in the prison , and brought his head in a dish: and gave to the damsel, and the damsel gave it her mother.
text_la: et attulit caput ejus in disco : et dedit illud puellæ, et puella dedit matri suæ.
text_pt: E trouxe a cabeça num prato, e deu-a à menina, e a menina a deu a sua mãe.
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκεν τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πίνακι καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν τῷ κορασίῳ, καὶ τὸ κοράσιον ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῆς.

text_en: Which his disciples hearing came, and took his body, and laid it in a tomb .
text_la: Quo audito, discipuli ejus venerunt, et tulerunt corpus ejus : et posuerunt illud in monumento.
text_pt: E os seus discípulos, tendo ouvido isto, foram, tomaram o seu corpo, e o puseram num sepulcro.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἦλθον καὶ ἦραν τὸ πτῶμα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔθηκαν αὐτὸ ἐν μνημείῳ.

text_en: And the apostles coming together unto Jesus , related to him all things that they had done and taught.
text_la: Et convenientes Apostoli ad Jesum, renuntiaverunt ei omnia quæ egerant, et docuerant.
text_pt: E os apóstolos ajuntaram-se a Jesus, e contaram-lhe tudo, tanto o que tinham feito como o que tinham ensinado.
text_el: Καὶ συνάγονται οἱ ἀπόστολοι πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν αὐτῷ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησαν καὶ ὅσα ἐδίδαξαν.

text_en: And he said to them: Come apart into a desert place , and rest a little. For there were many coming and going: and they had not so much as time to eat.
text_la: Et ait illis : Venite seorsum in desertum locum, et requiescite pusillum. Erant enim qui veniebant et redibant multi : et nec spatium manducandi habebant.
text_pt: E ele disse-lhes: Vinde vós, aqui à parte, a um lugar deserto, e repousai um pouco. Porque havia muitos que iam e vinham, e não tinham tempo para comer.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: δεῦτε ὑμεῖς αὐτοὶ κατ' ἰδίαν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον καὶ ἀναπαύσασθε ὀλίγον. ἦσαν γὰρ οἱ ἐρχόμενοι καὶ οἱ ὑπάγοντες πολλοί, καὶ οὐδὲ φαγεῖν εὐκαίρουν.

text_en: And going up into a ship, they went into a desert place apart.
text_la: Et ascendentes in navim, abierunt in desertum locum seorsum.
text_pt: E foram sós num barco para um lugar deserto.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθον ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κατ' ἰδίαν.

text_en: And they saw them going away, and many knew : and they ran flocking thither foot from all the cities, and were there before them.
text_la: Et viderunt eos abeuntes, et cognoverunt multi : et pedestres de omnibus civitatibus concurrerunt illuc, et prævenerunt eos.
text_pt: E a multidão viu-os partir, e muitos o conheceram; e correram para lá, a pé, de todas as cidades, e ali chegaram primeiro do que eles, e aproximavam-se dele.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον αὐτοὺς ὑπάγοντας καὶ ἔγνωσαν πολλοί, καὶ πεζῇ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν πόλεων συνέδραμον ἐκεῖ καὶ προῆλθον αὐτούς.

text_en: And Jesus going out saw a great multitude: and he had compassion on them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.
text_la: Et exiens vidit turbam multam Jesus : et misertus est super eos, quia erant sicut oves non habentes pastorem, et cœpit docere multa.
text_pt: E Jesus, saindo, viu uma grande multidão, e teve compaixão deles, porque eram como ovelhas que não têm pastor; e começou a ensinar-lhes muitas coisas.
text_el: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν εἶδεν πολὺν ὄχλον, καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη ἐπ' αὐτοὺς, ὅτι ἦσαν ὡς πρόβατα μὴ ἔχοντα ποιμένα, καὶ ἤρξατο διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς πολλά.

text_en: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came to him, saying: This is a desert place , and the hour is now past:
text_la: Et cum jam hora multa fieret, accesserunt discipuli ejus, dicentes : Desertus est locus hic, et jam hora præteriit:
text_pt: E, como o dia fosse já muito adiantado, os seus discípulos se aproximaram dele, e lhe disseram: O lugar é deserto, e o dia está já muito adiantado.
text_el: καὶ ἤδη ὥρας πολλῆς γενομένης προσελθόντες αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἔλεγον ὅτι ἔρημός ἐστιν ὁ τόπος, καὶ ἤδη ὥρα πολλή:

text_en: Send them away, that going into the next villages and towns, they may buy themselves meat to eat.
text_la: dimitte illos, ut euntes in proximas villas et vicos, emant sibi cibos, quos manducent.
text_pt: Despede-os, para que vão aos lugares e aldeias circunvizinhas, e comprem pão para si; porque não têm que comer.
text_el: ἀπόλυσον αὐτούς, ἵνα ἀπελθόντες εἰς τοὺς κύκλῳ ἀγροὺς καὶ κώμας ἀγοράσωσιν ἑαυτοῖς τί φάγωσιν.

text_en: And he answering said to them: Give you them to eat. And they said to him: Let us go and buy bread for two hundred pence, and we will give them to eat.
text_la: Et respondens ait illis : Date illis vos manducare. Et dixerunt ei : Euntes emamus ducentis denariis panes, et dabimus illis manducare.
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, lhes disse: Dai-lhes vós de comer. E eles disseram-lhe: Iremos nós, e compraremos duzentos dinheiros de pão para lhes darmos de comer?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: δότε αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς φαγεῖν. καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: ἀπελθόντες ἀγοράσωμεν δηναρίων διακοσίων ἄρτους, καὶ δώσομεν αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν;

text_en: And he says to them: How many loaves have you? Go and see. And when they knew , they say: Five, and two fishes.
text_la: Et dicit eis : Quot panes habetis? ite, et videte. Et cum cognovissent, dicunt : Quinque, et duos pisces.
text_pt: E ele disse-lhes: Quantos pães tendes? Ide ver. E, sabendo-o eles, disseram: Cinco pães e dois peixes.
text_el: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς: πόσους ἔχετε; ἄρτους ὑπάγετε ἴδετε. καὶ γνόντες λέγουσιν: πέντε, καὶ δύο ἰχθύας.

text_en: And he commanded them that they should make them all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
text_la: Et præcepit illis ut accumbere facerent omnes secundum contubernia super viride fœnum.
text_pt: E ordenou-lhes que fizessem assentar a todos, em ranchos, sobre a erva verde.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέταξεν αὐτοῖς ἀνακλιθήναι πάντας συμπόσια συμπόσια ἐπὶ τῷ χλωρῷ χόρτῳ.

text_en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
text_la: Et discubuerunt in partes per centenos et quinquagenos.
text_pt: E assentaram-se repartidos de cem em cem, e de cinqüenta em cinqüenta.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέπεσαν πρασιαὶ πρασιαὶ, κατὰ ἑκατὸν καὶ κατὰ πεντήκοντα.

text_en: And when he had taken the five loaves, and the two fishes: looking up to heaven , he blessed , and broke the loaves, and gave to his disciples to set before them: and the two fishes he divided among them all.
text_la: Et acceptis quinque panibus et duobus pisces, intuens in cælum, benedixit, et fregit panes, et dedit discipulis suis, ut ponerent ante eos : et duos pisces divisit omnibus.
text_pt: E, tomando ele os cinco pães e os dois peixes, levantou os olhos ao céu, abençoou e partiu os pães, e deu-os aos seus discípulos para que os pusessem diante deles. E repartiu os dois peixes por todos.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησεν, καὶ κατέκλασεν τοὺς ἄρτους καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἵνα παρατιθῶσιν αὐτοῖς, καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας ἐμέρισεν πᾶσιν.

text_en: And they all ate, and had their fill.
text_la: Et manducaverunt omnes, et saturati sunt.
text_pt: E todos comeram, e ficaram fartos;
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγον πάντες καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν:

text_en: And they took up the leavings, twelve full baskets of fragments, and of the fishes.
text_la: Et sustulerunt reliquias, fragmentorum duodecim cophinos plenos, et de piscibus.
text_pt: E levantaram doze alcofas cheias de pedaços de pão e de peixe.
text_el: καὶ ἦραν κλάσματα δώδεκα κοφίνων πληρώματα καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἰχθύων.

text_en: And they that ate, were five thousand men.
text_la: Erant autem qui manducaverunt quinque millia virorum.
text_pt: E os que comeram os pães eram quase cinco mil homens.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν οἱ φαγόντες τοὺς ἄρτους πεντακισχίλιοι ἄνδρες.

text_en: And immediately he obliged his disciples to go up into the ship, that they might go before him over the water to Bethsaida , whilst he dismissed the people.
text_la: Et statim coëgit discipulos suos ascendere navim, ut præcederent eum trans fretum ad Bethsaidam, dum ipse dimitteret populum.
text_pt: E logo obrigou os seus discípulos a subir para o barco, e passar adiante, para o outro lado, a Betsaida, enquanto ele despedia a multidão.
text_el: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἠνάγκασεν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἐμβῆναι εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ προάγειν εἰς τὸ πέραν πρὸς Βηθσαϊδάν, ἕως αὐτὸς ἀπολύει τὸν ὄχλον.

text_en: And when he had dismissed them, he went up to the mountain to pray ,
text_la: Et cum dimisisset eos, abiit in montem orare.
text_pt: E, tendo-os despedido, foi ao monte a orar.
text_el: καὶ ἀποταξάμενος αὐτοῖς ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος προσεύξασθαι.

text_en: and when it was late, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and himself alone on the land.
text_la: Et cum sero esset, erat navis in medio mari et ipse solus in terra.
text_pt: E, sobrevindo a tarde, estava o barco no meio do mar e ele, sozinho, em terra.
text_el: καὶ ὀψίας γενομένης ἦν τὸ πλοῖον ἐν μέσῳ τῆς θαλάσσης, καὶ αὐτὸς μόνος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And seeing them labouring in rowing, (for the wind was against them), and about the fourth watch of the night, he comes to them walking upon the sea, and he would have passed by them.
text_la: Et videns eos laborantes in remigando (erat enim ventus contrarius eis) et circa quartam vigiliam noctis venit ad eos ambulans supra mare: et volebat præterire eos.
text_pt: E vendo que se fatigavam a remar, porque o vento lhes era contrário, perto da quarta vigília da noite aproximou-se deles, andando sobre o mar, e queria passar-lhes adiante.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτοὺς βασανιζομένους ἐν τῷ ἐλαύνειν, ἦν γὰρ ὁ ἄνεμος ἐναντίος αὐτοῖς, περὶ τετάρτην φυλακὴν τῆς νυκτὸς ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτοὺς περιπατῶν ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης. καὶ ἤθελεν παρελθεῖν αὐτούς:

text_en: But they seeing him walking upon the sea, thought it was an apparition, and they cried out.
text_la: At illi ut viderunt eum ambulantem supra mare, putaverunt phantasma esse, et exclamaverunt.
text_pt: Mas, quando eles o viram andar sobre o mar, cuidaram que era um fantasma, e deram grandes gritos.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης περιπατοῦντα ἔδοξαν ὅτι φάντασμά ἐστιν, καὶ ἀνέκραξαν:

text_en: For they all saw him, and were troubled bled. And immediately he spoke with them, and said to them: Have a good heart, it is I, fear not.
text_la: Omnes enim viderunt eum, et conturbati sunt. Et statim locutus est cum eis, et dixit eis : Confidite, ego sum : nolite timere.
text_pt: Porque todos o viam, e perturbaram-se; mas logo falou com eles, e disse-lhes: Tende bom ânimo; sou eu, não temais.
text_el: πάντες γὰρ αὐτὸν εἶδον καὶ ἐταράχθησαν. ὁ δὲ εὐθὺς ἐλάλησεν μετ' αὐτῶν, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς, θαρσεῖτε, ἐγώ εἰμι, μὴ φοβεῖσθε.

text_en: And he went up to them into the ship, and the wind ceased: and they were far more astonished within themselves:
text_la: Et ascendit ad illos in navim, et cessavit ventus. Et plus magis intra se stupebant:
text_pt: E subiu para o barco, para estar com eles, e o vento se aquietou; e entre si ficaram muito assombrados e maravilhados;
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ ἐκόπασεν ὁ ἄνεμος: καὶ λίαν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἐξίσταντο.

text_en: For they understood not concerning the loaves; for their heart was blinded.
text_la: non enim intellexerunt de panibus : erat enim cor eorum obcæcatum.
text_pt: Pois não tinham compreendido o milagre dos pães; antes o seu coração estava endurecido.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ συνῆκαν ἐπὶ τοῖς ἄρτοις, ἀλλ' ἦν αὐτῶν ἡ καρδία πεπωρωμένη.

text_en: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Genezareth , and set to the shore.
text_la: Et cum transfretassent, venerunt in terram Genesareth, et applicuerunt.
text_pt: E, quando já estavam no outro lado, dirigiram-se à terra de Genesaré, e ali atracaram.
text_el: Καὶ διαπεράσαντες ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἦλθον εἰς Γεννησαρὲτ καὶ προσωρμίσθησαν.

text_en: And when they had gone out of the ship, immediately they knew him:
text_la: Cumque egressi essent de navi, continuo cognoverunt eum:
text_pt: E, saindo eles do barco, logo o conheceram;
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ πλοίου εὐθὺς ἐπιγνόντες αὐτὸν

text_en: And running through that whole country, they began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
text_la: et percurrentes universam regionem illam, cœperunt in grabatis eos, qui se male habebant, circumferre, ubi audiebant eum esse.
text_pt: E, correndo toda a terra em redor, começaram a trazer em leitos, aonde quer que sabiam que ele estava, os que se achavam enfermos.
text_el: περιέδραμον ὅλην τὴν χώραν ἐκείνην καὶ ἤρξαντο ἐπὶ τοῖς κραβάττοις τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας περιφέρειν, ὅπου ἤκουον ὅτι ἐστίν.

text_en: And wherever he entered, into towns or into villages or cities, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch but the hem of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
text_la: Et quocumque introibat, in vicos, vel in villas aut civitates, in plateis ponebant infirmos, et deprecabantur eum, ut vel fimbriam vestimenti ejus tangerent, et quotquot tangebant eum, salvi fiebant.
text_pt: E, onde quer que entrava, ou em cidade, ou aldeias, ou no campo, apresentavam os enfermos nas praças, e rogavam-lhe que os deixasse tocar ao menos na orla da sua roupa; e todos os que lhe tocavam saravam.
text_el: καὶ ὅπου ἂν εἰσεπορεύετο εἰς κώμας ἢ εἰς πόλεις ἢ εἰς ἀγροὺς, ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς ἐτίθεσαν τοὺς ἀσθενοῦντας, καὶ παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν ἵνα κἂν τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ ἅψωνται: καὶ ὅσοι ἂν ἥψαντο αὐτοῦ ἐσῴζοντο.

text_en: And there assembled together unto him the Pharisees and some of the scribes , coming from Jerusalem .
text_la: Et conveniunt ad eum pharisæi, et quidam de scribis, venientes ab Jerosolymis.
text_pt: E ajuntaram-se a ele os fariseus, e alguns dos escribas que tinham vindo de Jerusalém.
text_el: Καὶ συνάγονται πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καί τινες τῶν γραμματέων ἐλθόντες ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων.

text_en: And when they had seen some of his disciples eat bread with common, that is, with unwashed hands, they found fault.
text_la: Et cum vidissent quosdam ex discipulis ejus communibus manibus, id est non lotis, manducare panes, vituperaverunt.
text_pt: E, vendo que alguns dos seus discípulos comiam pão com as mãos impuras, isto é, por lavar, os repreendiam.
text_el: καὶ ἰδόντες τινὰς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ὅτι κοιναῖς χερσίν, τοῦτ' ἔστιν ἀνίπτοις, ἐσθίουσιν τοὺς ἄρτους

text_en: For the Pharisees and all the Jews eat not without often washing their hands , holding the tradition of the ancients.
text_la: Pharisæi enim, et omnes Judæi, nisi crebro laverint manus, non manducant, tenentes traditionem seniorum:
text_pt: Porque os fariseus, e todos os judeus, conservando a tradição dos antigos, não comem sem lavar as mãos muitas vezes;
text_el: οἱ γὰρ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ πάντες οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐὰν μὴ πυγμῇ νίψωνται τὰς χεῖρας οὐκ ἐσθίουσιν, κρατοῦντες τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν πρεσβυτέρων,

text_en: And when they come from the market, unless they be washed, they eat not: and many other things there are that have been delivered to them to observe, the washings of cups and of pots and of brazen vessels and of beds.
text_la: et a foro nisi baptizentur, non comedunt : et alia multa sunt, quæ tradita sunt illis servare, baptismata calicum, et urceorum, et æramentorum, et lectorum:
text_pt: E, quando voltam do mercado, se não se lavarem, não comem. E muitas outras coisas há que receberam para observar, como lavar os copos, e os jarros, e os vasos de metal e as camas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπ' ἀγορᾶς ἐὰν μὴ ῥαντίσωνται οὐκ ἐσθίουσιν, καὶ ἄλλα πολλά ἐστιν ἃ παρέλαβον κρατεῖν, βαπτισμοὺς ποτηρίων καὶ ξεστῶν καὶ χαλκίων

text_en: And the Pharisees and scribes asked him: Why do not your disciples walk according to the tradition of the ancients, but they eat bread with common hands?
text_la: et interrogabant eum pharisæi et scribæ : Quare discipuli tui non ambulant juxta traditionem seniorum, sed communibus manibus manducant panem?
text_pt: Depois perguntaram-lhe os fariseus e os escribas: Por que não andam os teus discípulos conforme a tradição dos antigos, mas comem o pão com as mãos por lavar?
text_el: καὶ ἐπερωτῶσιν αὐτὸν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς: διὰ τί οὐ περιπατοῦσιν οἱ μαθηταί σου κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, ἀλλὰ κοιναῖς χερσὶν ἐσθίουσιν τὸν ἄρτον;

text_en: But he answering, said to them: Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites , as it is written: This people honours me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
text_la: At ille respondens, dixit eis : Bene prophetavit Isaias de vobis hypocritis, sicut scriptum est : Populus hic labiis me honorat, cor autem eorum longe est a me :
text_pt: E ele, respondendo, disse-lhes: Bem profetizou Isaías acerca de vós, hipócritas, como está escrito:Este povo honra-me com os lábios,Mas o seu coração está longe de mim;
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: καλῶς ἐπροφήτευσεν Ἠσαΐας περὶ ὑμῶν τῶν ὑποκριτῶν, ὡς γέγραπται ὅτι οὗτος ὁ λαὸς τοῖς χείλεσίν με τιμᾷ, ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν πόρρω ἀπέχει ἀπ' ἐμοῦ:

text_en: And in vain do they worship me, teaching doctrines and precepts of men .
text_la: in vanum autem me colunt, docentes doctrinas, et præcepta hominum.
text_pt: Em vão, porém, me honram,Ensinando doutrinas que são mandamentos de homens.
text_el: μάτην δὲ σέβονταί με διδάσκοντες διδασκαλίας ἐντάλματα ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: For leaving the commandment of God , you hold the tradition of men , the washing of pots and of cups: and many other things you do like to these.
text_la: Relinquentes enim mandatum Dei, tenetis traditionem hominum, baptismata urceorum et calicum : et alia similia his facitis multa.
text_pt: Porque, deixando o mandamento de Deus, retendes a tradição dos homens; como o lavar dos jarros e dos copos; e fazeis muitas outras coisas semelhantes a estas.
text_el: ἀφέντες τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ θεοῦ κρατεῖτε τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: And he said to them: Well do you make void the commandment of God , that you may keep your own tradition.
text_la: Et dicebat illis : Bene irritum facitis præceptum Dei, ut traditionem vestram servetis.
text_pt: E dizia-lhes: Bem invalidais o mandamento de Deus para guardardes a vossa tradição.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: καλῶς ἀθετεῖτε τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα τὴν παράδοσιν ὑμῶν τηρήσητε.

text_en: For Moses said: Honour your father and your mother . And He that shall curse father or mother, dying let him die.
text_la: Moyses enim dixit : Honora patrem tuum, et matrem tuam. Et : Qui maledixerit patri, vel matri, morte moriatur.
text_pt: Porque Moisés disse: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe; e quem maldisser, ou o pai ou a mãe, certamente morrerá.
text_el: Μωϋσῆς γὰρ εἶπεν: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα σου, καί: ὁ κακολογῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα θανάτῳ τελευτάτω.

text_en: But you say: If a man shall say to his father or mother, Corban (which is a gift) whatsoever is from me shall profit you.
text_la: Vos autem dicitis : Si dixerit homo patri, aut matri, Corban (quod est donum) quodcumque ex me, tibi profuerit:
text_pt: Vós, porém, dizeis: Se um homem disser ao pai ou à mãe: Aquilo que poderias aproveitar de mim é Corbã, isto é, oferta ao Senhor;
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ λέγετε: ἐὰν εἴπῃ ἄνθρωπος τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί: Κορβᾶν, ὅ ἐστιν δῶρον, ὃ ἐὰν ἐξ ἐμοῦ ὠφεληθῇς,

text_en: And further you allow him not to do anything for his father or mother,
text_la: et ultra non dimittitis eum quidquam facere patri suo, aut matri,
text_pt: Nada mais lhe deixais fazer por seu pai ou por sua mãe,
text_el: οὐκέτι ἀφίετε αὐτὸν οὐδὲν ποιῆσαι τῷ πατρὶ ἢ τῇ μητρί,

text_en: making void the word of God by your own tradition, which you have given forth. And many other such like things you do.
text_la: rescindentes verbum Dei per traditionem vestram, quam tradidistis : et similia hujusmodi multa facitis.
text_pt: Invalidando assim a palavra de Deus pela vossa tradição, que vós ordenastes. E muitas coisas fazeis semelhantes a estas.
text_el: ἀκυροῦντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ τῇ παραδόσει ὑμῶν ᾗ παρεδώκατε. καὶ παρόμοια τοιαῦτα πολλὰ ποιεῖτε.

text_en: And calling again the multitude unto him, he said to them: Hear me all and understand.
text_la: Et advocans iterum turbam, dicebat illis : Audite me omnes, et intelligite.
text_pt: E, chamando outra vez a multidão, disse-lhes: Ouvi-me vós, todos, e compreendei.
text_el: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος πάλιν τὸν ὄχλον ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: ἀκούσατέ μου πάντες καὶ σύνετε.

text_en: There is nothing from without a man that entering into him can defile him. But the things which come from a man , those are they that defile a man .
text_la: Nihil est extra hominem introiens in eum, quod possit eum coinquinare, sed quæ de homine procedunt illa sunt quæ communicant hominem.
text_pt: Nada há, fora do homem, que, entrando nele, o possa contaminar; mas o que sai dele isso é que contamina o homem.
text_el: οὐδέν ἐστιν ἔξωθεν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰσπορευόμενον εἰς αὐτὸν ὃ δύναται κοινῶσαι αὐτόν: ἀλλὰ τὰ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκπορευόμενά ἐστιν τὰ κοινοῦντα τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

text_en: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
text_la: Si quis habet aures audiendi, audiat.
text_pt: Se alguém tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.

text_en: And when he had come into the house from the multitude, his disciples asked him the parable .
text_la: Et cum introisset in domum a turba, interrogabant eum discipuli ejus parabolam.
text_pt: Depois, quando deixou a multidão, e entrou em casa, os seus discípulos o interrogavam acerca desta parábola.
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς οἶκον ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου, ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν παραβολήν.

text_en: And he says to them: So are you also without knowledge ? Understand you not that everything from without entering into a man cannot defile him:
text_la: Et ait illis : Sic et vos imprudentes estis? Non intelligitis quia omne extrinsecus introiens in hominem, non potest eum communicare:
text_pt: E ele disse-lhes: Assim também vós estais sem entendimento? Não compreendeis que tudo o que de fora entra no homem não o pode contaminar,
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀσύνετοί ἐστε; οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἔξωθεν εἰσπορευόμενον εἰς τὸν ἄνθρωπον οὐ δύναται αὐτὸν κοινῶσαι,

text_en: Because it enters not into his heart but goes into his belly and goes out into the privy, purging all meats?
text_la: quia non intrat in cor ejus, sed in ventrum vadit, et in secessum exit, purgans omnes escas?
text_pt: Porque não entra no seu coração, mas no ventre, e é lançado fora, ficando puras todas as comidas?
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ εἰσπορεύεται αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ἀλλ' εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν, καὶ εἰς τὸν ἀφεδρῶνα ἐκπορεύεται, καθαρίζων πάντα τὰ βρώματα;

text_en: But he said that the things which come out from a man , they defile a man .
text_la: Dicebat autem, quoniam quæ de homine exeunt, illa communicant hominem.
text_pt: E dizia: O que sai do homem isso contamina o homem.
text_el: ἔλεγεν δὲ ὅτι τὸ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκπορευόμενον, ἐκεῖνο κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

text_en: For from within, out of the heart of men , proceed evil thoughts, adulteries , fornications, murders ,
text_la: Ab intus enim de corde hominum malæ cogitationes procedunt, adulteria, fornicationes, homicidia,
text_pt: Porque do interior do coração dos homens saem os maus pensamentos, os adultérios, as fornicações, os homicídios,
text_el: ἔσωθεν γὰρ ἐκ τῆς καρδίας τῶν ἀνθρώπων οἱ διαλογισμοὶ οἱ κακοὶ ἐκπορεύονται, πορνεῖαι, κλοπαί, φόνοι,

text_en: thefts, covetousness , wickedness , deceit , lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy , pride , foolishness.
text_la: furta, avaritiæ, nequitiæ, dolus, impudicitiæ, oculus malus, blasphemia, superbia, stultitia.
text_pt: Os furtos, a avareza, as maldades, o engano, a dissolução, a inveja, a blasfêmia, a soberba, a loucura.
text_el: μοιχεῖαι, πλεονεξίαι, πονηρίαι, δόλος, ἀσέλγεια, ὀφθαλμὸς πονηρός, βλασφημία, ὑπερηφανία, ἀφροσύνη:

text_en: All these evil things come from within and defile a man .
text_la: Omnia hæc mala ab intus procedunt, et communicant hominem.
text_pt: Todos estes males procedem de dentro e contaminam o homem.
text_el: πάντα ταῦτα τὰ πονηρὰ ἔσωθεν ἐκπορεύεται καὶ κοινοῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον.

text_en: And rising from thence he went into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon : and entering into a house, he would that no man should know it. And he could not be hid.
text_la: Et inde surgens abiit in fines Tyri et Sidonis : et ingressus domum, neminem voluit scire, et non potuit latere.
text_pt: E, levantando-se dali, foi para os termos de Tiro e de Sidom. E, entrando numa casa, não queria que alguém o soubesse, mas não pôde esconder-se;
text_el: Ἐκεῖθεν δὲ ἀναστὰς ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια Τύρου. [καὶ Σιδῶνος]. καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς οἰκίαν οὐδένα ἤθελεν γνῶναι, καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθη λαθεῖν:

text_en: For a woman as soon as she heard of him, whose daughter had an unclean spirit , came in and fell down at his feet.
text_la: Mulier enim statim ut audivit de eo, cujus filia habebat spiritum immundum, intravit, et procidit ad pedes ejus.
text_pt: Porque uma mulher, cuja filha tinha um espírito imundo, ouvindo falar dele, foi e lançou-se aos seus pés.
text_el: ἀλλ' εὐθὺς ἀκούσασα γυνὴ περὶ αὐτοῦ, ἧς εἶχεν τὸ θυγάτριον αὐτῆς πνεῦμα ἀκάθαρτον, ἐλθοῦσα προσέπεσεν πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ:

text_en: For the woman was a Gentile , a Syrophenician born. And she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
text_la: Erat enim mulier gentilis, Syrophœnissa genere. Et rogabat eum ut dæmonium ejiceret de filia ejus.
text_pt: E esta mulher era grega, siro-fenícia de nação, e rogava-lhe que expulsasse de sua filha o demônio.
text_el: ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἦν Ἑλληνίς, Συροφοινίκισσα τῷ γένει: καὶ ἠρώτα αὐτὸν ἵνα τὸ δαιμόνιον ἐκβάλῃ ἐκ τῆς θυγατρὸς αὐτῆς.

text_en: Who said to her: Suffer first the children to be filled: for it is not good to take the bread of the children and cast it to the dogs.
text_la: Qui dixit illi : Sine prius saturari filios : non est enim bonum sumere panem filiorum, et mittere canibus.
text_pt: Mas Jesus disse-lhe: Deixa primeiro saciar os filhos; porque não convém tomar o pão dos filhos e lançá-lo aos cachorrinhos.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτῇ: ἄφες πρῶτον χορτασθῆναι τὰ τέκνα: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν καλὸν λαβεῖν τὸν ἄρτον τῶν τέκνων καὶ τοῖς κυναρίοις βαλεῖν.

text_en: But she answered and said to him: Yea, Lord; for the whelps also eat under the table of the crumbs of the children.
text_la: At illa respondit, et dixit illi : Utique Domine, nam et catelli comedunt sub mensa de micis puerorum.
text_pt: Ela, porém, respondeu, e disse-lhe: Sim, Senhor; mas também os cachorrinhos comem, debaixo da mesa, as migalhas dos filhos.
text_el: ἡ δὲ ἀπεκρίθη καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ, ναί Κύριε: καὶ τὰ κυνάρια ὑποκάτω τῆς τραπέζης ἐσθίουσιν ἀπὸ τῶν ψιχίων τῶν παιδίων.

text_en: And he said to her: For this saying, go your way. The devil has gone out of your daughter.
text_la: Et ait illi : Propter hunc sermonem vade : exiit dæmonium a filia tua.
text_pt: Então ele disse-lhe: Por essa palavra, vai; o demônio já saiu de tua filha.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ: διὰ τοῦτον τὸν λόγον ὕπαγε, ἐξελήλυθεν ἐκ τῆς θυγατρός σου τὸ δαιμόνιον.

text_en: And when she had come into her house, she found the girl lying upon the bed and that the devil had gone out.
text_la: Et cum abiisset domum suam, invenit puellam jacentem supra lectum, et dæmonium exiisse.
text_pt: E, indo ela para sua casa, achou a filha deitada sobre a cama, e que o demônio já tinha saído.
text_el: καὶ ἀπελθοῦσα εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς εὗρεν τὸ παιδίον βεβλημένον ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην καὶ τὸ δαιμόνιον ἐξεληλυθός.

text_en: And again going out of the coasts of Tyre , he came by Sidon to the sea of Galilee , through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis .
text_la: Et iterum exiens de finibus Tyri, venit per Sidonem ad mare Galilææ inter medios fines Decapoleos.
text_pt: E ele, tornando a sair dos termos de Tiro e de Sidom, foi até ao mar da Galiléia, pelos confins de Decápolis.
text_el: Καὶ πάλιν ἐξελθὼν ἐκ τῶν ὁρίων Τύρου ἦλθεν διὰ Σιδῶνος εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὁρίων Δεκαπόλεως.

text_en: And they bring to him one deaf and dumb: and they besought him that he would lay his hand upon him.
text_la: Et adducunt ei surdum, et mutum, et deprecabantur eum, ut imponat illi manum.
text_pt: E trouxeram-lhe um surdo, que falava dificilmente; e rogaram-lhe que pusesse a mão sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτῷ κωφὸν καὶ μογιλάλον, καὶ παρακαλοῦσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα ἐπιθῇ αὐτῷ τὴν χεῖρα.

text_en: And taking him from the multitude apart, he put his fingers into his ears: and spitting, he touched his tongue.
text_la: Et apprehendens eum de turba seorsum, misit digitos suos in auriculas ejus : et exspuens, tetigit linguam ejus:
text_pt: E, tirando-o à parte, de entre a multidão, pôs-lhe os dedos nos ouvidos; e, cuspindo, tocou-lhe na língua.
text_el: καὶ ἀπολαβόμενος αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου κατ' ἰδίαν ἔβαλεν τοὺς δακτύλους αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰ ὦτα αὐτοῦ καὶ πτύσας ἥψατο τῆς γλώσσης αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And looking up to heaven , he groaned and said to him: Ephpheta, which is, Be opened.
text_la: et suscipiens in cælum, ingemuit, et ait illi : Ephphetha, quod est, Adaperire.
text_pt: E, levantando os olhos ao céu, suspirou, e disse: Efatá; isto é, Abre-te.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἐστέναξεν, καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: εφφαθα, ὅ ἐστιν, διανοίχθητι.

text_en: And immediately his ears were opened and the string of his tongue was loosed and he spoke right.
text_la: Et statim apertæ sunt aures ejus, et solutum est vinculum linguæ ejus, et loquebatur recte.
text_pt: E logo se abriram os seus ouvidos, e a prisão da língua se desfez, e falava perfeitamente.
text_el: καὶ ἠνοίγησαν αὐτοῦ αἱ, ἀκοαί καὶ ἐλύθη ὁ δεσμὸς τῆς γλώσσης αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλει ὀρθῶς.

text_en: And he charged them that they should tell no man . But the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal did they publish it.
text_la: Et præcepit illis ne cui dicerent. Quanto autem eis præcipiebat, tanto magis plus prædicabant:
text_pt: E ordenou-lhes que a ninguém o dissessem; mas, quanto mais lhos proibia, tanto mais o divulgavam.
text_el: καὶ διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ λέγωσιν: ὅσον δὲ αὐτοῖς διεστέλλετο, αὐτοὶ μᾶλλον περισσότερον ἐκήρυσσον.

text_en: And so much the more did they wonder, saying: He has done all things well. He has made both the deaf to hear and the dumb to speak.
text_la: et eo amplius admirabantur, dicentes : Bene omnia fecit : et surdos fecit audire, et mutos loqui.
text_pt: E, admirando-se sobremaneira, diziam: Tudo faz bem; faz ouvir os surdos e falar os mudos.
text_el: καὶ ὑπερπερισσῶς ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες: καλῶς πάντα πεποίηκεν, καὶ τοὺς κωφοὺς ποιεῖ ἀκούειν καὶ ἀλάλους λαλεῖν.

text_en: In those days again, when there was great multitude and they had nothing to eat; calling his disciples together, he says to them:
text_la: In diebus illis iterum cum turba multa esset, nec haberent quod manducarent, convocatis discipulis, ait illis:
text_pt: Naqueles dias, havendo uma grande multidão, e não tendo o que comer, Jesus chamou a si os seus discípulos, e disse-lhes:
text_el: Ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις πάλιν πολλοῦ ὄχλου ὄντος καὶ μὴ ἐχόντων τί φάγωσιν, προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς μαθητὰς λέγει αὐτοῖς:

text_en: I have compassion on the multitude, for behold they have now been with me three days and have nothing to eat.
text_la: Misereor super turbam : quia ecce jam triduo sustinent me, nec habent quod manducent:
text_pt: Tenho compaixão da multidão, porque há já três dias que estão comigo, e não têm o que comer.
text_el: σπλαγχνίζομαι ἐπὶ τὸν ὄχλον, ὅτι ἤδη ἡμέραι τρεῖς προσμένουσίν μοι καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν τί φάγωσιν.

text_en: And if I shall send them away fasting to their home, they will faint in the way: for some of them came from afar off.
text_la: et si dimisero eos jejunos in domum suam, deficient in via : quidam enim ex eis de longe venerunt.
text_pt: E, se os deixar ir em jejum, para suas casas, desfalecerão no caminho, porque alguns deles vieram de longe.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἀπολύσω αὐτοὺς νήστεις εἰς οἶκον αὐτῶν, ἐκλυθήσονται ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ: καί τινες αὐτῶν ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ε{I0}σίν.

text_en: And his disciples answered him: From whence can any one fill them here with bread in the wilderness ?
text_la: Et responderunt ei discipuli sui : Unde illos quis poterit saturare panibus in solitudine?
text_pt: E os seus discípulos responderam-lhe: De onde poderá alguém satisfazê-los de pão aqui no deserto?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι πόθεν τούτους δυνήσεταί τις ὧδε χορτάσαι ἄρτων ἐπ' ἐρημίας;

text_en: And he asked them: How many loaves do you have? Who said: Seven.
text_la: Et interrogavit eos : Quot panes habetis? Qui dixerunt : Septem.
text_pt: E perguntou-lhes: Quantos pães tendes? E disseram-lhe: Sete.
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτα αὐτούς: πόσους ἔχετε ἄρτους; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: ἑπτά.

text_en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground. And taking the seven loaves, giving thanks, he broke and gave to his disciples for to set before them. And they set them before the people.
text_la: Et præcepit turbæ discumbere super terram. Et accipiens septem panes, gratias agens fregit, et dabat discipulis suis ut apponerent, et apposuerunt turbæ.
text_pt: E ordenou à multidão que se assentasse no chão. E, tomando os sete pães, e tendo dado graças, partiu-os, e deu-os aos seus discípulos, para que os pusessem diante deles, e puseram-nos diante da multidão.
text_el: καὶ παραγγέλλει τῷ ὄχλῳ ἀναπεσεῖν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς: καὶ λαβὼν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ἵνα παρατιθῶσιν: καὶ παρέθηκαν τῷ ὄχλῳ.

text_en: And they had a few little fishes: and he blessed them and commanded them to be set before them.
text_la: Et habebant pisciculos paucos : et ipsos benedixit, et jussit apponi.
text_pt: Tinham também alguns peixinhos; e, tendo dado graças, ordenou que também lhos pusessem diante.
text_el: καὶ εἶχον ἰχθύδια ὀλίγα: καὶ εὐλογήσας αὐτὰ εἶπεν καὶ ταῦτα παρατιθέναι.

text_en: And they ate and were filled: and they took up that which was left of the fragments, seven baskets.
text_la: Et manducaverunt, et saturati sunt, et sustulerunt quod superaverat de fragmentis, septem sportas.
text_pt: E comeram, e saciaram-se; e dos pedaços que sobejaram levantaram sete cestos.
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν, καὶ ἦραν περισσεύματα κλασμάτων ἑπτὰ σπυρίδας.

text_en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand. And he sent them away.
text_la: Erant autem qui manducaverunt, quasi quatuor millia : et dimisit eos.
text_pt: E os que comeram eram quase quatro mil; e despediu-os.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ ὡς τετρακισχίλιοι: καὶ ἀπέλυσεν αὐτούς.

text_en: And immediately going up into a ship with his disciples , he came into the parts of Dalmanutha .
text_la: Et statim ascendens navim cum discipulis suis, venit in partes Dalmanutha.
text_pt: E, entrando logo no barco, com os seus discípulos, foi para as partes de Dalmanuta.
text_el: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐμβὰς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ μέρη Δαλμανουθά.

text_en: And the Pharisees came forth and began to question with him, asking him a sign from heaven , tempting him.
text_la: Et exierunt pharisæi, et cœperunt conquirere cum eo, quærentes ab illo signum de cælo, tentantes eum.
text_pt: E saíram os fariseus, e começaram a disputar com ele, pedindolhe, para o tentarem, um sinal do céu.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ ἤρξαντο συζητεῖν αὐτῷ, ζητοῦντες παρ' αὐτοῦ σημεῖον ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, πειράζοντες αὐτόν.

text_en: And sighing deeply in spirit, he says: Why does this generation seek a sign? Amen , I say to you, a sign shall not be given to this generation .
text_la: Et ingemiscens spiritu, ait : Quid generatio ista signum quærit? Amen dico vobis, si dabitur generationi isti signum.
text_pt: E, suspirando profundamente em seu espírito, disse: Por que pede esta geração um sinal? Em verdade vos digo que a esta geração não se dará sinal algum.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστενάξας τῷ πνεύματι αὐτοῦ λέγει: τί ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ζητεῖ σημεῖον; ἀμὴν λέγω εἰ δοθήσεται τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ σημεῖον.

text_en: And leaving them, he went up again into the ship and passed to the other side of the water.
text_la: Et dimittens eos, ascendit iterum navim et abiit trans fretum.
text_pt: E, deixando-os, tornou a entrar no barco, e foi para o outro lado.
text_el: καὶ ἀφεὶς αὐτοὺς πάλιν ἐμβὰς ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸ πέραν.

text_en: And they forgot to take bread: and they had but one loaf with them in the ship.
text_la: Et obliti sunt panes sumere : et nisi unum panem non habebant secum in navi.
text_pt: E eles se esqueceram de levar pão e, no barco, não tinham consigo senão um pão.
text_el: Καὶ ἐπελάθοντο λαβεῖν ἄρτους, καὶ εἰ μὴ ἕνα ἄρτον οὐκ εἶχον μεθ' ἑαυτῶν ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ.

text_en: And he charged them saying: Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the leaven of Herod .
text_la: Et præcipiebat eis, dicens : Videte, et cavete a fermento pharisæorum, et fermento Herodis.
text_pt: E ordenou-lhes, dizendo: Olhai, guardai-vos do fermento dos fariseus e do fermento de Herodes.
text_el: καὶ διεστέλλετο αὐτοῖς λέγων: ὁρᾶτε, βλέπετε ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ τῆς ζύμης Ἡρῴδου.

text_en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying: Because we have no bread.
text_la: Et cogitabant ad alterutrum, dicentes : quia panes non habemus.
text_pt: E arrazoavam entre si, dizendo: É porque não temos pão.
text_el: καὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἀλλήλους ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ἔχουσιν.

text_en: Which Jesus knowing , says to them: Why do you reason, because you have no bread? Do you not yet know nor understand? Have you still your heart blinded?
text_la: Quo cognito, ait illis Jesus : Quid cogitatis, quia panes non habetis? nondum cognoscetis nec intelligitis? adhuc cæcatum habetis cor vestrum?
text_pt: E Jesus, conhecendo isto, disse-lhes: Para que arrazoais, que não tendes pão? não considerastes, nem compreendestes ainda? tendes ainda o vosso coração endurecido?
text_el: καὶ γνοὺς λέγει αὐτοῖς: τί διαλογίζεσθε ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ἔχετε; οὔπω νοεῖτε οὐδὲ συνίετε; πεπωρωμένην ἔχετε τὴν καρδίαν ὑμῶν;

text_en: Having eyes, see you not? And having ears, hear you not? Neither do you remember?
text_la: oculos habentes non videtis? et aures habentes non auditis? nec recordamini,
text_pt: Tendo olhos, não vedes? e tendo ouvidos, não ouvis? e não vos lembrais,
text_el: ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντες οὐ βλέπετε, καὶ ὦτα ἔχοντες οὐκ ἀκούετε, καὶ οὐ μνημονεύετε,

text_en: When I broke the five loves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took you up? They say to him: Twelve.
text_la: quando quinque panes fregi in quinque millia : quot cophinos fragmentorum plenos sustulistis? Dicunt ei : Duodecim.
text_pt: Quando parti os cinco pães entre os cinco mil, quantas alcofas cheias de pedaços levantastes? Disseram-lhe: Doze.
text_el: ὅτε τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους ἔκλασα εἰς τοὺς πεντακισχιλίους, πόσους κοφίνους κλασμάτων πλήρεις ἤρατε; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: δώδεκα.

text_en: When also the seven loaves among four thousand, how many baskets of fragments took you up? And they say to him: Seven.
text_la: Quando et septem panes in quatuor millia : quot sportas fragmentorum tulistis? Et dicunt ei : Septem.
text_pt: E, quando parti os sete entre os quatro mil, quantos cestos cheios de pedaços levantastes? E disseram-lhe: Sete.
text_el: ὅτε τοὺς ἑπτὰ εἰς τοὺς τετρακισχιλίους πόσων, σπυρίδων πληρώματα κλασμάτων ἤρατε καὶ; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: ἑπτά.

text_en: And he said to them: How do you not yet understand?
text_la: Et dicebat eis : Quomodo nondum intelligitis?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Como não entendeis ainda?
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: οὔπω συνίετε;

text_en: And they came to Bethsaida : and they bring to him a blind man . And they besought him that he would touch him.
text_la: Et veniunt Bethsaidam, et adducunt ei cæcum, et rogabant eum ut illum tangeret.
text_pt: E chegou a Betsaida; e trouxeram-lhe um cego, e rogaram-lhe que o tocasse.
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Βηθσαϊδάν. καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτῷ τυφλὸν, καὶ παρακαλοῦσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα αὐτοῦ ἅψηται.

text_en: And taking the blind man by the hand, he led him out of the town. And spitting upon his eyes, laying his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
text_la: Et apprehensa manu cæci, eduxit eum extra vicum : et exspuens in oculos ejus impositis manibus suis, interrogavit eum si quid videret.
text_pt: E, tomando o cego pela mão, levou-o para fora da aldeia; e, cuspindo-lhe nos olhos, e impondo-lhe as mãos, perguntou-lhe se via alguma coisa.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενος τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ τυφλοῦ ἐξήνεγκεν αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς κώμης, καὶ πτύσας εἰς τὰ ὄμματα αὐτοῦ, ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῷ, ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν, εἴ τι βλέπεις;

text_en: And looking up, he said: I see men , as it were trees, walking.
text_la: Et aspiciens, ait : Video homines velut arbores ambulantes.
text_pt: E, levantando ele os olhos, disse: Vejo os homens; pois os vejo como árvores que andam.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβλέψας ἔλεγεν: βλέπω τοὺς ἀνθρώπους, ὅτι ὡς δένδρα ὁρῶ περιπατοῦντας.

text_en: After that again he laid his hands upon his eyes: and he began to see and was restored, so that he saw all things clearly.
text_la: Deinde iterum imposuit manus super oculos ejus : et cœpit videre : et restitutus est ita ut clare videret omnia.
text_pt: Depois disto, tornou a pôr-lhe as mãos sobre os olhos, e o fez olhar para cima: e ele ficou restaurado, e viu a todos claramente.
text_el: εἶτα πάλιν ἔθηκεν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ διέβλεψεν, καὶ ἀπεκατέστη, καὶ ἐνέβλεπεν τηλαυγῶς ἅπαντα.

text_en: And he sent him into his house, saying: Go into your house, and if you enter into the town, tell nobody.
text_la: Et misit illum in domum suam, dicens : Vade in domum tuam : et si in vicum introieris, nemini dixeris.
text_pt: E mandou-o para sua casa, dizendo: Nem entres na aldeia, nem o digas a ninguém na aldeia.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκον αὐτοῦ λέγων: μηδὲ εἰς τὴν κώμην εἰσέλθῃς.

text_en: And Jesus went out, and his disciples into the towns of Caesarea Philippi . And in the way, he asked his disciples , saying to them: Whom do men say that I am?
text_la: Et egressus est Jesus, et discipuli ejus in castella Cæsareæ Philippi : et in via interrogabat discipulos suos, dicens eis : Quem me dicunt esse homines?
text_pt: E saiu Jesus, e os seus discípulos, para as aldeias de Cesaréia de Filipe; e no caminho perguntou aos seus discípulos, dizendo: Quem dizem os homens que eu sou?
text_el: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς κώμας Καισαρείας τῆς Φιλίππου: καὶ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐπηρώτα τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ λέγων αὐτοῖς: τίνα με λέγουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι εἶναι;

text_en: Who answered him, saying: John the Baptist ; but some Elias , and others as one of the prophets .
text_la: Qui responderunt illi, dicentes : Joannem Baptistam, alii Eliam, alii vero quasi unum de prophetis.
text_pt: E eles responderam: João o Batista; e outros: Elias; mas outros: Um dos profetas.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι Ἰωάννην τὸν βαπτιστήν, καὶ ἄλλοι, Ἠλίαν, ἄλλοι δὲ ὅτι εἷς τῶν προφητῶν.

text_en: Then he says to them: But whom do you say that I am? Peter answering said to him: You are the Christ .
text_la: Tunc dicit illis : Vos vero quem me esse dicitis? Respondens Petrus, ait ei : Tu es Christus.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Mas vós, quem dizeis que eu sou? E, respondendo Pedro, lhe disse: Tu és o Cristo.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπηρώτα αὐτούς: ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι; ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος λέγει αὐτῷ: σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός.

text_en: And he strictly charged them that they should not tell any man of him.
text_la: Et comminatus est eis, ne cui dicerent de illo.
text_pt: E admoestou-os, para que a ninguém dissessem aquilo dele.
text_el: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ λέγωσιν περὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he began to teach them that the Son of man must suffer many things and be rejected by the ancients and by the high priests and the scribes : and be killed and after three days rise again .
text_la: Et cœpit docere eos quoniam oportet Filium hominis pati multa, et reprobari a senioribus, et a summis sacerdotibus et scribis, et occidi : et post tres dies resurgere.
text_pt: E começou a ensinar-lhes que importava que o Filho do homem padecesse muito, e que fosse rejeitado pelos anciãos e príncipes dos sacerdotes, e pelos escribas, e que fosse morto, mas que depois de três dias ressuscitaria.
text_el: Καὶ ἤρξατο διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς ὅτι δεῖ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πολλὰ παθεῖν, καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ὑπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστῆναι.

text_en: And he spoke the word openly. And Peter taking him began to rebuke him.
text_la: Et palam verbum loquebatur. Et apprehendens eum Petrus, cœpit increpare eum.
text_pt: E dizia abertamente estas palavras. E Pedro o tomou à parte, e começou a repreendê-lo.
text_el: καὶ παρρησίᾳ τὸν λόγον ἐλάλει. καὶ προσλαβόμενος ὁ Πέτρος αὐτὸν ἤρξατο ἐπιτιμᾶν αὐτῷ.

text_en: Who turning about and seeing his disciples , threatened Peter , saying: Go behind me, Satan , because you savour not the things that are of God but that are of men .
text_la: Qui conversus, et videns discipulos suos, comminatus est Petro, dicens : Vade retro me Satana, quoniam non sapis quæ Dei sunt, sed quæ sunt hominum.
text_pt: Mas ele, virando-se, e olhando para os seus discípulos, repreendeu a Pedro, dizendo: Retira-te de diante de mim, Satanás; porque não compreendes as coisas que são de Deus, mas as que são dos homens.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐπιστραφεὶς καὶ ἰδὼν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἐπετίμησεν Πέτρῳ καὶ λέγει: ὕπαγε ὀπίσω μου, Σατανᾶ, ὅτι οὐ φρονεῖς τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: And calling the multitude together with his disciples , he said to them: If any man will follow me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.
text_la: Et convocata turba cum discipulis suis, dixit eis : Si quis vult me sequi, deneget semetipsum : et tollat crucem suam, et sequatur me.
text_pt: E chamando a si a multidão, com os seus discípulos, disse-lhes: Se alguém quiser vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, e tome a sua cruz, e siga-me.
text_el: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν ὄχλον σὺν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἐλθεῖν, ἀπαρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι.

text_en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel shall save it.
text_la: Qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere, perdet eam : qui autem perdiderit animam suam propter me, et Evangelium, salvam faciet eam.
text_pt: Porque qualquer que quiser salvar a sua vida, perdê-la-á, mas, qualquer que perder a sua vida por amor de mim e do evangelho, esse a salvará.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν θέλῃ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχὴν σῶσαι, ἀπολέσει αὐτήν: ὃς δ' ἂν ἀπολέσει τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν [ἐμοῦ καὶ] τοῦ εὐαγγελίου, σώσει αὐτήν.

text_en: For what shall it profit a man , if he gain the whole world and suffer the loss of his soul ?
text_la: Quid enim proderit homini, si lucretur mundum totum et detrimentum animæ suæ faciat?
text_pt: Pois, que aproveitaria ao homem ganhar todo o mundo e perder a sua alma?
text_el: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖ ἄνθρωπον κερδῆσαι τὸν κόσμον ὅλον καὶ ζημιωθῆναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ;

text_en: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul :
text_la: Aut quid dabit homo commutationis pro anima sua?
text_pt: Ou, que daria o homem pelo resgate da sua alma?
text_el: τί γὰρ δοῖ ἄνθρωπος ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ;

text_en: For he that shall be ashamed of me and of my words, in this adulterous and sinful generation : the Son of man also will be ashamed of him, when he shall come in the glory of his Father with the holy angels .
text_la: Qui enim me confusus fuerit, et verba mea in generatione ista adultera et peccatrice, et Filius hominis confundetur eum, cum venerit in gloria Patris sui cum angelis sanctis.
text_pt: Porquanto, qualquer que, entre esta geração adúltera e pecadora, se envergonhar de mim e das minhas palavras, também o Filho do homem se envergonhará dele, quando vier na glória de seu Pai, com os santos anjos.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν ἐπαισχυνθῇ με καὶ τοὺς ἐμοὺς λόγους ἐν τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ τῇ μοιχαλίδι καὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπαισχυνθήσεται αὐτὸν, ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀγγέλων τῶν ἁγίων.

text_en: And he said to them: Amen I say to you that there are some of them that stand here who shall not taste death till they see the kingdom of God coming in power.
text_la: Et dicebat illis : Amen dico vobis, quia sunt quidam de hic stantibus, qui non gustabunt mortem donec videant regnum Dei veniens in virtute.

text_en: And after six days, Jesus takes with him Peter and James and John , and leads them up into an high mountain apart by themselves, and was transfigured before them.
text_la: Et post dies sex assumit Jesus Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem, et ducit illos in montem excelsum seorsum solos, et transfiguratus est coram ipsis.
text_pt: Dizia-lhes também: Em verdade vos digo que, dos que aqui estão, alguns há que não provarão a morte sem que vejam chegado o reino de Deus com poder.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰσίν τινες ὧδε τῶν ἑστηκότων οἵτινες οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐληλυθυῖαν ἐν δυνάμει.

text_en: And his garments became shining and exceeding white as snow, so as no fuller upon earth can make white.
text_la: Et vestimenta ejus facta sunt splendentia, et candida nimis velut nix, qualia fullo non potest super terram candida facere.
text_pt: E seis dias depois Jesus tomou consigo a Pedro, a Tiago, e a João, e os levou sós, em particular, a um alto monte; e transfigurou-se diante deles;
text_el: Καὶ μετὰ ἡμέρας ἓξ παραλαμβάνει ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάννην, καὶ ἀναφέρει αὐτοὺς εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν κατ' ἰδίαν μόνους, καὶ μετεμορφώθη ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν,

text_en: And there appeared to them Elias with Moses : and they were talking with Jesus .
text_la: Et apparuit illis Elias cum Moyse : et erant loquentes cum Jesu.
text_pt: E as suas vestes tornaram- se resplandecentes, extremamente brancas como a neve, tais como nenhum lavadeiro sobre a terra as poderia branquear.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο στίλβοντα λευκὰ λίαν, οἷα γναφεὺς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐ δύναται οὕτως λευκᾶναι.

text_en: And Peter answering, said to Jesus : Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. And let us make three tabernacles, one for you, and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
text_la: Et respondens Petrus, ait Jesu : Rabbi, bonum est nos hic esse : et faciamus tria tabernacula, tibi unum, et Moysi unum, et Eliæ unum.
text_pt: E apareceu-lhes Elias, com Moisés, e falavam com Jesus.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς Ἠλίας σὺν Μωϋσεῖ, καὶ ἦσαν συλλαλοῦντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: For he knew not what he said: for they were struck with fear.
text_la: Non enim sciebat quid diceret : erant enim timore exterriti.
text_pt: E Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse a Jesus: Mestre, é bom que estejamos aqui; e façamos três cabanas, uma para ti, outra para Moisés, e outra para Elias.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ: ῥαββί, καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι, καὶ ποιήσωμεν τρεῖς σκηνάς, σοὶ μίαν καὶ Μωϋσεῖ μίαν καὶ Ἠλίᾳ μίαν.

text_en: And there was a cloud overshadowing them. And a voice came out of the cloud, saying: This is my most beloved Son. Hear him.
text_la: Et facta est nubes obumbrans eos : et venit vox de nube, dicens : Hic est Filius meus carissimus : audite illum.
text_pt: Pois não sabia o que dizia, porque estavam assombrados.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ᾔδει τί ἀποκριθῇ: ἔκφοβοι γὰρ ἐγένοντο.

text_en: And immediately looking about, they saw no man any more, but Jesus only with them.
text_la: Et statim circumspicientes, neminem amplius viderunt, nisi Jesum tantum secum.
text_pt: E desceu uma nuvem que os cobriu com a sua sombra, e saiu da nuvem uma voz que dizia: Este é o meu filho amado; a ele ouvi.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο νεφέλη ἐπισκιάζουσα αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐγένετο φωνὴ ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἀκούετε αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them not to tell any man what things they had seen, till the Son of man shall be risen again from the dead .
text_la: Et descendentibus illis de monte, præcepit illis ne cuiquam quæ vidissent, narrarent : nisi cum Filius hominis a mortuis resurrexerit.
text_pt: E, tendo olhado em redor, ninguém mais viram, senão só Jesus com eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐξάπινα περιβλεψάμενοι οὐκέτι οὐδένα εἶδον μεθ' ἑαυτῶν εἰ μὴ τὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον.

text_en: And they kept the word to themselves; questioning together what that should mean, when he shall be risen from the dead.
text_la: Et verbum continuerunt apud se : conquirentes quid esset, cum a mortuis resurrexerit.
text_pt: E, descendo eles do monte, ordenou-lhes que a ninguém contassem o que tinham visto, até que o Filho do homem ressuscitasse dentre os mortos.
text_el: Καὶ καταβαινόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ ἃ εἶδον διηγήσωνται, εἰ μὴ ὅταν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῇ.

text_en: And they asked him, saying: Why then do the Pharisees and scribes say that Elias must come first?
text_la: Et interrogabant eum, dicentes : Quid ergo dicunt pharisæi et scribæ, quia Eliam oportet venire primum?
text_pt: E eles retiveram o caso entre si, perguntando uns aos outros que seria aquilo, ressuscitar dentre os mortos.
text_el: καὶ τὸν λόγον ἐκράτησαν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς συζητοῦντες τί ἐστιν τὸ ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῆναι.

text_en: Who answering, said to then: Elias , when he shall come first, shall restore all things; and as it is written of the Son of man that he must suffer many things and be despised .
text_la: Qui respondens, ait illis : Elias cum venerit primo, restituet omnia : et quomodo scriptum est in Filium hominis, ut multa patiatur et contemnatur.
text_pt: E interrogaram-no, dizendo: Por que dizem os escribas que é necessário que Elias venha primeiro?
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες: ὅτι λέγουσιν οἱ γραμματεῖς ὅτι Ἠλίαν δεῖ ἐλθεῖν πρῶτον;

text_en: But I say to you that Elias also has come (and they have done to him whatsoever they would), as it is written of him.
text_la: Sed dico vobis quia et Elias venit (et fecerunt illi quæcumque voluerunt) sicut scriptum est de eo.
text_pt: E, respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Em verdade Elias virá primeiro, e todas as coisas restaurará; e, como está escrito do Filho do homem, que ele deva padecer muito e ser aviltado.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτοῖς: Ἠλίας μὲν ἐλθὼν πρῶτον ἀποκαθιστάνει πάντα. καὶ πῶς γέγραπται ἐπὶ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου; ἵνα πολλὰ πάθῃ καὶ ἐξουδενηθῇ.

text_en: And coming to his disciples he saw a great multitude about them and the scribes disputing with them.
text_la: Et veniens ad discipulos suos, vidit turbam magnam circa eos, et scribas conquirentes cum illis.
text_pt: Digo-vos, porém, que Elias já veio, e fizeram-lhe tudo o que quiseram, como dele está escrito.
text_el: ἀλλὰ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι καὶ Ἠλίας ἐλήλυθεν, καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ ὅσα ἤθελον, καθὼς γέγραπται ἐπ' αὐτόν.

text_en: And presently all the people, seeing Jesus , were astonished and struck with fear: and running to him, they saluted him.
text_la: Et confestim omnis populus videns Jesum, stupefactus est, et expaverunt, et accurrentes salutabant eum.
text_pt: E, quando se aproximou dos discípulos, viu ao redor deles grande multidão, e alguns escribas que disputavam com eles.
text_el: Καὶ ἐλθόντες πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εἶδον ὄχλον πολὺν περὶ αὐτοὺς καὶ γραμματεῖς συζητοῦντας πρὸς αὐτούς.

text_en: And he asked them: What do you question about among you?
text_la: Et interrogavit eos : Quid inter vos conquiritis?
text_pt: E logo toda a multidão, vendo-o, ficou espantada e, correndo para ele, o saudaram.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεθαμβήθησαν, καὶ προστρέχοντες ἠσπάζοντο αὐτόν.

text_en: And one of the multitude, answering, said: Master, I have brought my son to you, having a dumb spirit.
text_la: Et respondens unus de turba, dixit : Magister, attuli filium meum ad te habentem spiritum mutum:
text_pt: E perguntou aos escribas: Que é que discutis com eles?
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτούς: τί συζητεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς;

text_en: Who, wheresoever he takes him, dashes him: and he foams and gnashes with the teeth and pines away. And I spoke to your disciples to cast him out: and they could not.
text_la: qui ubicumque eum apprehenderit, allidit illum, et spumat, et stridet dentibus, et arescit : et dixi discipulis tuis ut ejicerent illum, et non potuerunt.
text_pt: E um da multidão, respondendo, disse: Mestre, trouxe-te o meu filho, que tem um espírito mudo;
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου, διδάσκαλε, ἤνεγκα τὸν υἱόν μου πρὸς σέ, ἔχοντα πνεῦμα ἄλαλον,

text_en: Who answering them, said: O incredulous generation , how long shall I be with you? How long shall I suffer you? Bring him unto me.
text_la: Qui respondens eis, dixit : O generatio incredula, quamdiu apud vos ero? quamdiu vos patiar? afferte illum ad me.
text_pt: E este, onde quer que o apanhe, despedaça-o, e ele espuma, e range os dentes, e vai definhando; e eu disse aos teus discípulos que o expulsassem, e não puderam.
text_el: καὶ ὅπου ἐὰν αὐτὸν καταλάβῃ ῥήσσει, αὐτόν καὶ ἀφρίζει καὶ τρίζει τοὺς ὀδόντας καὶ ξηραίνεται: καὶ εἶπα τοῖς μαθηταῖς σου ἵνα αὐτὸ ἐκβάλωσιν, καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν.

text_en: And they brought him. And when he had seen him, immediately the spirit troubled him and being thrown down upon the ground, he rolled about foaming.
text_la: Et attulerunt eum. Et cum vidisset eum, statim spiritus conturbavit illum : et elisus in terram, volutabatur spumans.
text_pt: E ele, respondendo-lhes, disse: Ó geração incrédula! até quando estarei convosco? até quando vos sofrerei ainda? Trazei-mo.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτοῖς λέγει: ὦ γενεὰ ἄπιστος, ἕως πότε πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἔσομαι; ἕως πότε ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν; φέρετε αὐτὸν πρός με.

text_en: And he asked his father: How long time is it since this has happened unto him? But he sad: From his infancy.
text_la: Et interrogavit patrem ejus : Quantum temporis est ex quo ei hoc accidit? At ille ait : Ab infantia:
text_pt: E trouxeram-lho; e quando ele o viu, logo o espírito o agitou com violência, e, caindo o endemoninhado por terra, revolvia-se, escumando.
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκαν αὐτὸν πρὸς αὐτόν. καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν, τὸ πνεῦμα εὐθὺς συνεσπάραξεν αὐτόν, καὶ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐκυλίετο ἀφρίζων.

text_en: And oftentimes has he cast him into the fire and into the waters to destroy him. But if you can do anything, help us, having compassion on us.
text_la: et frequenter eum in ignem, et in aquas misit ut eum perderet : sed si quid potes, adjuva nos, misertus nostri.
text_pt: E perguntou ao pai dele: Quanto tempo há que lhe sucede isto? E ele disse-lhe: Desde a infância.
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ: πόσος χρόνος ἐστὶν ὡς τοῦτο γέγονεν αὐτῷ; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν: ἐκ παιδιόθεν:

text_en: And Jesus said to him: If you can believe , all things are possible to him that believes .
text_la: Jesus autem ait illi : Si potes credere, omnia possibilia sunt credenti.
text_pt: E muitas vezes o tem lançado no fogo, e na água, para o destruir; mas, se tu podes fazer alguma coisa, tem compaixão de nós, e ajuda-nos.
text_el: καὶ πολλάκις καὶ εἰς πῦρ αὐτὸν ἔβαλεν καὶ εἰς ὕδατα, ἵνα ἀπολέσῃ αὐτόν: ἀλλ' εἴ τι δύνῃ, βοήθησον ἡμῖν σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐφ' ἡμᾶς.

text_en: And immediately the father of the boy crying out, with tears said: I do believe , Lord. Help my unbelief.
text_la: Et continuo exclamans pater pueri, cum lacrimis aiebat : Credo, Domine; adjuva incredulitatem meam.
text_pt: E Jesus disse-lhe: Se tu podes crer, tudo é possível ao que crê.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ, τὸ εἰ δύνῃ; πάντα δυνατὰ τῷ πιστεύοντι.

text_en: And when Jesus saw the multitude running together, he threatened the unclean spirit , saying to him: Deaf and dumb spirit, I command you, go out of him and enter not any more into him.
text_la: Et cum videret Jesus concurrentem turbam, comminatus est spiritui immundo, dicens illi : Surde et mute spiritus, ego præcipio tibi, exi ab eo : et amplius ne introëas in eum.
text_pt: E logo o pai do menino, clamando, com lágrimas, disse: Eu creio, Senhor! ajuda a minha incredulidade.
text_el: εὐθὺς κράξας ὁ πατὴρ τοῦ παιδίου ἔλεγεν: πιστεύω: βοήθει μου τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ.

text_en: And crying out and greatly tearing him, he went our of him. And he became as dead, so that many said: He is dead.
text_la: Et exclamans, et multum discerpens eum, exiit ab eo, et factus est sicut mortuus, ita ut multi dicerent : Quia mortuus est.
text_pt: E Jesus, vendo que a multidão concorria, repreendeu o espírito imundo, dizendo-lhe: Espírito mudo e surdo, eu te ordeno: Sai dele, e não entres mais nele.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἐπισυντρέχει ὄχλος, ἐπετίμησεν τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ λέγων αὐτῷ: τὸ ἄλαλον καὶ κωφὸν πνεῦμα, ἐγὼ ἐπιτάσσω σοι, ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ μηκέτι εἰσέλθῃς εἰς αὐτόν.

text_en: But Jesus taking him by the hand, lifted him up. And he arose.
text_la: Jesus autem tenens manum ejus elevavit eum, et surrexit.
text_pt: E ele, clamando, e agitando-o com violência, saiu; e ficou o menino como morto, de tal maneira que muitos diziam que estava morto.
text_el: καὶ κράξας καὶ πολλὰ σπαράξας ἐξῆλθεν: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡσεὶ νεκρός, ὥστε τοὺς πολλοὺς λέγειν ὅτι ἀπέθανεν.

text_en: And when he had come into the house, his disciples secretly asked him: Why could not we cast him out?
text_la: Et cum introisset in domum, discipuli ejus secreto interrogabant eum : Quare nos non potuimus ejicere eum?
text_pt: Mas Jesus, tomando-o pela mão, o ergueu, e ele se levantou.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κρατήσας τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ ἤγειρεν αὐτόν, καὶ ἀνέστη.

text_en: And he said to them: This kind can go out by nothing, but by prayer and fasting .
text_la: Et dixit illis : Hoc genus in nullo potest exire, nisi in oratione et jejunio.
text_pt: E, quando entrou em casa, os seus discípulos lhe perguntaram à parte: Por que o não pudemos nós expulsar?
text_el: καὶ εἰσελθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς οἶκον οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ κατ' ἰδίαν ἐπηρώτων αὐτόν: ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἠδυνήθημεν ἐκβαλεῖν αὐτό;

text_en: And departing from thence, they passed through Galilee : and he would not that any man should know it.
text_la: Et inde profecti prætergrediebantur Galilæam: nec volebat quemquam scire.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Esta casta não pode sair com coisa alguma, a não ser com oração e jejum.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τοῦτο τὸ γένος ἐν οὐδενὶ δύναται ἐξελθεῖν εἰ μὴ ἐν προσευχῇ.

text_en: And he taught his disciples and said to them: The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men , and they shall kill him; and after he is killed, he shall rise again the third day.
text_la: Docebat autem discipulos suos, et dicebat illis : Quoniam Filius hominis tradetur in manus hominum, et occident eum, et occisus tertia die resurget.
text_pt: E, tendo partido dali, caminharam pela Galiléia, e não queria que alguém o soubesse;
text_el: Κἀκεῖθεν ἐξελθόντες ἐπορεύοντο διὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν ἵνα τις γνοῖ:

text_en: But they understood not the word: and they were afraid to ask him.
text_la: At illi ignorabant verbum : et timebant interrogare eum.
text_pt: Porque ensinava os seus discípulos, e lhes dizia: O Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens, e matá-lo-ão; e, morto ele, ressuscitará ao terceiro dia.
text_el: ἐδίδασκεν γὰρ τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλεγεν [αὐτοῖς] ὅτι ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων, καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν, καὶ ἀποκτανθεὶς μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστήσεται.

text_en: And they came to Capharnaum . And when they were in the house, he asked them: What did you treat of in the way?
text_la: Et venerunt Capharnaum. Qui cum domi essent, interrogabat eos : Quid in via tractabatis?
text_pt: Mas eles não entendiam esta palavra, e receavam interrogá-lo.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἠγνόουν τὸ ῥῆμα, καὶ ἐφοβοῦντο αὐτὸν ἐπερωτῆσαι.

text_en: But they held their peace, for in the way they had disputed among themselves, which of them should be the greatest.
text_la: At illi tacebant : siquidem in via inter se disputaverunt : quis eorum major esset.
text_pt: E chegou a Cafarnaum e, entrando em casa, perguntou-lhes: Que estáveis vós discutindo pelo caminho?
text_el: Καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Καφαρναούμ. καὶ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ γενόμενος ἐπηρώτα αὐτούς: τί ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ διελογίζεσθε;

text_en: And sitting down, he called the twelve and says to them: If any man desire to be first, he shall be the last of all and be minister of all.
text_la: Et residens vocavit duodecim, et ait illis : Si quis vult primus esse, erit omnium novissimus, et omnium minister.
text_pt: Mas eles calaram-se; porque pelo caminho tinham disputado entre si qual era o maior.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐσιώπων: πρὸς ἀλλήλους γὰρ διελέχθησαν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τίς μείζων.

text_en: And taking a child, he set him in the midst of them. Whom when he had embraced, he says to them:
text_la: Et accipiens puerum, statuit eum in medio eorum : quem cum complexus esset, ait illis:
text_pt: E ele, assentando-se, chamou os doze, e disse-lhes: Se alguém quiser ser o primeiro, será o derradeiro de todos e o servo de todos.
text_el: καὶ καθίσας ἐφώνησεν τοὺς δώδεκα, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: εἴ τις θέλει πρῶτος εἶναι, ἔσται πάντων ἔσχατος καὶ πάντων διάκονος.

text_en: Whosoever shall receive one such child as this in my name receives me. And whosoever shall receive me receives not me but him that sent me.
text_la: Quisquis unum ex hujusmodi pueris receperit in nomine meo, me recipit : et quicumque me susceperit, non me suscipit, sed eum qui misit me.
text_pt: E, lançando mão de um menino, pô-lo no meio deles e, tomando-o nos seus braços, disse-lhes:
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐναγκαλισάμενος αὐτὸ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς:

text_en: John answered him, saying: Master, we saw one casting out devils in your name , who follows not us: and we forbade him.
text_la: Respondit illi Joannes, dicens : Magister, vidimus quemdam in nomine tuo ejicientem dæmonia, qui non sequitur nos, et prohibuimus eum.
text_pt: Qualquer que receber um destes meninos em meu nome, a mim me recebe; e qualquer que a mim me receber, recebe, não a mim, mas ao que me enviou.
text_el: ὃς ἂν [ἓν] τῶν τοιούτων παιδίων δέξηται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐμὲ δέχεται: καὶ ὃς ἂν ἐμὲ δέχηται, οὐκ ἐμὲ δέχεται ἀλλὰ τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με.

text_en: But Jesus said: Do not forbid him. For there is no man that does a miracle in my name and can soon speak ill of me.
text_la: Jesus autem ait : Nolite prohibere eum : nemo est enim qui faciat virtutem in nomine meo, et possit cito male loqui de me:
text_pt: E João lhe respondeu, dizendo: Mestre, vimos um que em teu nome expulsava demônios, o qual não nos segue; e nós lho proibimos, porque não nos segue.
text_el: Ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰωάννης: διδάσκαλε, εἴδομέν τινα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐκβάλλοντα δαιμόνια καὶ ἐκωλύομεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὐκ ἠκολούθει ἡμῖν.

text_en: For he that is not against you is for you.
text_la: qui enim non est adversum vos, pro vobis est.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, disse: Não lho proibais; porque ninguém há que faça milagre em meu nome e possa logo falar mal de mim.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: μὴ κωλύετε αὐτόν, οὐδεὶς γάρ ἐστιν ὃς ποιήσει δύναμιν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου καὶ δυνήσεται ταχὺ κακολογῆσαί με:

text_en: For whosoever shall give you to drink a cup of water in my name , because you belong to Christ : amen I say to you, he shall not lose his reward.
text_la: Quisquis enim potum dederit vobis calicem aquæ in nomine meo, quia Christi estis : amen dico vobis, non perdet mercedem suam.
text_pt: Porque quem não é contra nós, é por nós.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ οὐκ ἔστιν καθ' ἡμῶν, ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἐστιν.

text_en: And whosoever shall scandalize one of these little ones that believe in me: it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck and he were cast into the sea.
text_la: Et quisquis scandalizaverit unum ex his pusillis credentibus in me : bonum est ei magis si circumdaretur mola asinaria collo ejus, et in mare mitteretur.
text_pt: Porquanto, qualquer que vos der a beber um copo de água em meu nome, porque sois discípulos de Cristo, em verdade vos digo que não perderá o seu galardão.
text_el: ὃς γὰρ ἂν ποτίσῃ ὑμᾶς ποτήριον ὕδατος ἐν ὀνόματι ὅτι Χριστοῦ ἐστε, ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσῃ τὸν μισθὸν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And if your hand scandalize you, cut it off: it is better for you to enter into life, maimed, than having two hands to go into hell , into unquenchable fire:
text_la: Et si scandalizaverit te manus tua, abscide illam : bonum est tibi debilem introire in vitam, quam duas manus habentem ire in gehennam, in ignem inextinguibilem,
text_pt: E qualquer que escandalizar um destes pequeninos que crêem em mim, melhor lhe fora que lhe pusessem ao pescoço uma mó de atafona, e que fosse lançado no mar.
text_el: Καὶ ὃς ἂν σκανδαλίσῃ ἕνα τῶν μικρῶν τούτων τῶν πιστευόντων, καλόν ἐστιν αὐτῷ μᾶλλον εἰ περίκειται μύλος ὀνικὸς περὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ βέβληται εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν.
