text_en: Where their worm dies not, and the fire is not extinguished.
text_la: ubi vermis eorum non moritur, et ignis non extinguitur.
text_pt: E, se a tua mão te escandalizar, corta-a; melhor é para ti entrares na vida aleijado do que, tendo duas mãos, ires para o inferno, para o fogo que nunca se apaga,
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν σκανδαλίσῃ σε ἡ χείρ σου, ἀπόκοψον αὐτήν: καλόν ἐστίν σε κυλλὸν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν, ἢ τὰς δύο χεῖρας ἔχοντα ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὴν γέενναν, εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ ἄσβεστον.

text_en: And if your foot scandalize you, cut it off: it is better for you to enter lame into life everlasting than having two feet to be cast into the hell of unquenchable fire :
text_la: Et si pes tuus te scandalizat, amputa illum : bonum est tibi claudum introire in vitam æternam, quam duos pedes habentem mitti in gehennam ignis inextinguibilis,
text_pt: Onde o seu bicho não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.

text_en: Where their worm dies not, and the fire is not extinguished.
text_la: ubi vermis eorum non moritur, et ignis non extinguitur.
text_pt: E, se o teu pé te escandalizar, corta-o; melhor é para ti entrares coxo na vida do que, tendo dois pés, seres lançado no inferno, no fogo que nunca se apaga,
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ὁ πούς σου σκανδαλίζῃ σε, ἀπόκοψον αὐτόν: καλόν ἐστίν σε εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν χωλὸν ἢ τοὺς δύο πόδας ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν γέενναν.

text_en: And if your eye scandalize you, pluck it out: it is better for you with one eye to enter into the kingdom of God than having two eyes to be cast into the hell of fire :
text_la: Quod si oculus tuus scandalizat te, ejice eum : bonum est tibi luscum introire in regnum Dei, quam duos oculos habentem mitti in gehennam ignis,
text_pt: Onde o seu bicho não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου σκανδαλίζῃ σε, ἔκβαλε αὐτόν: καλόν σέ ἐστιν μονόφθαλμον εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἢ δύο ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς γέενναν,

text_en: Where their worm dies not, and the fire is not extinguished.
text_la: ubi vermis eorum non moritur, et ignis non extinguitur.
text_pt: E, se o teu olho te escandalizar, lança-o fora; melhor é para ti entrares no reino de Deus com um só olho do que, tendo dois olhos, seres lançado no fogo do inferno,
text_el: ὅπου ὁ σκώληξ αὐτῶν οὐ τελευτᾷ καὶ τὸ πῦρ οὐ σβέννυται:

text_en: For every one shall be salted with fire: and every victim shall be salted with salt .
text_la: Omnis enim igne salietur, et omnis victima sale salietur.
text_pt: Onde o seu bicho não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.
text_el: πᾶς γὰρ πυρὶ ἁλισθήσεται.

text_en: Salt is good . But if the salt become unsavoury, wherewith will you season it? Have salt in you: and have peace among you.
text_la: Bonum est sal : quod si sal insulsum fuerit, in quo illud condietis? Habete in vobis sal, et pacem habete inter vos.
text_pt: Porque cada um será salgado com fogo, e cada sacrifício será salgado com sal.
text_el: καλὸν τὸ ἅλας: ἐὰν δὲ τὸ ἅλας ἄναλον γένηται, ἐν τίνι αὐτὸ ἀρτύσετε; ἔχετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἅλα, καὶ εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ἀλλήλοις.

text_en: And rising up from thence, he comes into the coast of Judea beyond the Jordan : and the multitude flocked to him again. And as he was accustomed, he taught them again.
text_la: Et inde exsurgens venit in fines Judææ ultra Jordanem : et conveniunt iterum turbæ ad eum : et sicut consueverat, iterum docebat illos.
text_pt: E, levantando-se dali, foi para os termos da Judéia, além do Jordão, e a multidão se reuniu em torno dele; e tornou a ensiná-los, como tinha por costume.
text_el: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀναστὰς ἔρχεται εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ συμπορεύονται πάλιν ὄχλοι πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ ὡς εἰώθει πάλιν ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς.

text_en: And the Pharisees coming to him asked him, tempting him: Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife?
text_la: Et accedentes pharisæi interrogabant eum : Si licet viro uxorem dimittere : tentantes eum.
text_pt: E, aproximando-se dele os fariseus, perguntaram-lhe, tentando-o: É lícito ao homem repudiar sua mulher?
text_el: καὶ [προσελθόντες Φαρισαῖοι] ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν εἰ ἔξεστιν ἀνδρὶ γυναῖκα ἀπολῦσαι, πειράζοντες αὐτόν.

text_en: But he answering, says to them: What did Moses command you?
text_la: At ille respondens, dixit eis : Quid vobis præcepit Moyses?
text_pt: Mas ele, respondendo, disse-lhes: Que vos mandou Moisés?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τί ὑμῖν ἐνετείλατο Μωϋσῆς;

text_en: Who said: Moses permitted to write a bill of divorce and to put her away .
text_la: Qui dixerunt : Moyses permisit libellum repudii scribere, et dimittere.
text_pt: E eles disseram: Moisés permitiu escrever carta de divórcio e repudiar.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: ἐπέτρεψεν Μωϋσῆς βιβλίον ἀποστασίου γράψαι καὶ ἀπολῦσαι.

text_en: To whom Jesus answering, said: Because of the hardness of your heart, he wrote you that precept .
text_la: Quibus respondens Jesus, ait : Ad duritiam cordis vestri scripsit vobis præceptum istud:
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Pela dureza dos vossos corações vos deixou ele escrito esse mandamento;
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν τὴν ἐντολὴν ταύτην.

text_en: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
text_la: ab initio autem creaturæ masculum et feminam fecit eos Deus.
text_pt: Porém, desde o princípio da criação, Deus os fez macho e fêmea.
text_el: ἀπὸ δὲ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν [αὐτούς]:

text_en: For this cause, a man shall leave his father and mother and shall cleave to his wife.
text_la: Propter hoc relinquet homo patrem suum et matrem, et adhærebit ad uxorem suam:
text_pt: Por isso deixará o homem a seu pai e a sua mãe, e unir-se-á a sua mulher,
text_el: ἕνεκεν τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα,

text_en: And they two shall be in one flesh. Therefore now they are not two, but one flesh.
text_la: et erunt duo in carne una. Itaque jam non sunt duo, sed una caro.
text_pt: E serão os dois uma só carne; e assim já não serão dois, mas uma só carne.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν, ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ μία σάρξ.

text_en: What therefore God has joined together, let no man put asunder.
text_la: Quod ergo Deus conjunxit, homo non separet.
text_pt: Portanto, o que Deus ajuntou não o separe o homem.
text_el: ὃ οὖν ὁ θεὸς συνέζευξεν, ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω.

text_en: And in the house again his disciples asked him concerning the same thing.
text_la: Et in domo iterum discipuli ejus de eodem interrogaverunt eum.
text_pt: E em casa tornaram os discípulos a interrogá-lo acerca disto mesmo.
text_el: καὶ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν πάλιν οἱ μαθηταὶ περὶ τούτου ἐπηρώτων αὐτόν.

text_en: And he says to them: Whosoever shall put away his wife and marry another commits adultery against her.
text_la: Et ait illis : Quicumque dimiserit uxorem suam, et aliam duxerit, adulterium committit super eam.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Qualquer que deixar a sua mulher e casar com outra, adultera contra ela.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην, μοιχᾶται ἐπ' αὐτήν:

text_en: And if the wife shall put away her husband and be married to another , she commits adultery .
text_la: Et si uxor dimiserit virum suum, et alii nupserit, mœchatur.
text_pt: E, se a mulher deixar a seu marido, e casar com outro, adultera.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν αὐτὴ ἀπολύσασα τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς γαμήσῃ ἄλλον, μοιχᾶται.

text_en: And they brought to him young children, that he might touch them. And the disciples rebuked them that brought them.
text_la: Et offerebant illi parvulos ut tangeret illos. Discipuli autem comminabantur offerentibus.
text_pt: E traziam-lhe meninos para que lhes tocasse, mas os discípulos repreendiam aos que lhos traziam.
text_el: Καὶ προσέφερον αὐτῷ παιδία ἵνα αὐτῶν ἅψηται: οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Whom when Jesus saw, he was much displeased and says to them: Suffer the little children to come unto me and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God .
text_la: Quos cum videret Jesus, indigne tulit, et ait illis : Sinite parvulos venire ad me, et ne prohibueritis eos : talium enim est regnum Dei.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, vendo isto, indignou-se, e disse-lhes: Deixai vir os meninos a mim, e não os impeçais; porque dos tais é o reino de Deus.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἠγανάκτησεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με, μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά: τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Amen I say to you, whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall not enter into it.
text_la: Amen dico vobis : Quisquis non receperit regnum Dei velut parvulus, non intrabit in illud.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que qualquer que não receber o reino de Deus como menino, de maneira nenhuma entrará nele.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν.

text_en: And embracing them and laying his hands upon them, he blessed them.
text_la: Et complexans eos, et imponens manus super illos, benedicebat eos.
text_pt: E, tomando-os nos seus braços, e impondo-lhes as mãos, os abençoou.
text_el: καὶ ἐναγκαλισάμενος αὐτὰ κατευλόγει τιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ' αὐτά.

text_en: And when he had gone forth into the way, a certain man , running up and kneeling before him, asked him: Good Master, what shall I do that I may receive life everlasting?
text_la: Et cum egressus esset in viam, procurrens quidam genu flexo ante eum, rogabat eum : Magister bone, quid faciam ut vitam æternam percipiam?
text_pt: E, pondo-se a caminho, correu para ele um homem, o qual se ajoelhou diante dele, e lhe perguntou: Bom Mestre, que farei para herdar a vida eterna?
text_el: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ εἰς ὁδὸν προσδραμὼν εἷς καὶ γονυπετήσας αὐτὸν ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν: διδάσκαλε ἀγαθέ, τί ποιήσω ἵνα ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Why do you call me good ? None is good but one, that is God .
text_la: Jesus autem dixit ei : Quid me dicis bonum? nemo bonus, nisi unus Deus.
text_pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Por que me chamas bom? Ninguém há bom senão um, que é Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: τί με λέγεις ἀγαθόν; οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς ὁ θεός.

text_en: You know the commandments: Do not commit adultery , do not kill, do not steal, bear not false witness, do no fraud , honour your father and mother.
text_la: Præcepta nosti : ne adulteres, ne occidas, ne fureris, ne falsum testimonium dixeris, ne fraudum feceris, honora patrem tuum et matrem.
text_pt: Tu sabes os mandamentos: Não adulterarás; não matarás; não furtarás; não dirás falso testemunho; não defraudarás alguém; honra a teu pai e a tua mãe.
text_el: τὰς ἐντολὰς οἶδας: μὴ φονεύσῃς, μὴ μοιχεύσῃς, μὴ κλέψῃς, μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς, μὴ ἀποστερήσῃς, τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα.

text_en: But he answering, said to him: Master, all these things I have observed from my youth.
text_la: At ille respondens, ait illi : Magister, hæc omnia observavi a juventute mea.
text_pt: Ele, porém, respondendo, lhe disse: Mestre, tudo isso guardei desde a minha mocidade.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτῷ: διδάσκαλε, ταῦτα πάντα ἐφυλαξάμην ἐκ νεότητός μου.

text_en: And Jesus , looking on him, loved him and said to him: One thing is wanting unto you. Go, sell whatsoever you have and give to the poor: and you shall have treasure in heaven . And come, follow me.
text_la: Jesus autem intuitus eum, dilexit eum, et dixit ei : Unum tibi deest : vade, quæcumque habes vende, et da pauperibus, et habebis thesaurum in cælo : et veni, sequere me.
text_pt: E Jesus, olhando para ele, o amou e lhe disse: Falta-te uma coisa: vai, vende tudo quanto tens, e dá-o aos pobres, e terás um tesouro no céu; e vem, toma a cruz, e segue-me.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐμβλέψας αὐτῷ ἠγάπησεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἕν σε ὑστερεῖ: ὕπαγε, ὅσα ἔχεις πώλησον καὶ δὸς τοῖς πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανῷ, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.

text_en: Who being struck sad at that saying, went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions .
text_la: Qui contristatus in verbo, abiit mœrens : erat enim habens multas possessiones.
text_pt: Mas ele, pesaroso desta palavra, retirou-se triste; porque possuía muitas propriedades.
text_el: ὁ δὲ στυγνάσας ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος: ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά.

text_en: And Jesus looking round about, says to his disciples : How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
text_la: Et circumspiciens Jesus, ait discipulis suis : Quam difficile qui pecunias habent, in regnum Dei introibunt!
text_pt: Então Jesus, olhando em redor, disse aos seus discípulos: Quão dificilmente entrarão no reino de Deus os que têm riquezas!
text_el: καὶ περιβλεψάμενος ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ: πῶς δυσκόλως οἱ τὰ χρήματα ἔχοντες εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ εἰσελεύσονται.

text_en: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus again answering, says to them: Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God ?
text_la: Discipuli autem obstupescebant in verbis ejus. At Jesus rursus respondens ait illis : Filioli, quam difficile est, confidentes in pecuniis, in regnum Dei introire!
text_pt: E os discípulos se admiraram destas suas palavras; mas Jesus, tornando a falar, disse-lhes: Filhos, quão difícil é, para os que confiam nas riquezas, entrar no reino de Deus!
text_el: οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐθαμβοῦντο ἐπὶ τοῖς λόγοις αὐτοῦ. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτοῖς: τέκνα, πῶς δύσκολόν ἐστιν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν:

text_en: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
text_la: Facilius est camelum per foramen acus transire, quam divitem intrare in regnum Dei.
text_pt: É mais fácil passar um camelo pelo fundo de uma agulha, do que entrar um rico no reino de Deus.
text_el: εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρυμαλιᾶς ῥαφίδος διελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν.

text_en: Who wondered the more, saying among themselves: Who then can be saved?
text_la: Qui magis admirabantur, dicentes ad semetipsos : Et quis potest salvus fieri?
text_pt: E eles se admiravam ainda mais, dizendo entre si: Quem poderá, pois, salvar-se?
text_el: οἱ δὲ περισσῶς ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ τίς δύναται σωθῆναι;

text_en: And Jesus looking on them, says with men it is impossible; but not with God . For all things are possible with God .
text_la: Et intuens illos Jesus, ait : Apud homines impossibile est, sed non apud Deum : omnia enim possibilia sunt apud Deum.
text_pt: Jesus, porém, olhando para eles, disse: Para os homens é impossível, mas não para Deus, porque para Deus todas as coisas são possíveis.
text_el: ἐμβλέψας αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει: παρὰ ἀνθρώποις ἀδύνατον, ἀλλ' οὐ παρὰ θεῷ: πάντα γὰρ δυνατὰ παρὰ [τῷ] θεῷ.

text_en: And Peter began to say unto him: Behold, we have left all things and have followed you.
text_la: Et cœpit ei Petrus dicere : Ecce nos dimisimus omnia, et secuti sumus te.
text_pt: E Pedro começou a dizer-lhe: Eis que nós tudo deixamos, e te seguimos.
text_el: Ἤρξατο λέγειν ὁ Πέτρος αὐτῷ: ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήκαμέν σοι.

text_en: Jesus answering said: Amen I say to you, there is no man who has left house or brethren or sisters or father or mother or children or lands, for my sake and for the gospel ,
text_la: Respondens Jesus, ait : Amen dico vobis : Nemo est qui reliquerit domum, aut fratres, aut sorores, aut patrem, aut matrem, aut filios, aut agros propter me et propter Evangelium,
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse: Em verdade vos digo que ninguém há, que tenha deixado casa, ou irmãos, ou irmãs, ou pai, ou mãe, ou mulher, ou filhos, ou campos, por amor de mim e do evangelho,
text_el: ἔφη ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐδείς ἐστιν ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ μητέρα ἢ πατέρα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ καὶ [ἕνεκεν] τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

text_en: who shall not receive an hundred times as much, now in this time: houses and brethren and sisters and mothers and children and lands, with persecutions : and in the world to come life everlasting.
text_la: qui non accipiat centies tantum, nunc in tempore hoc : domos, et fratres, et sorores, et matres, et filios, et agros, cum persecutionibus, et in sæculo futuro vitam æternam.
text_pt: Que não receba cem vezes tanto, já neste tempo, em casas, e irmãos, e irmãs, e mães, e filhos, e campos, com perseguições; e no século futuro a vida eterna.
text_el: ἐὰν μὴ λάβῃ ἑκατονταπλασίονα νῦν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ οἰκίας καὶ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἀδελφὰς καὶ μητέρας καὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀγροὺς μετὰ διωγμῶν, καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: But many that are first shall be last: and the last, first.
text_la: Multi autem erunt primi novissimi, et novissimi primi.
text_pt: Porém muitos primeiros serão derradeiros, e muitos derradeiros serão primeiros.
text_el: πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ [οἱ] ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι.

text_en: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem : and Jesus went before them. And they were astonished and following were afraid. And taking again the twelve, he began to tell them the things that should befall him.
text_la: Erant autem in via ascendentes Jerosolymam : et præcedebat illos Jesus, et stupebant : et sequentes timebant. Et assumens iterum duodecim, cœpit illis dicere quæ essent ei eventura.
text_pt: E iam no caminho, subindo para Jerusalém; e Jesus ia adiante deles. E eles maravilhavam-se, e seguiam-no atemorizados.  E, tornando a tomar consigo os doze, começou a dizer-lhes as coisas que lhe deviam sobrevir,
text_el: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἀναβαίνοντες εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, καὶ ἦν προάγων αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐθαμβοῦντο, οἱ δὲ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἐφοβοῦντο. καὶ παραλαβὼν πάλιν τοὺς δώδεκα ἤρξατο αὐτοῖς λέγειν τὰ μέλλοντα αὐτῷ συμβαίνειν,

text_en: Saying: Behold we go up to Jerusalem , and the Son of man shall be betrayed to the chief priests and to the scribes and ancients. And they shall condemn him to death and shall deliver him to the Gentiles .
text_la: Quia ecce ascendimus Jerosolymam, et Filius hominis tradetur principibus sacerdotum, et scribis, et senioribus, et damnabunt eum morte, et tradent eum gentibus:
text_pt: Dizendo: Eis que nós subimos a Jerusalém, e o Filho do homem será entregue aos príncipes dos sacerdotes, e aos escribas, e o condenarão à morte, e o entregarão aos gentios.
text_el: ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδοθήσεται τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς γραμματεῦσιν, καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτὸν θανάτῳ καὶ παραδώσουσιν αὐτὸν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

text_en: And they shall mock him and spit on him and scourge him and kill him: and the third day he shall rise again .
text_la: et illudent ei, et conspuent eum, et flagellabunt eum, et interficient eum : et tertia die resurget.
text_pt: E o escarnecerão, e açoitarão, e cuspirão nele, e o matarão; e, ao terceiro dia, ressuscitará.
text_el: καὶ ἐμπαίξουσιν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐμπτύσουσιν αὐτῷ καὶ μαστιγώσουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν, καὶ μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστήσεται.

text_en: And James and John , the sons of Zebedee, come to him, saying: Master, we desire that whatsoever we shall ask, you would do it for us.
text_la: Et accedunt ad eum Jacobus et Joannes filii Zebedæi, dicentes : Magister, volumus ut quodcumque petierimus, facias nobis.
text_pt: E aproximaram-se dele Tiago e João, filhos de Zebedeu, dizendo: Mestre, queremos que nos faças o que te pedirmos.
text_el: Καὶ προσπορεύονται αὐτῷ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάννης οἱ [δύο] υἱοὶ Ζεβεδαίου, λέγοντες αὐτῷ, διδάσκαλε, θέλομεν ἵνα ὃ ἐὰν αἰτήσωμέν σε ποιήσῃς ἡμῖν.

text_en: But he said to them: What would you that I should do for you?
text_la: At ille dixit eis : Quid vultis ut faciam vobis?
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Que quereis que vos faça?
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τί θέλετέ ποιήσω ὑμῖν;

text_en: And they said: Grant to us that we may sit, one on your right hand and the other on your left hand, in your glory .
text_la: Et dixerunt : Da nobis ut unus ad dexteram tuam, et alius ad sinistram tuam sedeamus in gloria tua.
text_pt: E eles lhe disseram: Concede-nos que na tua glória nos assentemos, um à tua direita, e outro à tua esquerda.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ, δὸς ἡμῖν ἵνα εἷς σου ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ ἀριστερῶν καθίσωμεν ἐν τῇ δόξῃ σου.

text_en: And Jesus said to them: You know not what you ask. Can you drink of the chalice that I drink of or be baptized with the baptism wherewith I am baptized ?
text_la: Jesus autem ait eis : Nescitis quid petatis : potestis bibere calicem, quem ego bibo, aut baptismo, quo ego baptizor, baptizari?
text_pt: Mas Jesus lhes disse: Não sabeis o que pedis; podeis vós beber o cálice que eu bebo, e ser batizados com o batismo com que eu sou batizado?
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: οὐκ οἴδατε τί αἰτεῖσθε. δύνασθε πιεῖν τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ πίνω, ἢ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐγὼ βαπτίζομαι βαπτισθῆναι;

text_en: But they said to him: We can. And Jesus says to them: You shall indeed drink of the chalice that I drink of; and with the baptism wherewith I am baptized you shall be baptized .
text_la: At illi dixerunt ei : Possumus. Jesus autem ait eis : Calicem quidem, quem ego bibo, bibetis; et baptismo, quo ego baptizor, baptizabimini:
text_pt: E eles lhe disseram: Podemos. Jesus, porém, disse-lhes: Em verdade, vós bebereis o cálice que eu beber, e sereis batizados com o batismo com que eu sou batizado;
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: δυνάμεθα. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ πίνω πίεσθε καὶ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐγὼ βαπτίζομαι βαπτισθήσεσθε:

text_en: But to sit on my right hand or on my left is not mine to give to you, but to them for whom it is prepared.
text_la: sedere autem ad dexteram meam, vel ad sinistram, non est meum dare vobis, sed quibus paratum est.
text_pt: Mas, o assentar-se à minha direita, ou à minha esquerda, não me pertence a mim concedê-lo, mas isso é para aqueles a quem está reservado.
text_el: τὸ δὲ καθίσαι ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἢ ἐξ εὐωνύμων οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸν δοῦναι, ἀλλ' οἷς ἡτοίμασται.

text_en: And the ten, hearing it, began to be much displeased at James and John .
text_la: Et audientes decem, cœperunt indignari de Jacobo et Joanne.
text_pt: E os dez, tendo ouvido isto, começaram a indignar-se contra Tiago e João.
text_el: Καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ δέκα ἤρξαντο ἀγανακτεῖν περὶ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου.

text_en: But Jesus calling them, says to them: You know that they who seem to rule over the Gentiles lord it over them: and their princes have power over them.
text_la: Jesus autem vocans eos, ait illis : Scitis quia hi, qui videntur principari gentibus, dominantur eis : et principes eorum potestatem habent ipsorum.
text_pt: Mas Jesus, chamando-os a si, disse-lhes: Sabeis que os que julgam ser príncipes dos gentios, deles se assenhoreiam, e os seus grandes usam de autoridade sobre eles;
text_el: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς: οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ δοκοῦντες ἄρχειν τῶν ἐθνῶν κατακυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι αὐτῶν κατεξουσιάζουσιν αὐτῶν.

text_en: But it is not so among you: but whosoever will be greater shall be your minister.
text_la: Non ita est autem in vobis, sed quicumque voluerit fieri major, erit vester minister:
text_pt: Mas entre vós não será assim; antes, qualquer que entre vós quiser ser grande, será vosso serviçal;
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως δέ ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν: ἀλλ' ὃς ἂν θέλῃ μέγας γενέσθαι ἐν ὑμῖν, ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος,

text_en: And whosoever will be first among you shall be the servant of all.
text_la: et quicumque voluerit in vobis primus esse, erit omnium servus.
text_pt: E qualquer que dentre vós quiser ser o primeiro, será servo de todos.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ ἐν ὑμῖν εἶναι πρῶτος, ἔσται πάντων δοῦλος:

text_en: For the Son of man also is not come to be ministered unto: but to minister and to give his life a redemption for many.
text_la: Nam et Filius hominis non venit ut ministraretur ei, sed ut ministraret, et daret animam suam redemptionem pro multis.
text_pt: Porque o Filho do homem também não veio para ser servido, mas para servir e dar a sua vida em resgate de muitos.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἦλθεν διακονηθῆναι ἀλλὰ διακονῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ λύτρον ἀντὶ πολλῶν.

text_en: And they came to Jericho . And as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a very great multitude, Bartimeus the blind man , the son of Timeus, sat by the way side begging.
text_la: Et veniunt Jericho : et proficiscente eo de Jericho, et discipulis ejus, et plurima multitudine, filius Timæi Bartimæus cæcus, sedebat juxta viam mendicans.
text_pt: E depois, foram para Jericó. E, saindo ele de Jericó com seus discípulos e uma grande multidão, Bartimeu, o cego, filho de Timeu, estava assentado junto do caminho, mendigando.
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Ἰεριχώ. καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ Ἰεριχὼ καὶ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὄχλου ἱκανοῦ ὁ υἱὸς Τιμαίου Βαρτιμαῖος, τυφλὸς προσαίτης, ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν.

text_en: Who when he had heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth , began to cry out and to say: Jesus , Son of David , have mercy on me.
text_la: Qui cum audisset quia Jesus Nazarenus est, cœpit clamare, et dicere : Jesu fili David, miserere mei.
text_pt: E, ouvindo que era Jesus de Nazaré, começou a clamar, e a dizer: Jesus, filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσας ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζαρηνός ἐστιν, ἤρξατο κράζειν καὶ λέγειν: υἱὲ Δαυὶδ Ἰησοῦ, ἐλέησόν με.

text_en: And many rebuked him, that he might hold his peace; but he cried a great deal the more: Son of David , have mercy on me.
text_la: Et comminabantur ei multi ut taceret. At ille multo magis clamabat : Fili David, miserere mei.
text_pt: E muitos o repreendiam, para que se calasse; mas ele clamava cada vez mais: Filho de Davi! tem misericórdia de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ πολλοὶ ἵνα σιωπήσῃ: ὁ δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν, υἱὲ Δαυίδ, ἐλέησόν με.

text_en: And Jesus , standing still, commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man , saying to him: Be of better comfort. Arise, he calls you.
text_la: Et stans Jesus præcepit illum vocari. Et vocant cæcum, dicentes ei : Animæquior esto : surge, vocat te.
text_pt: E Jesus, parando, disse que o chamassem; e chamaram o cego, dizendo-lhe: Tem bom ânimo; levanta-te, que ele te chama.
text_el: καὶ στὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: φωνήσατε αὐτόν. καὶ φωνοῦσιν τὸν τυφλὸν λέγοντες αὐτῷ: θάρσει, ἔγειρε, φωνεῖ σε.

text_en: Who casting off his garment leaped up and came to him.
text_la: Qui projecto vestimento suo exiliens, venit ad eum.
text_pt: E ele, lançando de si a sua capa, levantou-se, e foi ter com Jesus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀποβαλὼν τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ ἀναπηδήσας ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to him: What will you that I should do to you? And the blind man said to him: Rabboni. That I may see.
text_la: Et respondens Jesus dixit illi : Quid tibi vis faciam? Cæcus autem dixit ei : Rabboni, ut videam.
text_pt: E Jesus, falando, disse-lhe: Que queres que te faça? E o cego lhe disse: Mestre, que eu tenha vista.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: τί σοι θέλεις ποιήσω; ὁ δὲ τυφλὸς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ραββουνι, ἵνα ἀναβλέψω.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Go your way. Your faith has made you whole. And immediately he saw and followed him in the way.
text_la: Jesus autem ait illi : Vade, fides tua te salvum fecit. Et confestim vidit, et sequebatur eum in via.
text_pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Vai, a tua fé te salvou. E logo viu, e seguiu a Jesus pelo caminho.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ὕπαγε, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε. καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέβλεψεν, καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.

text_en: And when they were drawing near to Jerusalem and to Bethania , at the mount of Olives , he sends two of his disciples ,
text_la: Et cum appropinquarent Jerosolymæ et Bethaniæ ad montem Olivarum, mittit duos ex discipulis suis,
text_pt: E, logo que se aproximaram de Jerusalém, de Betfagé e de Betânia, junto do Monte das Oliveiras, enviou dois dos seus discípulos,
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγγίζουσιν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα εἰς Βηθφαγὴ καὶ Βηθανίαν πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν, ἀποστέλλει δύο τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: and says to them: Go into the village that is over against you, and immediately at your coming in thither, you shall find a colt tied, upon which no man yet has sat. Loose him and bring him.
text_la: et ait illis : Ite in castellum, quod contra vos est, et statim introëuntes illuc, invenietis pullum ligatum, super quem nemo adhuc hominum sedit : solvite illum, et adducite.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Ide à aldeia que está defronte de vós; e, logo que ali entrardes, encontrareis preso um jumentinho, sobre o qual ainda não montou homem algum; soltai-o, e trazei-mo.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν κώμην τὴν κατέναντι ὑμῶν, καὶ εὐθὺς εἰσπορευόμενοι εἰς αὐτὴν εὑρήσετε πῶλον δεδεμένον, ἐφ' ὃν οὐδεὶς οὔπω ἀνθρώπων ἐκάθισεν: λύσατε αὐτὸν καὶ φέρετε.

text_en: And if any man shall say to you: What are you doing? Say that the Lord has need of him. And immediately he will let him come hither.
text_la: Et si quis vobis dixerit : Quid facitis? dicite, quia Domino necessarius est : et continuo illum dimittet huc.
text_pt: E, se alguém vos disser: Por que fazeis isso? dizei-lhe que o Senhor precisa dele, e logo o deixará trazer para aqui.
text_el: καὶ ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ: τί ποιεῖτε τοῦτο; εἴπατε: ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχει, καὶ εὐθὺς αὐτὸν ἀποστέλλει πάλιν ὧδε.

text_en: And going their way, they found the colt tied before the gate without, in the meeting of two ways. And they loose him.
text_la: Et abeuntes invenerunt pullum ligatum ante januam foris in bivio: et solvunt eum.
text_pt: E foram, e encontraram o jumentinho preso fora da porta, entre dois caminhos, e o soltaram.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθον καὶ εὗρον πῶλον δεδεμένον πρὸς θύραν ἔξω ἐπὶ τοῦ ἀμφόδου, καὶ λύουσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: And some of them that stood there said to them: What do you loosing the colt?
text_la: Et quidam de illic stantibus dicebant illis : Quid facitis solventes pullum?
text_pt: E alguns dos que ali estavam lhes disseram: Que fazeis, soltando o jumentinho?
text_el: καί τινες τῶν ἐκεῖ ἑστηκότων ἔλεγον αὐτοῖς: τί ποιεῖτε λύοντες τὸν πῶλον;

text_en: Who said to them as Jesus had commanded them. And they let him go with them.
text_la: Qui dixerunt eis sicut præceperat illis Jesus, et dimiserunt eis.
text_pt: Eles, porém, disseram-lhes como Jesus lhes tinha mandado; e deixaram-nos ir.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς καθὼς εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: καὶ ἀφῆκαν αὐτούς.

text_en: And they brought the colt to Jesus . And they lay their garments on him: and he sat upon him.
text_la: Et duxerunt pullum ad Jesum : et imponunt illi vestimenta sua, et sedit super eum.
text_pt: E levaram o jumentinho a Jesus, e lançaram sobre ele as suas vestes, e assentou-se sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ φέρουσιν τὸν πῶλον πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ ἐπιβάλλουσιν αὐτῷ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐπ' αὐτόν.

text_en: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down boughs from the trees and strewed them in the way.
text_la: Multi autem vestimenta sua straverunt in via : alii autem frondes cædebant de arboribus, et sternebant in via.
text_pt: E muitos estendiam as suas vestes pelo caminho, e outros cortavam ramos das árvores, e os espalhavam pelo caminho.
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν ἔστρωσαν εἰς τὴν ὁδόν, ἄλλοι δὲ στιβάδας, κόψαντες ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν.

text_en: And they that went before and they that followed cried, saying: Hosanna : Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Et qui præibant, et qui sequebantur, clamabant, dicentes : Hosanna : benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini:
text_pt: E aqueles que iam adiante, e os que seguiam, clamavam, dizendo: Hosana, bendito o que vem em nome do Senhor;
text_el: καὶ οἱ προάγοντες καὶ οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἔκραζον: ὡσαννά, εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου:

text_en: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David that comes: Hosanna in the highest.
text_la: benedictum quod venit regnum patris nostri David : hosanna in excelsis.
text_pt: Bendito o reino do nosso pai Davi, que vem em nome do Senhor. Hosana nas alturas.
text_el: εὐλογημένη ἡ ἐρχομένη βασιλεία τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Δαυίδ, ὡσαννὰ ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις.

text_en: And he entered into Jerusalem , into the temple : and having viewed all things round about, when now the eventide had come, he went out to Bethania with the twelve.
text_la: Et introivit Jerosolymam in templum : et circumspectis omnibus, cum jam vespera esset hora, exiit in Bethaniam cum duodecim.
text_pt: E Jesus entrou em Jerusalém, no templo, e, tendo visto tudo em redor, como fosse já tarde, saiu para Betânia com os doze.
text_el: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα εἰς τὸ ἱερόν: καὶ περιβλεψάμενος πάντα, ὀψὲ ἤδη οὔσης τῆς ὥρας, ἐξῆλθεν εἰς Βηθανίαν μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα.

text_en: And the next day when they came out from Bethania , he was hungry.
text_la: Et alia die cum exirent a Bethania, esuriit.
text_pt: E, no dia seguinte, quando saíram de Betânia, teve fome.
text_el: Καὶ τῇ ἐπαύριον ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Βηθανίας ἐπείνασεν.

text_en: And when he had seen afar off a fig tree having leaves, he came, if perhaps he might find anything on it. And when he had come to it, he found nothing but leaves. For it was not the time for figs.
text_la: Cumque vidisset a longe ficum habentem folia, venit si quid forte inveniret in ea : et cum venisset ad eam, nihil invenit præter folia : non enim erat tempus ficorum.
text_pt: E, vendo de longe uma figueira que tinha folhas, foi ver se nela acharia alguma coisa; e, chegando a ela, não achou senão folhas, porque não era tempo de figos.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν συκῆν ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἔχουσαν φύλλα, ἦλθεν εἰ ἄρα τι εὑρήσει ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐπ' αὐτὴν οὐδὲν εὗρεν εἰ μὴ φύλλα: ὁ γὰρ καιρὸς οὐκ ἦν σύκων.

text_en: And answering he said to it: May no man hereafter eat fruit of you any more for ever! And his disciples heard it.
text_la: Et respondens dixit ei : Jam non amplius in æternum ex te fructum quisquam manducet. Et audiebant discipuli ejus.
text_pt: E Jesus, falando, disse à figueira: Nunca mais coma alguém fruto de ti. E os seus discípulos ouviram isto.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῇ: μηκέτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐκ σοῦ μηδεὶς καρπὸν φάγοι. καὶ ἤκουον οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And they came to Jerusalem . And when he was entered into the temple , he began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple : and over threw the tables of the moneychangers and the chairs of them that sold doves.
text_la: Et veniunt in Jerosolymam. Et cum introisset in templum, cœpit ejicere vendentes et ementes in templo : et mensas numulariorum, et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit:
text_pt: E vieram a Jerusalém; e Jesus, entrando no templo, começou a expulsar os que vendiam e compravam no templo; e derrubou as mesas dos cambiadores e as cadeiras dos que vendiam pombas.
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα. καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἤρξατο ἐκβάλλειν τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ τοὺς ἀγοράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, καὶ τὰς τραπέζας τῶν κολλυβιστῶν καὶ τὰς καθέδρας τῶν πωλούντων τὰς περιστερὰς κατέστρεψεν,

text_en: And he suffered not that any man should carry a vessel through the temple .
text_la: et non sinebat ut quisquam transferret vas per templum:
text_pt: E não consentia que alguém levasse algum vaso pelo templo.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν ἵνα τις διενέγκῃ σκεῦος διὰ τοῦ ἱεροῦ,

text_en: And he taught, saying to them: Is it not written: My house shall be called the house of prayer to all nations, but you have made it a den of thieves .
text_la: et docebat, dicens eis : Nonne scriptum est : Quia domus mea, domus orationis vocabitur omnibus gentibus? vos autem fecistis eam speluncam latronum.
text_pt: E os ensinava, dizendo: Não está escrito: A minha casa será chamada, por todas as nações, casa de oração? Mas vós a tendes feito covil de ladrões.
text_el: καὶ ἐδίδασκεν καὶ ἔλεγεν οὐ γέγραπται ὅτι ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς κληθήσεται πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν; ὑμεῖς δὲ πεποιήκατε αὐτὸν σπήλαιον λῃστῶν.

text_en: Which when the chief priests and the scribes had heard, they sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because the whole multitude was in admiration at his doctrine.
text_la: Quo audito principes sacerdotum et scribæ, quærebant quomodo eum perderent : timebant enim eum, quoniam universa turba admirabatur super doctrina ejus.
text_pt: E os escribas e príncipes dos sacerdotes, tendo ouvido isto, buscavam ocasião para o matar; pois eles o temiam, porque toda a multidão estava admirada acerca da sua doutrina.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς, καὶ ἐζήτουν πῶς αὐτὸν ἀπολέσωσιν: ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ αὐτόν, πᾶς γὰρ ὁ ὄχλος ἐξεπλήσσετο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And when evening had come, he went forth out of the city.
text_la: Et cum vespera facta esset, egrediebatur de civitate.
text_pt: E, sendo já tarde, saiu para fora da cidade.
text_el: Καὶ ὅταν ὀψὲ ἐγένετο, ἐξεπορεύοντο ἔξω τῆς πόλεως.

text_en: And when they passed by in the morning they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
text_la: Et cum mane transirent, viderunt ficum aridam factam a radicibus.
text_pt: E eles, passando pela manhã, viram que a figueira se tinha secado desde as raízes.
text_el: Καὶ παραπορευόμενοι πρωῒ εἶδον τὴν συκῆν ἐξηραμμένην ἐκ ῥιζῶν.

text_en: And Peter remembering, said to him: Rabbi, behold the fig tree which you cursed is withered away.
text_la: Et recordatus Petrus, dixit ei : Rabbi, ecce ficus, cui maledixisti, aruit.
text_pt: E Pedro, lembrando-se, disse-lhe: Mestre, eis que a figueira, que tu amaldiçoaste, se secou.
text_el: καὶ ἀναμνησθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος λέγει αὐτῷ, ῥαββί, ἴδε ἡ συκῆ ἣν κατηράσω ἐξήρανται.

text_en: And Jesus answering, says to them: Have the faith of God .
text_la: Et respondens Jesus ait illis: Habete fidem Dei.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Tende fé em Deus;
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς, ἔχετε πίστιν θεοῦ,

text_en: Amen I say to you that whosoever shall say to this mountain, Be removed and be cast into the sea, and shall not stagger in his heart, but be believe that whatsoever he says shall be done; it shall be done unto him.
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quia quicumque dixerit huic monti : Tollere, et mittere in mare, et non hæsitaverit in corde suo, sed crediderit, quia quodcumque dixerit fiat, fiet ei.
text_pt: Porque em verdade vos digo que qualquer que disser a este monte: Ergue-te e lança-te no mar, e não duvidar em seu coração, mas crer que se fará aquilo que diz, tudo o que disser lhe será feito.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ: ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ μὴ διακριθῇ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ πιστεύῃ ὅτι ὃ λαλεῖ γίνεται, ἔσται αὐτῷ.

text_en: Therefore I say unto you, all things, whatsoever you ask when you pray , believe that you shall receive: and they shall come unto you.
text_la: Propterea dico vobis, omnia quæcumque orantes petitis, credite quia accipietis, et evenient vobis.
text_pt: Por isso vos digo que todas as coisas que pedirdes, orando, crede receber, e tê-las-eis.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν, πάντα ὅσα προσεύχεσθε καὶ αἰτεῖσθε, πιστεύετε ὅτι ἐλάβετε, καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν.

text_en: And when you shall stand to pray , forgive, if you have aught against any man : that your Father also, who is in heaven , may forgive you your sins .
text_la: Et cum stabitis ad orandum, dimittite si quis habetis adversus aliquem : ut et Pater vester, qui in cælis est, dimittat vobis peccata vestra.
text_pt: E, quando estiverdes orando, perdoai, se tendes alguma coisa contra alguém, para que vosso Pai, que está nos céus, vos perdoe as vossas ofensas.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν στήκετε προσευχόμενοι, ἀφίετε εἴ τι ἔχετε κατά τινος, ἵνα καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἀφῇ ὑμῖν τὰ παραπτώματα ὑμῶν.

text_en: But if you will not forgive, neither will your father that is in heaven forgive you your sins .
text_la: Quod si vos non dimiseritis : nec Pater vester, qui in cælis est, dimittet vobis peccata vestra.
text_pt: Mas, se vós não perdoardes, também vosso Pai, que está nos céus, vos não perdoará as vossas ofensas.

text_en: And they come again to Jerusalem . And when he was walking in the temple , there come to him the chief priests and the scribes and the ancients.
text_la: Et veniunt rursus Jerosolymam. Et cum ambularet in templo, accedunt ad eum summi sacerdotes, et scribæ, et seniores:
text_pt: E tornaram a Jerusalém, e, andando ele pelo templo, os principais dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os anciãos, se aproximaram dele.
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχονται πάλιν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα. καὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ περιπατοῦντος αὐτοῦ ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι

text_en: And they say to him: By what authority do you these things? And who has given you this authority that you should do these things?
text_la: et dicunt ei : In qua potestate hæc facis? et quis dedit tibi hanc potestatem ut ista facias?
text_pt: E lhe disseram: Com que autoridade fazes tu estas coisas? ou quem te deu tal autoridade para fazer estas coisas?
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ: ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς; ἢ τίς σοι ἔδωκεν τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἵνα ταῦτα ποιῇς;

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to them: I will also ask you one word. And answer you me: and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
text_la: Jesus autem respondens, ait illis : Interrogabo vos et ego unum verbum, et respondete mihi : et dicam vobis in qua potestate hæc faciam.
text_pt: Mas Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Também eu vos perguntarei uma coisa, e respondei-me; e então vos direi com que autoridade faço estas coisas:
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἐπερωτήσω ὑμᾶς ἕνα λόγον, καὶ ἀποκρίθητέ μοι, καὶ ἐρῶ ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ:

text_en: The baptism of John , was it from heaven or from men ? Answer me.
text_la: Baptismus Joannis, de cælo erat, an ex hominibus? Respondete mihi.
text_pt: O batismo de João era do céu ou dos homens? respondei-me.
text_el: τὸ βάπτισμα τὸ Ἰωάννου ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἦν ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων; ἀποκρίθητέ μοι.

text_en: But they thought with themselves, saying: If we say, From heaven ; he will say, Why then did you not believe him?
text_la: At illi cogitabant secum, dicentes : Si dixerimus : De cælo, dicet : Quare ergo non credidistis ei?
text_pt: E eles arrazoavam entre si, dizendo: Se dissermos: Do céu, ele nos dirá: Então por que o não crestes?
text_el: καὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντες: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν: ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ: διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;

text_en: If we say, From men , we fear the people. For all men counted John that he was a prophet indeed.
text_la: Si dixerimus : Ex hominibus, timemus populum : omnes enim habebant Joannem quia vere propheta esset.
text_pt: Se, porém, dissermos: Dos homens, tememos o povo. Porque todos sustentavam que João verdadeiramente era profeta.
text_el: ἀλλὰ εἴπωμεν: ἐξ ἀνθρώπων; ἐφοβοῦντο τὸν ὄχλον: ἅπαντες γὰρ εἶχον τὸν Ἰωάννην ὄντως ὅτι προφήτης ἦν.

text_en: And they answering, say to Jesus : We know not. And Jesus answering, says to them: Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
text_la: Et respondentes dicunt Jesu : Nescimus. Et respondens Jesus ait illis : Neque ego dico vobis in qua potestate hæc faciam.
text_pt: E, respondendo, disseram a Jesus: Não sabemos. E Jesus lhes replicou: Também eu vos não direi com que autoridade faço estas coisas.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγουσιν: οὐκ οἴδαμεν. καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς: οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.

text_en: And he began to speak to them in parables : A certain man planted a vineyard and made a hedge about it and dug a place for the winefat and built a tower and let it to husbandmen: and went into a far country.
text_la: Et cœpit illis in parabolis loqui : Vineam pastinavit homo, et circumdedit sepem, et fodit lacum, et ædificavit turrim, et locavit eam agricolis, et peregre profectus est.
text_pt: E começou a falar-lhes por parábolas: Um homem plantou uma vinha, e cercou-a de um valado, e fundou nela um lagar, e edificou uma torre, e arrendou-a a uns lavradores, e partiu para fora da terra.
text_el: Καὶ ἤρξατο αὐτοῖς ἐν παραβολαῖς λαλεῖν. ἀμπελῶνα ἄνθρωπος ἐφύτευσεν, καὶ περιέθηκεν φραγμὸν καὶ ὤρυξεν ὑπολήνιον καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πύργον, καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν.

text_en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant to receive of the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
text_la: Et misit ad agricolas in tempore servum ut ab agricolis acciperet de fructu vineæ.
text_pt: E, chegado o tempo, mandou um servo aos lavradores para que recebesse, dos lavradores, do fruto da vinha.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς τῷ καιρῷ δοῦλον, ἵνα παρὰ τῶν γεωργῶν λάβῃ ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος:

text_en: Who, having laid hands on him, beat and sent him away empty.
text_la: Qui apprehensum eum ceciderunt, et dimiserunt vacuum.
text_pt: Mas estes, apoderando-se dele, o feriram e o mandaram embora vazio.
text_el: καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὸν ἔδειραν καὶ ἀπέστειλαν κενόν.

text_en: And again he sent to them another servant: and him they wounded in the head and used him reproachfully.
text_la: Et iterum misit ad illos alium servum : et illum in capite vulneraverunt, et contumeliis affecerunt.
text_pt: E tornou a enviar-lhes outro servo; e eles, apedrejando-o, o feriram na cabeça, e o mandaram embora, tendo-o afrontado.
text_el: καὶ πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἄλλον δοῦλον: κἀκεῖνον ἐκεφαλίωσαν καὶ ἠτίμασαν.

text_en: And again he sent another, and him they killed: and many others, of whom some they beat, and others they killed.
text_la: Et rursum alium misit, et illum occiderunt : et plures alios : quosdam cædentes, alios vero occidentes.
text_pt: E tornou a enviar-lhes outro, e a este mataram; e a outros muitos, dos quais a uns feriram e a outros mataram.
text_el: καὶ ἄλλον ἀπέστειλεν: κἀκεῖνον ἀπέκτειναν, καὶ πολλοὺς ἄλλους, οὓς μὲν δέροντες, οὓς δὲ ἀποκτέννοντες.

text_en: Therefore, having yet one son, most dear to him, he also sent him unto them last of all, saying: They will reverence my son.
text_la: Adhuc ergo unum habens filium carissimum, et illum misit ad eos novissimum, dicens : Quia reverebuntur filium meum.
text_pt: Tendo ele, pois, ainda um seu filho amado, enviou-o também a estes por derradeiro, dizendo: Ao menos terão respeito ao meu filho.
text_el: ἔτι ἕνα εἶχεν, υἱὸν ἀγαπητόν: ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν ἔσχατον πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων ὅτι ἐντραπήσονται τὸν υἱόν μου.

text_en: But the husbandmen said one to another: This is the heir. Come let us kill him and the inheritance shall be ours.
text_la: Coloni autem dixerunt ad invicem : Hic est hæres : venite, occidamus eum : et nostra erit hæreditas.
text_pt: Mas aqueles lavradores disseram entre si: Este é o herdeiro; vamos, matemo-lo, e a herança será nossa.
text_el: ἐκεῖνοι δὲ οἱ γεωργοὶ πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς εἶπαν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος: δεῦτε ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτόν, καὶ ἡμῶν ἔσται ἡ κληρονομία.

text_en: And laying hold on him, they killed him and cast him out of the vineyard.
text_la: Et apprehendentes eum, occiderunt : et ejecerunt extra vineam.
text_pt: E, pegando dele, o mataram, e o lançaram fora da vinha.
text_el: καὶ λαβόντες ἀπέκτειναν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος.

text_en: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy those husbandmen and will give the vineyard to others.
text_la: Quid ergo faciet dominus vineæ? Veniet, et perdet colonos, et dabit vineam aliis.
text_pt: Que fará, pois, o senhor da vinha? Virá, e destruirá os lavradores, e dará a vinha a outros.
text_el: τί ποιήσει ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος; ἐλεύσεται καὶ ἀπολέσει τοὺς γεωργούς, καὶ δώσει τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἄλλοις.

text_en: And have you not read this scripture , The stone which the builders rejected, the same is made the head of the corner :
text_la: Nec scripturam hanc legistis : Lapidem quem reprobaverunt ædificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli:
text_pt: Ainda não lestes esta Escritura:A pedra, que os edificadores rejeitaram,Esta foi posta por cabeça de esquina;
text_el: οὐδὲ τὴν γραφὴν ταύτην ἀνέγνωτε: λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας:

text_en: By the Lord has this been done, and it is wonderful in our eyes.
text_la: a Domino factum est istud, et est mirabile in oculis nostris?
text_pt: Isto foi feito pelo Senhor E é coisa maravilhosa aos nossos olhos?
text_el: παρὰ κυρίου ἐγένετο αὕτη καὶ ἔστιν θαυμαστὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν;

text_en: And they sought to lay hands on him: but they feared the people. For they knew that he spoke this parable to them. And leaving him, they went their way.
text_la: Et quærebant eum tenere : et timuerunt turbam : cognoverunt enim quoniam ad eos parabolam hanc dixerit. Et relicto eo abierunt.
text_pt: E buscavam prendê-lo, mas temiam a multidão; porque entendiam que contra eles dizia esta parábola; e, deixando-o, foram-se.
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν κρατῆσαι, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν ὄχλον: ἔγνωσαν γὰρ ὅτι πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὴν παραβολὴν εἶπεν. καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἀπῆλθον.

text_en: And they sent to him some of the Pharisees and of the Herodians: that they should catch him in his words.
text_la: Et mittunt ad eum quosdam ex pharisæis, et herodianis, ut eum caperent in verbo.
text_pt: E enviaram-lhe alguns dos fariseus e dos herodianos, para que o apanhassem nalguma palavra.
text_el: Καὶ ἀποστέλλουσιν πρὸς αὐτόν τινας τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ τῶν Ἡρῳδιανῶν ἵνα αὐτὸν ἀγρεύσωσιν λόγῳ.

text_en: Who coming, say to him: Master, we know that you are a true speaker and care not for any man ; for you regard not the person of men , but teach the way of God in truth . Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar ? Or shall we not give it?
text_la: Qui venientes dicunt ei : Magister, scimus quia verax es, et non curas quemquam : nec enim vides in faciem hominum, sed in veritate viam Dei doces. Licet dari tributum Cæsari, an non dabimus?
text_pt: E, chegando eles, disseram-lhe: Mestre, sabemos que és homem de verdade, e de ninguém se te dá, porque não olhas à aparência dos homens, antes com verdade ensinas o caminho de Deus; é lícito dar o tributo a César, ou não? Daremos, ou não daremos?
text_el: καὶ ἐλθόντες λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: διδάσκαλε, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀληθὴς εἶ καὶ οὐ μέλει σοι περὶ οὐδενός: οὐ γὰρ βλέπεις εἰς πρόσωπον ἀνθρώπων, ἀλλ' ἐπ' ἀληθείας τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ θεοῦ διδάσκεις: ἔξεστιν δοῦναι κῆνσον Καίσαρι ἢ οὔ; δῶμεν ἢ μὴ δῶμεν;

text_en: Who knowing their wiliness, says to them: Why tempt you me? Bring me a penny that I may see it.
text_la: Qui sciens versutiam illorum, ait illos : Quid me tentatis? afferte mihi denarium ut videam.
text_pt: Então ele, conhecendo a sua hipocrisia, disse-lhes: Por que me tentais? Trazei-me uma moeda, para que a veja.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἰδὼς αὐτῶν τὴν ὑπόκρισιν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τί με πειράζετε; φέρετέ μοι δηνάριον ἵνα ἴδω.

text_en: And they brought it him. And he says to them: Whose is this image and inscription? They say to him, Caesar's .
text_la: At illi attulerunt ei. Et ait illis : Cujus est imago hæc, et inscriptio? Dicunt ei : Cæsaris.
text_pt: E eles lha trouxeram. E disse-lhes: De quem é esta imagem e inscrição? E eles lhe disseram: De César.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἤνεγκαν. καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: τίνος ἡ εἰκὼν αὕτη καὶ ἡ ἐπιγραφή; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: Καίσαρος.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to them: Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's and to God the things that are God's . And they marvelled at him.
text_la: Respondens autem Jesus dixit illis : Reddite igitur quæ sunt Cæsaris, Cæsari : et quæ sunt Dei, Deo. Et mirabantur super eo.
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Dai pois a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus. E maravilharam-se dele.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τὰ Καίσαρος ἀπόδοτε Καίσαρι καὶ τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τῷ θεῷ. καὶ ἐξεθαύμαζον ἐπ' αὐτῷ.

text_en: And there came to him the Sadducees , who say there is no resurrection. And they asked him, saying:
text_la: Et venerunt ad eum sadducæi, qui dicunt resurrectionem non esse : et interrogabant eum, dicentes:
text_pt: Então os saduceus, que dizem que não há ressurreição, aproximaram-se dele, e perguntaram-lhe, dizendo:
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχονται Σαδδουκαῖοι πρὸς αὐτόν, οἵτινες λέγουσιν ἀνάστασιν μὴ εἶναι, καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες:

text_en: Master, Moses wrote unto us that if any man's brother die and leave his wife behind him and leave no children, his brother should take his wife and raise up seed to his brother.
text_la: Magister, Moyses nobis scripsit, ut si cujus frater mortuus fuerit, et dimiserit uxorem, et filios non reliquerit, accipiat frater ejus uxorem ipsius, et resuscitet semen fratri suo.
text_pt: Mestre, Moisés nos escreveu que, se morresse o irmão de alguém, e deixasse a mulher e não deixasse filhos, seu irmão tomasse a mulher dele, e suscitasse descendência a seu irmão.
text_el: διδάσκαλε, Μωϋσῆς ἔγραψεν ἡμῖν ὅτι ἐάν τινος ἀδελφὸς ἀποθάνῃ καὶ καταλίπῃ γυναῖκα καὶ μὴ ἀφῇ τέκνον, ἵνα λάβῃ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ ἐξαναστήσῃ σπέρμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife and died leaving no issue.
text_la: Septem ergo fratres erant : et primus accepit uxorem, et mortuus est non relicto semine.
text_pt: Ora, havia sete irmãos, e o primeiro tomou a mulher, e morreu sem deixar descendência;
text_el: ἑπτὰ ἀδελφοὶ ἦσαν: καὶ ὁ πρῶτος ἔλαβεν γυναῖκα, καὶ ἀποθνῄσκων οὐκ ἀφῆκεν σπέρμα.

text_en: And the second took her and died: and neither did he leave any issue. And the third in like manner.
text_la: Et secundus accepit eam, et mortuus est : et nec iste reliquit semen. Et tertius similiter.
text_pt: E o segundo também a tomou e morreu, e nem este deixou descendência; e o terceiro da mesma maneira.
text_el: καὶ ὁ δεύτερος ἔλαβεν αὐτήν, καὶ ἀπέθανεν μὴ καταλιπὼν σπέρμα: καὶ ὁ τρίτος ὡσαύτως:

text_en: And the seven all took her in like manner and did not leave issue. Last of all the woman also died.
text_la: Et acceperunt eam similiter septem : et non reliquerunt semen. Novissima omnium defuncta est et mulier.
text_pt: E tomaram-na os sete, sem, contudo, terem deixado descendência. Finalmente, depois de todos, morreu também a mulher.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ οὐκ ἀφῆκαν σπέρμα. ἔσχατον πάντων καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἀπέθανεν.

text_en: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise again, whose wife shall she be of them? For the seven had her to wife.
text_la: In resurrectione ergo cum resurrexerint, cujus de his erit uxor? septem enim habuerunt eam uxorem.
text_pt: Na ressurreição, pois, quando ressuscitarem, de qual destes será a mulher? porque os sete a tiveram por mulher.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει, τίνος αὐτῶν ἔσται γυνή; οἱ γὰρ ἑπτὰ ἔσχον αὐτὴν γυναῖκα.

text_en: And Jesus answering, says to them: Do not therefore err , because you know not the scriptures nor the power of God ?
text_la: Et respondens Jesus, ait illis : Nonne ideo erratis, non scientes Scripturas, neque virtutem Dei?
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse-lhes: Porventura não errais vós em razão de não saberdes as Escrituras nem o poder de Deus?
text_el: ἔφη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: οὐ διὰ τοῦτο πλανᾶσθε μὴ εἰδότες τὰς γραφὰς μηδὲ τὴν δύναμιν τοῦ θεοῦ;

text_en: For when they shall rise again from the dead , they shall neither marry , nor be married , but are as the angels in heaven .
text_la: Cum enim a mortuis resurrexerint, neque nubent, neque nubentur, sed sunt sicut angeli in cælis.
text_pt: Porquanto, quando ressuscitarem dentre os mortos, nem casarão, nem se darão em casamento, mas serão como os anjos que estão nos céus.
text_el: ὅταν γὰρ ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῶσιν, οὔτε γαμοῦσιν οὔτε γαμίζονται, ἀλλ' εἰσὶν ὡς ἄγγελοι ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

text_en: And as concerning the dead that they rise again have you not read in the book of Moses , how in the bush God spoke to him, saying: I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob ?
text_la: De mortuis autem quod resurgant, non legistis in libro Moysi, super rubum, quomodo dixerit illi Deus, inquiens : Ego sum Deus Abraham, et Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob?
text_pt: E, acerca dos mortos que houverem de ressuscitar, não tendes lido no livro de Moisés como Deus lhe falou na sarça, dizendo: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão, e o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó?
text_el: περὶ δὲ τῶν νεκρῶν, ὅτι ἐγείρονται οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ἐν τῇ βίβλῳ Μωϋσέως ἐπὶ τοῦ βάτου πῶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς λέγων: ἐγὼ ὁ θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ θεὸς Ἰσαὰκ καὶ θεὸς Ἰακώβ;

text_en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You therefore do greatly err .
text_la: Non est Deus mortuorum, sed vivorum. Vos ergo multum erratis.
text_pt: Ora, Deus não é de mortos, mas sim, é Deus de vivos. Por isso vós errais muito.
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν θεὸς νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων. πολὺ πλανᾶσθε.

text_en: And there came one of the scribes that had heard them reasoning together, and seeing that he had answered them well, asked him which was the first commandment of all.
text_la: Et accessit unus de scribis, qui audierat illos conquirentes, et videns quoniam bene illis responderit, interrogavit eum quod esset primum omnium mandatum.
text_pt: Aproximou-se dele um dos escribas que os tinha ouvido disputar, e sabendo que lhes tinha respondido bem, perguntou-lhe: Qual é o primeiro de todos os mandamentos?
text_el: Καὶ προσελθὼν εἷς τῶν γραμματέων, ἀκούσας αὐτῶν συζητούντων, εἰδὼς ὅτι καλῶς ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς, ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτόν: ποία ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη πάντων;

text_en: And Jesus answered him: The first commandment of all is, Hear, O Israel : the Lord your God is one God .
text_la: Jesus autem respondit ei : Quia primum omnium mandatum est : Audi Israël, Dominus Deus tuus, Deus unus est:
text_pt: E Jesus respondeu-lhe: O primeiro de todos os mandamentos é: Ouve, Israel, o Senhor nosso Deus é o único Senhor.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι πρώτη ἐστίν: ἄκουε Ἰσραήλ, κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν κύριος εἷς ἐστιν,

text_en: And you shall love the Lord your God with your whole heart and with your whole soul and with your whole mind and with your whole strength. This is the first commandment.
text_la: et diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, et ex tota anima tua, et ex tota mente tua, et ex tota virtute tua. Hoc est primum mandatum.
text_pt: Amarás, pois, ao Senhor teu Deus de todo o teu coração, e de toda a tua alma, e de todo o teu entendimento, e de todas as tuas forças; este é o primeiro mandamento.
text_el: καὶ ἀγαπήσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐξ ὅλης καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς διανοίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ἰσχύος σου.

text_en: And the second is like to it: You shall love your neighbour as yourself. There is no other commandment greater than these.
text_la: Secundum autem simile est illi : Diliges proximum tuum tamquam teipsum. Majus horum aliud mandatum non est.
text_pt: E o segundo, semelhante a este, é: Amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo. Não há outro mandamento maior do que estes.
text_el: δευτέρα αὕτη: ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν. μείζων τούτων ἄλλη ἐντολὴ οὐκ ἔστιν.

text_en: And the scribe said to him: Well, Master, you have said in truth that there is one God and there is no other besides him.
text_la: Et ait illi scriba : Bene, Magister, in veritate dixisti, quia unus est Deus, et non est alius præter eum.
text_pt: E o escriba lhe disse: Muito bem, Mestre, e com verdade disseste que há um só Deus, e que não há outro além dele;
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ γραμματεύς: καλῶς, διδάσκαλε, ἐπ' ἀληθείας εἶπες ὅτι εἷς ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλος πλὴν αὐτοῦ:

text_en: And that he should be loved with the whole heart and with the whole understanding and with the whole soul and with the whole strength. And to love one's neighbour as one's self is a greater thing than all holocausts and sacrifices .
text_la: Et ut diligatur ex toto corde, et ex toto intellectu, et ex tota anima, et ex tota fortitudine, et diligere proximum tamquam seipsum, majus est omnibus holocautomatibus, et sacrificiis.
text_pt: E que amá-lo de todo o coração, e de todo o entendimento, e de toda a alma, e de todas as forças, e amar o próximo como a si mesmo, é mais do que todos os holocaustos e sacrifícios.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἀγαπᾶν αὐτὸν ἐξ ὅλης καρδίας καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς συνέσεως καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ἰσχύος καὶ τὸ ἀγαπᾶν τὸν πλησίον ὡς ἑαυτὸν περισσότερόν ἐστιν πάντων τῶν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων καὶ θυσιῶν.

text_en: And Jesus seeing that he had answered wisely, said to him: You are not far from the kingdom of God . And no man after that dared ask him any question.
text_la: Jesus autem videns quod sapienter respondisset, dixit illi : Non es longe a regno Dei. Et nemo jam audebat eum interrogare.
text_pt: E Jesus, vendo que havia respondido sabiamente, disse-lhe: Não estás longe do reino de Deus. E já ninguém ousava perguntar-lhe mais nada.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ὅτι νουνεχῶς ἀπεκρίθη, εἶπεν αὐτῷ: οὐ μακρὰν [εἶ] ἀπὸ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ. καὶ οὐδεὶς οὐκέτι ἐτόλμα αὐτὸν ἐπερωτῆσαι.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said, teaching in the temple : How do the scribes say that Christ is the son of David ?
text_la: Et respondens Jesus dicebat, docens in templo : Quomodo dicunt scribæ Christum filium esse David?
text_pt: E, falando Jesus, dizia, ensinando no templo: Como dizem os escribas que o Cristo é filho de Davi?
text_el: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἔλεγεν διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ: πῶς λέγουσιν οἱ γραμματεῖς ὅτι ὁ Χριστὸς υἱὸς Δαυίδ ἐστιν;

text_en: For David himself says by the Holy Ghost : The Lord said to my Lord: Sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool.
text_la: Ipse enim David dicit in Spiritu Sancto : Dixit Dominus Domino meo : Sede a dextris meis, donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.
text_pt: O próprio Davi disse pelo Espírito Santo:O Senhor disse ao meu Senhor:Assenta-te à minha direita Até que eu ponha os teus inimigos por escabelo dos teus pés.
text_el: αὐτὸς Δαυὶδ εἶπεν ἐν τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἁγίῳ: εἶπεν κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου: κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν σου.

text_en: David therefore himself calls him Lord. And whence is he then his son? And a great multitude heard him gladly.
text_la: Ipse ergo David dicit eum Dominum, et unde est filius ejus? Et multa turba eum libenter audivit.
text_pt: Pois, se Davi mesmo lhe chama Senhor, como é logo seu filho? E a grande multidão o ouvia de boa vontade.
text_el: αὐτὸς Δαυὶδ λέγει αὐτὸν κύριον, καὶ πόθεν αὐτοῦ ἐστιν υἱός; καὶ ὁ πολὺς ὄχλος ἤκουεν αὐτοῦ ἡδέως.

text_en: And he said to them in his doctrine: Beware of the scribes , who love to walk in long robes and to be saluted in the marketplace,
text_la: Et dicebat eis in doctrina sua : Cavete a scribis, qui volunt in stolis ambulare, et salutari in foro,
text_pt: E, ensinando-os, dizia-lhes: Guardai-vos dos escribas, que gostam de andar com vestes compridas, e das saudações nas praças,
text_el: Καὶ ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ ἔλεγεν: βλέπετε ἀπὸ τῶν γραμματέων τῶν θελόντων ἐν στολαῖς περιπατεῖν καὶ ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς

text_en: and to sit in the first chairs in the synagogues and to have the highest places at suppers:
text_la: et in primis cathedris sedere in synagogis, et primos discubitus in cœnis:
text_pt: E das primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas, e dos primeiros assentos nas ceias;
text_el: καὶ πρωτοκαθεδρίας ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ πρωτοκλισίας ἐν τοῖς δείπνοις:

text_en: Who devour the houses of widows under the pretence of long prayer . These shall receive greater judgment.
text_la: qui devorant domos viduarum sub obtentu prolixæ orationis : hi accipient prolixius judicium.
text_pt: Que devoram as casas das viúvas, e isso com pretexto de largas orações. Estes receberão mais grave condenação.
text_el: οἱ κατεσθίοντες τὰς οἰκίας τῶν χηρῶν καὶ προφάσει μακρὰ προσευχόμενοι, οὗτοι λήμψονται περισσότερον κρίμα.

text_en: And Jesus sitting over against the treasury, beheld how the people cast money into the treasury. And many that were rich cast in much.
text_la: Et sedens Jesus contra gazophylacium, aspiciebat quomodo turba jactaret æs in gazophylacium, et multi divites jactabant multa.
text_pt: E, estando Jesus assentado defronte da arca do tesouro, observava a maneira como a multidão lançava o dinheiro na arca do tesouro; e muitos ricos deitavam muito.
text_el: Καὶ καθίσας κατέναντι τοῦ γαζοφυλακίου ἐθεώρει πῶς ὁ ὄχλος βάλλει χαλκὸν εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον: καὶ πολλοὶ πλούσιοι ἔβαλλον πολλά,

text_en: And there came a certain poor widow : and she cast in two mites, which make a farthing.
text_la: Cum venisset autem vidua una pauper, misit duo minuta, quod est quadrans,
text_pt: Vindo, porém, uma pobre viúva, deitou duas pequenas moedas, que valiam meio centavo.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθοῦσα μία χήρα πτωχὴ ἔβαλεν λεπτὰ δύο, ὅ ἐστιν κοδράντης.

text_en: And calling his disciples together, he says to them: Amen I say to you, this poor widow has cast in more than all they who have cast into the treasury.
text_la: et convocans discipulos suos, ait illis : Amen dico vobis, quoniam vidua hæc pauper plus omnibus misit, qui miserunt in gazophylacium.
text_pt: E, chamando os seus discípulos, disse-lhes: Em verdade vos digo que esta pobre viúva deitou mais do que todos os que deitaram na arca do tesouro;
text_el: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ χήρα αὕτη ἡ πτωχὴ πλεῖον πάντων ἔβαλεν τῶν βαλλόντων εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον:

text_en: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want cast in all she had, even her whole living.
text_la: Omnes enim ex eo, quod abundabat illis, miserunt : hæc vero de penuria sua omnia quæ habuit misit totum victum suum.
text_pt: Porque todos ali deitaram do que lhes sobejava, mas esta, da sua pobreza, deitou tudo o que tinha, todo o seu sustento.
text_el: πάντες γὰρ ἐκ τοῦ περισσεύοντος αὐτοῖς ἔβαλον, αὕτη δὲ ἐκ τῆς ὑστερήσεως αὐτῆς πάντα ὅσα εἶχεν ἔβαλεν, ὅλον τὸν βίον αὐτῆς.

text_en: And as he was going out of the temple , one of his disciples said to him: Master, behold what manner of stones and what buildings are here.
text_la: Et cum egrederetur de templo, ait illi unus ex discipulis suis : Magister, aspice quales lapides, et quales structuræ.
text_pt: E, saindo ele do templo, disse-lhe um dos seus discípulos: Mestre, olha que pedras, e que edifícios!
text_el: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ, λέγει αὐτῷ εἷς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ: διδάσκαλε, ἴδε ποταποὶ λίθοι καὶ ποταπαὶ οἰκοδομαί.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to him: Do you see all these great buildings? There shall not be left a stone upon a stone, that shall not be thrown down.
text_la: Et respondens Jesus, ait illi : Vides has omnes magnas ædificationes? Non relinquetur lapis super lapidem, qui non destruatur.
text_pt: E, respondendo Jesus, disse-lhe: Vês estes grandes edifícios? Não ficará pedra sobre pedra que não seja derrubada.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ: βλέπεις ταύτας τὰς μεγάλας οἰκοδομάς; οὐ μὴ ἀφεθῇ ὧδε λίθος ἐπὶ λίθον. ὃς οὐ μὴ καταλυθῇ.

text_en: And as he sat on the mount of Olivet over against the temple , Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him apart:
text_la: Et cum sederet in monte Olivarum contra templum, interrogabant eum separatim Petrus, et Jacobus, et Joannes, et Andreas:
text_pt: E, assentando-se ele no Monte das Oliveiras, defronte do templo, Pedro, e Tiago, e João e André lhe perguntaram em particular:
text_el: καὶ καθημένου αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν κατέναντι τοῦ ἱεροῦ, ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν κατ' ἰδίαν Πέτρος καὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀνδρέας:

text_en: Tell us, when shall these things be and what shall be the sign when all these things shall begin to be fulfilled?
text_la: Dic nobis, quando ista fient? et quod signum erit, quando hæc omnia incipient consummari?
text_pt: Dize-nos, quando serão essas coisas, e que sinal haverá quando todas elas estiverem para se cumprir.
text_el: εἰπὸν ἡμῖν, πότε ταῦτα ἔσται; καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν μέλλῃ ταῦτα συντελεῖσθαι πάντα;

text_en: And Jesus answering, began to say to them: Take heed lest any man deceive you.
text_la: Et respondens Jesus cœpit dicere illis: Videte ne quid vos seducat:
text_pt: E Jesus, respondendo-lhes, começou a dizer: Olhai que ninguém vos engane;
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἤρξατο λέγειν αὐτοῖς: βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς πλανήσῃ.

text_en: For many shall come in my name saying, I am he: and they shall deceive many.
text_la: multi enim venient in nomine meo, dicentes quia ego sum : et multos seducent.
text_pt: Porque muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: Eu sou o Cristo; e enganarão a muitos.
text_el: πολλοὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, λέγοντες ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ πολλοὺς πλανήσουσιν.

text_en: And when you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, fear not. For such things must needs be: but the end is not yet.
text_la: Cum audieritis autem bella, et opiniones bellorum, ne timueritis : oportet enim hæc fieri : sed nondum finis.
text_pt: E, quando ouvirdes de guerras e de rumores de guerras, não vos perturbeis; porque assim deve acontecer; mas ainda não será o fim.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκοὰς πολέμων, μὴ θροεῖσθε: δεῖ γενέσθαι, ἀλλ' οὔπω τὸ τέλος.

text_en: For nation shall rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places and famines. These things are the beginning of sorrows.
text_la: Exsurget enim gens contra gentem, et regnum super regnum, et erunt terræmotus per loca, et fames. Initium dolorum hæc.
text_pt: Porque se levantará nação contra nação, e reino contra reino, e haverá terremotos em diversos lugares, e haverá fomes e tribulações. Estas coisas sào os princípios das dores.
text_el: ἐγερθήσεται γὰρ ἔθνος ἐπ' ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν, ἔσονται σεισμοὶ κατὰ τόπους, ἔσονται λιμοί: ἀρχὴ ὠδίνων ταῦτα.

text_en: But look to yourselves. For they shall deliver you Up to councils: and in the synagogues you shall be beaten: and you shall stand before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony unto them.
text_la: Videte autem vosmetipsos. Tradent enim vos in consiliis, et in synagogis vapulabitis, et ante præsides et reges stabitis propter me, in testimonium illis.
text_pt: Mas olhai por vós mesmos, porque vos entregarão aos concílios e às sinagogas; e sereis açoitados, e sereis apresentados perante presidentes e reis, por amor de mim, para lhes servir de testemunho.
text_el: Βλέπετε δὲ ὑμεῖς ἑαυτούς: παραδώσουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς συνέδρια καὶ εἰς συναγωγὰς δαρήσεσθε καὶ ἐπὶ ἡγεμόνων καὶ βασιλέων σταθήσεσθε ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ, εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And unto all nations the gospel must first be preached.
text_la: Et in omnes gentes primum oportet prædicari Evangelium.
text_pt: Mas importa que o evangelho seja primeiramente pregado entre todas as nações.
text_el: καὶ εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη πρῶτον δεῖ κηρυχθῆναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον.

text_en: And when they shall lead you and deliver you up, be not thoughtful beforehand what you shall speak: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, speak that. For it is not you that speak, but the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Et cum duxerint vos tradentes, nolite præcogitare quid loquamini : sed quod datum vobis fuerit in illa hora, id loquimini : non enim vos estis loquentes, sed Spiritus Sanctus.
text_pt: Quando, pois, vos conduzirem e vos entregarem, não estejais solícitos de antemão pelo que haveis de dizer, nem premediteis; mas, o que vos for dado naquela hora, isso falai, porque não sois vós os que falais, mas o Espírito Santo.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν ἄγωσιν ὑμᾶς παραδιδόντες, μὴ προμεριμνᾶτε τί λαλήσητε, ἀλλ' ὃ ἐὰν δοθῇ ὑμῖν ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ, τοῦτο λαλεῖτε: οὐ γάρ ἐστε ὑμεῖς οἱ λαλοῦντες, ἀλλὰ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον.

text_en: And the brother shall betray his brother unto death, and the father his son; and children shall rise up against their parents and shall work their death.
text_la: Tradet autem frater fratrem in mortem, et pater filium : et consurgent filii in parentes, et morte afficient eos.
text_pt: E o irmão entregará à morte o irmão, e o pai ao filho; e levantar-se-ão os filhos contra os pais, e os farão morrer.
text_el: καὶ παραδώσει ἀδελφὸς ἀδελφὸν εἰς θάνατον καὶ πατὴρ τέκνον, καὶ ἐπαναστήσονται τέκνα ἐπὶ γονεῖς καὶ θανατώσουσιν αὐτούς.

text_en: And you shall be hated by all men for my name's sake. But he that shall endure unto the end, he shall be saved.
text_la: Et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum. Qui autem sustinuerit in finem, hic salvus erit.
text_pt: E sereis odiados por todos por amor do meu nome; mas quem perseverar até ao fim, esse será salvo.
text_el: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου: ὁ δὲ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος, οὗτος σωθήσεται.

text_en: And when you shall see the abomination of desolation , standing where it ought not (he that reads let him understand): then let them that are in Judea flee unto the mountains.
text_la: Cum autem videritis abominationem desolationis stantem, ubi non debet, qui legit, intelligat : tunc qui in Judæa sunt, fugiant in montes:
text_pt: Ora, quando vós virdes a abominação do assolamento, que foi predita por Daniel o profeta, estar onde não deve estar (quem lê, entenda), então os que estiverem na Judéia fujam para os montes.
text_el: Ὅταν δὲ ἴδητε τὸ βδέλυγμα τῆς ἐρημώσεως ἑστηκότα ὅπου οὐ δεῖ, ὁ ἀναγινώσκων νοείτω, τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη,

text_en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house nor enter therein to take anything out of the house.
text_la: et qui super tectum, ne descendat in domum, nec introëat ut tollat quid de domo sua:
text_pt: E o que estiver sobre o telhado não desça para casa, nem entre a tomar coisa alguma de sua casa;
text_el: ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος μὴ καταβάτω μηδὲ εἰσελθάτω τι ἆραί ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And let him that shall be in the field not turn back to take up his garment.
text_la: et qui in agro erit, non revertatur retro tollere vestimentum suum.
text_pt: E o que estiver no campo não volte atrás, para tomar as suas vestes.
text_el: καὶ ὁ εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἆραι τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And woe to them that are with child and that give suck in those days.
text_la: Væ autem prægnantibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus.
text_pt: Mas ai das grávidas, e das que criarem naqueles dias!
text_el: οὐαὶ δὲ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις.

text_en: But pray that these things happen not in winter.
text_la: Orate vero ut hieme non fiant.
text_pt: Orai, pois, para que a vossa fuga não suceda no inverno.
text_el: προσεύχεσθε δὲ ἵνα μὴ γένηται χειμῶνος:

text_en: For in those days shall be such tribulations as were not from the beginning of the creation which God created until now: neither shall be.
text_la: Erunt enim dies illi tribulationes tales quales non fuerunt ab initio creaturæ, quam condidit Deus usque nunc, neque fient.
text_pt: Porque naqueles dias haverá uma aflição tal, qual nunca houve desde o princípio da criação, que Deus criou, até agora, nem jamais haverá.
text_el: ἔσονται γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι θλῖψις οἵα οὐ γέγονεν τοιαύτη ἀπ' ἀρχῆς κτίσεως, ἣν ἔκτισεν ὁ θεὸς ἕως τοῦ νῦν καὶ οὐ μὴ γένηται.

text_en: And unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh should be saved: but, for the sake of the elect which he has chosen, he has shortened the days.
text_la: Et nisi breviasset Dominus dies, non fuisset salva omnis caro : sed propter electos, quos elegit, breviavit dies.
text_pt: E, se o Senhor não abreviasse aqueles dias, nenhuma carne se salvaria; mas, por causa dos eleitosque escolheu, abreviou aqueles dias.
text_el: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐκολόβωσεν κύριος τὰς ἡμέρας, οὐκ ἂν ἐσώθη πᾶσα σάρξ: ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἐκολόβωσεν τὰς ἡμέρας.

text_en: And then if any man shall say to you: Lo, here is Christ . Lo, he is here: do not believe .
text_la: Et tunc si quis vobis dixerit : Ecce hic est Christus, ecce illic, ne credideritis.
text_pt: E então, se alguém vos disser: Eis aqui o Cristo; ou: Ei-lo ali; não acrediteis.
text_el: καὶ τότε ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ: ἴδε ὧδε ὁ Χριστός, ἴδε ἐκεῖ, μὴ πιστεύετε.

text_en: For there will rise up false Christs and false prophets : and they shall show signs and wonders , to seduce (if it were possible) even the elect .
text_la: Exsurgent enim pseudochristi et pseudoprophetæ, et dabunt signa et portenta ad seducendos, si fieri potest, etiam electos.
text_pt: Porque se levantarão falsos cristos, e falsos profetas, e farão sinais e prodígios, para enganarem, se for possível, até os escolhidos.
text_el: ἐγερθήσονται γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται καὶ δώσουσιν σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα πρὸς τὸ ἀποπλανᾶν, εἰ δυνατόν, τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς.

text_en: Take you heed therefore: behold, I have foretold you all things.
text_la: Vos ergo videte: ecce prædixi vobis omnia.
text_pt: Mas vós vede; eis que de antemão vos tenho dito tudo.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ βλέπετε: προείρηκα ὑμῖν πάντα.

text_en: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened and the moon shall not give her light.
text_la: Sed in illis diebus, post tribulationem illam, sol contenebrabitur, et luna non dabit splendorem suum:
text_pt: Ora, naqueles dias, depois daquela aflição, o sol se escurecerá, e a lua não dará a sua luz.
text_el: Ἀλλὰ ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν ἐκείνην ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται, καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φέγγος αὐτῆς,

text_en: And the stars of heaven shall be falling down and the powers that are in heaven shall be moved.
text_la: et stellæ cæli erunt decidentes, et virtutes, quæ in cælis sunt, movebuntur.
text_pt: E as estrelas cairão do céu, e as forças que estão nos céus serão abaladas.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες ἔσονται ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πίπτοντες, καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς σαλευθήσονται.

text_en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds, with great power and glory .
text_la: Et tunc videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nubibus cum virtute multa et gloria.
text_pt: E então verão vir o Filho do homem nas nuvens, com grande poder e glória.
text_el: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλαις μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς καὶ δόξης.

text_en: And then shall he send his angels and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven .
text_la: Et tunc mittet angelos suos, et congregabit electos suos a quatuor ventis, a summo terræ usque ad summum cæli.
text_pt: E ele enviará os seus anjos, e ajuntará os seus escolhidos, desde os quatro ventos, da extremidade da terra até a extremidade do céu.
text_el: καὶ τότε ἀποστελεῖ τοὺς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἐπισυνάξει τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπ' ἄκρου γῆς ἕως ἄκρου οὐρανοῦ.

text_en: Now of the fig tree learn a parable . When the branch thereof is now tender and the leaves have come forth, you know that summer is very near.
text_la: A ficu autem discite parabolam. Cum jam ramus ejus tener fuerit, et nata fuerint folia, cognoscitis quia in proximo sit æstas:
text_pt: Aprendei, pois, a parábola da figueira: Quando já o seu ramo se torna tenro, e brota folhas, bem sabeis que já está próximo o verão.
text_el: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς συκῆς μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν. ὅταν ἤδη ὁ κλάδος αὐτῆς ἁπαλὸς γένηται καὶ ἐκφύῃ τὰ φύλλα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν:

text_en: So you also when you shall see these things come to pass, know that it is very near, even at the doors.
text_la: sic et vos cum videritis hæc fieri, scitote quod in proximo sit, in ostiis.
text_pt: Assim também vós, quando virdes sucederem estas coisas, sabei que já está perto, às portas.
text_el: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἐπὶ θύραις.

text_en: Amen , I say to you that this generation shall not pass until all these things be done.
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quoniam non transibit generatio hæc, donec omnia ista fiant.
text_pt: Na verdade vos digo que não passará esta geração, sem que todas estas coisas aconteçam.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη μέχρις οὗ ταῦτα πάντα γένηται.

text_en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my word shall not pass away.
text_la: Cælum et terra transibunt, verba autem mea non transibunt.
text_pt: Passará o céu e a terra, mas as minhas palavras não passarão.
text_el: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ παρελεύσονται.

text_en: But of that day or hour no man knows , neither the angels in heaven , nor the Son , but the Father .
text_la: De die autem illo vel hora nemo scit, neque angeli in cælo, neque Filius, nisi Pater.
text_pt: Mas daquele dia e hora ninguém sabe, nem os anjos que estão no céu, nem o Filho, senão o Pai.
