text_el: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ἢ τῆς ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν, οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι ἐν οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ὁ υἱός, εἰ μὴ ὁ πατήρ.

text_en: Take heed, watch and pray . For you know not when the time is.
text_la: Videte, vigilate, et orate : nescitis enim quando tempus sit.
text_pt: Olhai, vigiai e orai; porque não sabeis quando chegará o tempo.
text_el: βλέπετε ἀγρυπνεῖτε: οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ καιρός [ἐστιν].

text_en: Even as a man who, going into a far country, left his house and gave authority to his servants over every work and commanded the porter to watch.
text_la: Sicut homo qui peregre profectus reliquit domum suam, et dedit servis suis potestatem cujusque operis, et janitori præcepit ut vigilet,
text_pt: É como se um homem, partindo para fora da terra, deixasse a sua casa, e desse autoridade aos seus servos, e a cada um a sua obra, e mandasse ao porteiro que vigiasse.
text_el: ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἀπόδημος ἀφεὶς τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ δοὺς τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐξουσίαν, ἑκάστῳ τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τῷ θυρωρῷ ἐνετείλατο ἵνα γρηγορῇ.

text_en: Watch therefore (for you know not when the lord of the house comes, at even, or at midnight, or at the cock crowing, or in the morning):
text_la: vigilate ergo (nescitis enim quando dominus domus veniat : sero, an media nocte, an galli cantu, an mane),
text_pt: Vigiai, pois, porque não sabeis quando virá o senhor da casa; se à tarde, se à meia-noite, se ao cantar do galo, se pela manhã,
text_el: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν: οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ κύριος τῆς οἰκίας ἔρχεται, ἢ ὀψὲ ἢ μεσονύκτιον ἢ ἀλεκτοροφωνίας ἢ πρωΐ:

text_en: Lest coming on a sudden, he find you sleeping.
text_la: ne, cum venerit repente, inveniat vos dormientes.
text_pt: Para que, vindo de improviso, não vos ache dormindo.
text_el: μὴ ἐλθὼν ἐξαίφνης εὕρῃ ὑμᾶς καθεύδοντας.

text_en: And what I say to you, I say to all: Watch.
text_la: Quod autem vobis dico, omnibus dico : Vigilate.
text_pt: E as coisas que vos digo, digo-as a todos: Vigiai.
text_el: ὃ δὲ ὑμῖν λέγω, πᾶσιν λέγω, γρηγορεῖτε.

text_en: Now the feast of the pasch and of the Azymes was after two days: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might by some wile lay hold on him and kill him.
text_la: Erat autem Pascha et azyma post biduum : et quærebant summi sacerdotes et scribæ quomodo eum dolo tenerent, et occiderent.
text_pt: E dali a dois dias era a páscoa, e a festa dos pães ázimos; e os principais dos sacerdotes e os escribas buscavam como o prenderiam com dolo, e o matariam.
text_el: Ἦν δὲ τὸ πάσχα καὶ τὰ ἄζυμα μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας, καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς πῶς αὐτὸν ἐν δόλῳ κρατήσαντες ἀποκτείνωσιν:

text_en: But they said: Not on the festival day, lest there should be a tumult among the people.
text_la: Dicebant autem : Non in die festo, ne forte tumultus fieret in populo.
text_pt: Mas eles diziam: Não na festa, para que porventura não se faça alvoroço entre o povo.
text_el: ἔλεγον γάρ: μὴ ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, μήποτε ἔσται θόρυβος τοῦ λαοῦ.

text_en: And when he was in Bethania , in the house of Simon the leper , and was at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of precious spikenard. And breaking the alabaster box, she poured it out upon his head.
text_la: Et cum esset Bethaniæ in domo Simonis leprosi, et recumberet, venit mulier habens alabastrum unguenti nardi spicati pretiosi : et fracto alabastro, effudit super caput ejus.
text_pt: E, estando ele em betânia, assentado à mesa, em casa de Simão, o leproso, veio uma mulher, que trazia um vaso de alabastro, com ungüento de nardo puro, de muito preço, e quebrando o vaso, lho derramou sobre a cabeça.
text_el: Καὶ ὄντος αὐτοῦ ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος τοῦ λεπροῦ, κατακειμένου αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν γυνὴ ἔχουσα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτελοῦς: συντρίψασα τὴν ἀλάβαστρον κατέχεεν αὐτοῦ τῆς κεφαλῆς.

text_en: Now there were some that had indignation within themselves and said: Why was this waste of the ointment made?
text_la: Erant autem quidam indigne ferentes intra semetipsos, et dicentes : Ut quid perditio ista unguenti facta est?
text_pt: E alguns houve que em si mesmos se indignaram, e disseram: Para que se fez este desperdício de ungüento?
text_el: ἦσαν δέ τινες ἀγανακτοῦντες πρὸς ἑαυτούς: εἰς τί ἡ ἀπώλεια αὕτη τοῦ μύρου γέγονεν;

text_en: For this ointment might have been sold for more than three hundred pence and given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
text_la: poterat enim unguentum istud venundari plus quam trecentis denariis, et dari pauperibus. Et fremebant in eam.
text_pt: Porque podia vender-se por mais de trezentos dinheiros, e dá-lo aos pobres. E bramavam contra ela.
text_el: ἠδύνατο γὰρ τοῦτο τὸ μύρον πραθῆναι ἐπάνω δηναρίων τριακοσίων καὶ δοθῆναι τοῖς πτωχοῖς: καὶ ἐνεβριμῶντο αὐτῇ.

text_en: But Jesus said: Let her alone. Why do You molest her? She has wrought a good work upon me.
text_la: Jesus autem dixit : Sinite eam, quid illi molesti estis? Bonum opus operata est in me:
text_pt: Jesus, porém, disse: Deixai-a, por que a molestais? Ela fez-me boa obra.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ἄφετε αὐτήν: τί αὐτῇ κόπους παρέχετε; καλὸν ἔργον ἠργάσατο ἐν ἐμοί.

text_en: For the poor you have always with you: and whensoever you will, you may do them good : but me you have not always.
text_la: semper enim pauperes habetis vobiscum : et cum volueritis, potestis illis benefacere : me autem non semper habetis.
text_pt: Porque sempre tendes os pobres convosco, e podeis fazer-lhes bem, quando quiserdes; mas a mim nem sempre me tendes.
text_el: πάντοτε γὰρ τοὺς πτωχοὺς ἔχετε μεθ' ἑαυτῶν, καὶ ὅταν θέλητε δύνασθε αὐτοῖς [πάντοτε] εὖ ποιῆσαι, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε.

text_en: She has done what she could: she has come beforehand to anoint my body for the burial.
text_la: Quod habuit hæc, fecit : prævenit ungere corpus meum in sepulturam.
text_pt: Esta fez o que podia; antecipou-se a ungir o meu corpo para a sepultura.
text_el: ὃ ἔσχεν ἐποίησεν: προέλαβεν μυρίσαι τὸ σῶμά μου εἰς τὸν ἐνταφιασμόν.

text_en: Amen , I say to you, wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, that also which she has done shall be told for a memorial of her.
text_la: Amen dico vobis : Ubicumque prædicatum fuerit Evangelium istud in universo mundo, et quod fecit hæc, narrabitur in memoriam ejus.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que, em todas as partes do mundo onde este evangelho for pregado, também o que ela fez será contado para sua memória.
text_el: ἀμὴν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅπου ἐὰν κηρυχθῇ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον εἰς ὅλον τὸν κόσμον, καὶ ὃ ἐποίησεν αὕτη λαληθήσεται εἰς μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς.

text_en: And Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve, went to the chief priests , to betray him to them.
text_la: Et Judas Iscariotes, unus de duodecim, abiit ad summos sacerdotes, ut proderet eum illis.
text_pt: E Judas Iscariotes, um dos doze, foi ter com os principais dos sacerdotes para lho entregar.
text_el: Καὶ Ἰούδας Ἰσκαριὼθ, ὁ εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς ἵνα αὐτὸν παραδοῖ αὐτοῖς.

text_en: Who hearing it were glad: and they promised him they would give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
text_la: Qui audientes gavisi sunt : et promiserunt ei pecuniam se daturos. Et quærebat quomodo illum opportune traderet.
text_pt: E eles, ouvindo-o, folgaram, e prometeram dar-lhe dinheiro; e buscava como o entregaria em ocasião oportuna.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ἐχάρησαν καὶ ἐπηγγείλαντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι: καὶ ἐζήτει πῶς αὐτὸν εὐκαίρως παραδοῖ.

text_en: Now on the first day of the unleavened bread , when they sacrificed the pasch , the disciples say to him: Whither will you that we go and prepare for you to eat the pasch ?
text_la: Et primo die azymorum quando Pascha immolabant, dicunt ei discipuli : Quo vis eamus, et paremus tibi ut manduces Pascha?
text_pt: E, no primeiro dia dos pães ázimos, quando sacrificavam a páscoa, disseram-lhe os discípulos: Aonde queres que vamos fazer os preparativos para comer a páscoa?
text_el: Καὶ τῇ πρώτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν ἀζύμων, ὅτε τὸ πάσχα ἔθυον, λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ: ποῦ θέλεις ἀπελθόντες ἑτοιμάσωμεν ἵνα φάγῃς τὸ πάσχα;

text_en: And he sends two of his disciples and says to them: Go into the city; and there shall meet you a man carrying a pitcher of water. Follow him.
text_la: Et mittit duos ex discipulis suis, et dicit eis : Ite in civitatem, et occurret vobis homo lagenam aquæ bajulans : sequimini eum,
text_pt: E enviou dois dos seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Ide à cidade, e um homem, que leva um cântaro de água, vos encontrará; segui-o.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστέλλει δύο τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ ἀπαντήσει ὑμῖν ἄνθρωπος κεράμιον ὕδατος βαστάζων: ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ,

text_en: And wherever he shall go in, say to the master of the house, The master says, Where is my refectory, where I may eat the pasch with my disciples ?
text_la: et quocumque introierit, dicite domino domus, quia magister dicit : Ubi est refectio mea, ubi Pascha cum discipulis meis manducem?
text_pt: E, onde quer que entrar, dizei ao senhor da casa: O Mestre diz: Onde está o aposento em que hei de comer a páscoa com os meus discípulos?
text_el: καὶ ὅπου ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃ εἴπατε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ ὅτι ὁ διδάσκαλος λέγει: ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμά μου, ὅπου τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου φάγω;

text_en: And he will show you a large dining room furnished. And there prepare for us.
text_la: Et ipse vobis demonstrabit cœnaculum grande, stratum : et illic parate nobis.
text_pt: E ele vos mostrará um grande cenáculo mobilado e preparado; preparai-a ali.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον ἕτοιμον, καὶ ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν.

text_en: And his disciples went their way and came into the city. And they found as he had told them: and they prepared the pasch .
text_la: Et abierunt discipuli ejus, et venerunt in civitatem : et invenerunt sicut dixerat illis, et paraverunt Pascha.
text_pt: E, saindo os seus discípulos, foram à cidade, e acharam como lhes tinha dito, e prepararam a páscoa.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ εὗρον καθὼς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.

text_en: And when evening had come, he comes with the twelve.
text_la: Vespere autem facto, venit cum duodecim.
text_pt: E, chegada a tarde, foi com os doze.
text_el: Καὶ ὀψίας γενομένης ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα.

text_en: And when they were at table and eating, Jesus says: Amen I say to you, one of you that eats with me shall betray me.
text_la: Et discumbentibus eis, et manducantibus, ait Jesus : Amen dico vobis, quia unus ex vobis tradet me, qui manducat mecum.
text_pt: E, quando estavam assentados a comer, disse Jesus: Em verdade vos digo que um de vós, que comigo come, há de trair-me.
text_el: καὶ ἀνακειμένων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσθιόντων ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με, ὁ ἐσθίων μετ' ἐμοῦ.

text_en: But they began to be sorrowful and to say to him, one by one: Is it I?
text_la: At illi cœperunt contristari, et dicere ei singulatim : Numquid ego?
text_pt: E eles começaram a entristecer-se e a dizer-lhe um após outro: Sou eu? E outro disse: Sou eu?
text_el: ἤρξαντο λυπεῖσθαι καὶ λέγειν αὐτῷ εἷς κατὰ εἷς: μήτι ἐγώ;

text_en: Who says to them: One of the twelve, who dips with me his hand in the dish.
text_la: Qui ait illis : Unus ex duodecim, qui intingit mecum manum in catino.
text_pt: Mas ele, respondendo, disse-lhes: É um dos doze, que põe comigo a mão no prato.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, ὁ ἐμβαπτόμενος μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰς τὸ [ἓν] τρύβλιον.

text_en: And the Son of man indeed goes, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man shall be betrayed. It were better for him, if that man had not been born.
text_la: Et Filius quidem hominis vadit sicut scriptum est de eo : væ autem homini illi per quem Filius hominis tradetur! bonum erat ei, si non esset natus homo ille.
text_pt: Na verdade o Filho do homem vai, como dele está escrito, mas ai daquele homem por quem o Filho do homem é traído! Bom seria para o tal homem não haver nascido.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ μὲν υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑπάγει, καθὼς γέγραπται περὶ αὐτοῦ: οὐαὶ δὲ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι' οὗ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται: καλὸν αὐτῷ εἰ οὐκ ἐγεννήθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος.

text_en: And whilst they were eating, Jesus took bread; and blessing , broke and gave to them and said: Take. This is my body.
text_la: Et manducantibus illis, accepit Jesus panem : et benedicens fregit, et dedit eis, et ait : Sumite, hoc est corpus meum.
text_pt: E, comendo eles, tomou Jesus pão e, abençoando-o, o partiu e deu-lho, e disse: Tomai, comei, isto é o meu corpo.
text_el: Καὶ ἐσθιόντων αὐτῶν λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐλογήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπεν: λάβετε: τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου.

text_en: And having taken the chalice, giving thanks, he gave it to them. And they all drank of it.
text_la: Et accepto calice, gratias agens dedit eis : et biberunt ex illo omnes.
text_pt: E, tomando o cálice, e dando graças, deu-lho; e todos beberam dele.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἔπιον ἐξ αὐτοῦ πάντες.

text_en: And he said to them: This is my blood of the new testament, which shall be shed for many.
text_la: Et ait illis : Hic est sanguis meus novi testamenti, qui pro multis effundetur.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Isto é o meu sangue, o sangue do novo testamento, que por muitos é derramado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ αἷμά μου τῆς διαθήκης τὸ ἐκχυννόμενον ὑπὲρ πολλῶν.

text_en: Amen I say to you that I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine until that day when I shall drink it new in the kingdom of God .
text_la: Amen dico vobis, quia jam non bibam de hoc genimine vitis usque in diem illum, cum illud bibam novum in regno Dei.
text_pt: Em verdade vos digo que não beberei mais do fruto da vide, até àquele dia em que o beber, novo, no reino de Deus.
text_el: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ πίω ἐκ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ὅταν αὐτὸ πίνω καινὸν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went forth to the mount of Olives .
text_la: Et hymno dicto exierunt in montem Olivarum.
text_pt: E, tendo cantado o hino, saíram para o Monte das Oliveiras.
text_el: Καὶ ὑμνήσαντες ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν.

text_en: And Jesus says to them: You will all be scandalized in my regard this night. For it is written: I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep shall be dispersed.
text_la: Et ait eis Jesus : Omnes scandalizabimini in me in nocte ista : quia scriptum est : Percutiam pastorem, et dispergentur oves.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Jesus: Todos vós esta noite vos escandalizareis em mim; porque está escrito: Ferirei o pastor, e as ovelhas se dispersarão.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι πάντες σκανδαλισθήσεσθε, ὅτι γέγραπται: πατάξω τὸν ποιμένα, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα διασκορπισθήσονται.

text_en: But after I shall be risen again , I will go before you into Galilee .
text_la: Sed postquam resurrexero, præcedam vos in Galilæam.
text_pt: Mas, depois que eu houver ressuscitado, irei adiante de vós para a Galiléia.
text_el: ἀλλὰ μετὰ τὸ ἐγερθῆναί με προάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

text_en: But Peter said to him: Although all shall be scandalized in you, yet not I.
text_la: Petrus autem ait illi : Et si omnes scandalizati fuerint in te, sed non ego.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Pedro: Ainda que todos se escandalizem, nunca, porém, eu.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἔφη αὐτῷ: εἰ καὶ πάντες σκανδαλισθήσονται, ἀλλ' οὐκ ἐγώ.

text_en: And Jesus said to him: Amen I say to you, today, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, you shall deny me thrice.
text_la: Et ait illi Jesus : Amen dico tibi, quia tu hodie in nocte hac, priusquam gallus vocem bis dederit, ter me es negaturus.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Jesus: Em verdade te digo que hoje, nesta noite, antes que o galo cante duas vezes, três vezes me negarás.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι σὺ σήμερον ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ πρὶν ἢ δὶς ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ.

text_en: But he spoke the more vehemently: Although I should die together with you, I will not deny you. And in like manner also said they all.
text_la: At ille amplius loquebatur : Et si oportuerit me simul commori tibi, non te negabo. Similiter autem et omnes dicebant.
text_pt: Mas ele disse com mais veemência: Ainda que me seja necessário morrer contigo, de modo nenhum te negarei. E da mesma maneira diziam todos também.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐκπερισσῶς ἐλάλει: ἐὰν δέῃ με συναποθανεῖν σοι, οὐ μή σε ἀπαρνήσομαι. ὡσαύτως [δὲ] καὶ πάντες ἔλεγον.

text_en: And they came to a farm called Gethsemani . And he says to his disciples : Sit you here, while I pray .
text_la: Et veniunt in prædium, cui nomen Gethsemani. Et ait discipulis suis : Sedete hic donec orem.
text_pt: E foram a um lugar chamado Getsêmani, e disse aos seus discípulos: Assentai-vos aqui, enquanto eu oro.
text_el: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς χωρίον οὗ τὸ ὄνομα Γεθσημανί, καὶ λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ: καθίσατε ὧδε ἕως προσεύξωμαι.

text_en: And he takes Peter and James and John with him: and he began to fear and to be heavy.
text_la: Et assumit Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem secum : et cœpit pavere et tædere.
text_pt: E tomou consigo a Pedro, e a Tiago, e a João, e começou a ter pavor, e a angustiar-se.
text_el: καὶ παραλαμβάνει τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην μετ' αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤρξατο ἐκθαμβεῖσθαι καὶ ἀδημονεῖν,

text_en: And he says to them: My soul is sorrowful even unto death. Stay you here and watch.
text_la: Et ait illis : Tristis est anima mea usque ad mortem : sustinete hic, et vigilate.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: A minha alma está profundamente triste até a morte; ficai aqui, e vigiai.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: περίλυπός ἐστιν ἡ ψυχή μου ἕως θανάτου: μείνατε ὧδε καὶ γρηγορεῖτε.

text_en: And when he had gone forward a little, he fell flat on the ground: and he prayed that, if it might be, the hour might pass from him.
text_la: Et cum processisset paululum, procidit super terram, et orabat ut, si fieri posset, transiret ab eo hora.
text_pt: E, tendo ido um pouco mais adiante, prostrou-se em terra; e orou para que, se fosse possível, passasse dele aquela hora.
text_el: καὶ προελθὼν μικρὸν ἔπιπτεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ προσηύχετο ἵνα εἰ δυνατόν ἐστιν παρέλθῃ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα,

text_en: And he says: Abba, Father , all things are possible to you: remove this chalice from me; but not what I will, but what you will.
text_la: Et dixit : Abba pater, omnia tibi possibilia sunt : transfer calicem hunc a me : sed non quod ego volo, sed quod tu.
text_pt: E disse: Aba, Pai, todas as coisas te são possíveis; afasta de mim este cálice; não seja, porém, o que eu quero, mas o que tu queres.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν: Αββα ὁ πατήρ, πάντα δυνατά σοι: παρένεγκε τὸ ποτήριον τοῦτο ἀπ' ἐμοῦ: ἀλλ' οὐ τί ἐγὼ θέλω ἀλλὰ τί σύ.

text_en: And he comes and finds them sleeping. And he says to Peter : Simon , are you sleeping? Could you not watch one hour?
text_la: Et venit, et invenit eos dormientes. Et ait Petro : Simon, dormis? non potuisti una hora vigilare?
text_pt: E, chegando, achou-os dormindo; e disse a Pedro: Simão, dormes? não podes vigiar uma hora?
text_el: καὶ ἔρχεται καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, καὶ λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ: Σίμων, καθεύδεις; οὐκ ἴσχυσας μίαν ὥραν γρηγορῆσαι;

text_en: Watch and pray that you enter not into temptation . The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
text_la: vigilate et orate, ut non intretis in tentationem. Spiritus quidem promptus est, caro vero infirma.
text_pt: Vigiai e orai, para que não entreis em tentação; o espírito, na verdade, está pronto, mas a carne é fraca.
text_el: γρηγορεῖτε καὶ προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ ἔλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν. τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον, ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής.

text_en: And going away again, he prayed , saying the same words.
text_la: Et iterum abiens oravit, eumdem sermonem dicens.
text_pt: E foi outra vez e orou, dizendo as mesmas palavras.
text_el: καὶ πάλιν ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο [τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον εἰπών].

text_en: And when he returned, he found them again asleep (for their eyes were heavy): and they knew not what to answer him.
text_la: Et reversus, denuo invenit eos dormientes (erant enim oculi eorum gravati), et ignorabant quid responderent ei.
text_pt: E, voltando, achou-os outra vez dormindo, porque os seus olhos estavam pesados, e não sabiam o que responder-lhe.
text_el: καὶ πάλιν ἐλθὼν εὗρεν αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας: ἦσαν γὰρ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ καταβαρυνόμενοι, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδεισαν τί ἀποκριθῶσιν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And he comes the third time and says to them: Sleep now and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come: behold the Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text_la: Et venit tertio, et ait illis : Dormite jam, et requiescite. Sufficit : venit hora : ecce Filius hominis tradetur in manus peccatorum.
text_pt: E voltou terceira vez, e disse-lhes: Dormi agora, e descansai. Basta; é chegada a hora.  Eis que o Filho do homem vai ser entregue nas mãos dos pecadores.
text_el: καὶ ἔρχεται τὸ τρίτον καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: καθεύδετε [τὸ] λοιπὸν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθε: ἀπέχει: ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα, ἰδοὺ παραδίδοται ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰς τὰς χεῖρας τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν.

text_en: Rise up: let us go. Behold, he that will betray me is at hand.
text_la: Surgite, eamus : ecce qui me tradet, prope est.
text_pt: Levantai-vos, vamos; eis que está perto o que me trai.
text_el: ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν: ἰδοὺ ὁ παραδιδούς με ἤγγικεν.

text_en: And while he was yet speaking, comes Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve: and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the ancients.
text_la: Et, adhuc eo loquente, venit Judas Iscariotes unus de duodecim, et cum eo turba multa cum gladiis et lignis, a summis sacerdotibus, et scribis, et senioribus.
text_pt: E logo, falando ele ainda, veio Judas, que era um dos doze, da parte dos principais dos sacerdotes, e dos escribas e dos anciãos, e com ele uma grande multidão com espadas e varapaus.
text_el: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος παραγίνεται [ὁ] Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ὄχλος μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων παρὰ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων.

text_en: And he that betrayed him had given them a sign, saying: Whomsoever I shall kiss , that is he. Lay hold on him: and lead him away carefully.
text_la: Dederat autem traditor ejus signum eis, dicens : Quemcumque osculatus fuero, ipse est, tenete eum, et ducite caute.
text_pt: Ora, o que o traía, tinha-lhes dado um sinal, dizendo: Aquele que eu beijar, esse é; prendei-o, e levai-o com segurança.
text_el: δεδώκει δὲ ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν σύσσημον αὐτοῖς λέγων: ὃν ἂν φιλήσω, αὐτός ἐστιν: κρατήσατε αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπάγετε ἀσφαλῶς.

text_en: And when he had come, immediately going up to him he says: Hail, Rabbi! And he kissed him.
text_la: Et cum venisset, statim accedens ad eum, ait : Ave Rabbi : et osculatus est eum.
text_pt: E, logo que chegou, aproximou-se dele, e disse-lhe: Rabi, Rabi. E beijou-o.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐθὺς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ λέγει: ῥαββί, καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν:

text_en: But they laid hands on him and held him.
text_la: At illi manus injecerunt in eum, et tenuerunt eum.
text_pt: E lançaram-lhe as mãos, e o prenderam.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῷ καὶ ἐκράτησαν αὐτόν.

text_en: And one of them that stood by, drawing a sword, struck a servant of the chief priest and cut off his ear.
text_la: Unus autem quidam de circumstantibus educens gladium, percussit servum summi sacerdotis, et amputavit illi auriculam.
text_pt: E um dos que ali estavam presentes, puxando da espada, feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, e cortou-lhe uma orelha.
text_el: εἷς δέ τις τῶν παρεστηκότων σπασάμενος τὴν μάχαιραν ἔπαισεν τὸν δοῦλον τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ ἀφεῖλεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτάριον.

text_en: And Jesus answering, said to them: Are you come out as to a robber, with swords and staves to apprehend me?
text_la: Et respondens Jesus, ait illis : Tamquam ad latronem existis cum gladiis et lignis comprehendere me?
text_pt: E, respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Saístes com espadas e varapaus a prender-me, como a um salteador?
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων συλλαβεῖν με:

text_en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching: and you did not lay hands on me. But that the scriptures may be fulfilled.
text_la: quotidie eram apud vos in templo docens, et non me tenuistis. Sed ut impleantur Scripturæ.
text_pt: Todos os dias estava convosco ensinando no templo, e não me prendestes; mas isto é para que as Escrituras se cumpram.
text_el: καθ' ἡμέραν ἤμην πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων, καὶ οὐκ ἐκρατήσατέ με: ἀλλ' ἵνα πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαί.

text_en: Then his disciples , leaving him, all fled away.
text_la: Tunc discipuli ejus relinquentes eum, omnes fugerunt.
text_pt: Então, deixando-o, todos fugiram.
text_el: καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἔφυγον πάντες.

text_en: And a certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body. And they laid hold on him.
text_la: Adolescens autem quidam sequebatur eum amictus sindone super nudo: et tenuerunt eum.
text_pt: E um certo jovem o seguia, envolto em um lençol sobre o corpo nu. E lançaram-lhe a mão.
text_el: Καὶ νεανίσκος τις συνηκολούθει αὐτῷ περιβεβλημένος σινδόνα ἐπὶ γυμνοῦ, καὶ κρατοῦσιν αὐτόν:

text_en: But he, casting off the linen cloth, fled from them naked.
text_la: At ille rejecta sindone, nudus profugit ab eis.
text_pt: Mas ele, largando o lençol, fugiu nu. Jesus perante o Sinédrio. Negação de Pedro
text_el: ὁ δὲ καταλιπὼν τὴν σινδόνα γυμνὸς ἔφυγεν.

text_en: And they brought Jesus to the high priest . And all the priests and the scribes and the ancients assembled together.
text_la: Et adduxerunt Jesum ad summum sacerdotem : et convenerunt omnes sacerdotes, et scribæ, et seniores.
text_pt: E levaram Jesus ao sumo sacerdote, e ajuntaram-se todos os principais dos sacerdotes, e os anciãos e os escribas.
text_el: Καὶ ἀπήγαγον τὸν Ἰησοῦν πρὸς τὸν ἀρχιερέα, καὶ συνέρχονται πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς.

text_en: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the court of the high priest . And he sat with the servants at the fire and warmed himself.
text_la: Petrus autem a longe secutus est eum usque intro in atrium summi sacerdotis : et sedebat cum ministris ad ignem, et calefaciebat se.
text_pt: E Pedro o seguiu de longe até dentro do pátio do sumo sacerdote, e estava assentado com os servidores, aquentando-se ao lume.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Πέτρος ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ ἕως ἔσω εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, καὶ ἦν συγκαθήμενος μετὰ τῶν ὑπηρετῶν καὶ θερμαινόμενος πρὸς τὸ φῶς.

text_en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for evidence against Jesus , that they might put him to death: and found none.
text_la: Summi vero sacerdotes et omne concilium quærebant adversus Jesum testimonium ut eum morti traderent: nec inveniebant.
text_pt: E os principais dos sacerdotes e todo o concílio buscavam algum testemunho contra Jesus, para o matar, e não o achavam.
text_el: Οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ ὅλον τὸ συνέδριον ἐζήτουν κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ μαρτυρίαν εἰς τὸ θανατῶσαι αὐτόν, καὶ οὐχ ηὕρισκον:

text_en: For many bore false witness against him: and their evidences were not agreeing.
text_la: Multi enim testimonium falsum dicebant adversus eum : et convenientia testimonia non erant.
text_pt: Porque muitos testificavam falsamente contra ele, mas os testemunhos não eram coerentes.
text_el: πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐψευδομαρτύρουν κατ' αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἴσαι αἱ μαρτυρίαι οὐκ ἦσαν.

text_en: And some rising up, bore false witness against him, saying:
text_la: Et quidam surgentes, falsum testimonium ferebant adversus eum, dicentes:
text_pt: E, levantando-se alguns, testificaram falsamente contra ele, dizendo:
text_el: καί τινες ἀναστάντες ἐψευδομαρτύρουν κατ' αὐτοῦ λέγοντες

text_en: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple made with hands and within three days I will build another not made with hands.
text_la: Quoniam nos audivimus eum dicentem : Ego dissolvam templum hoc manu factum, et per triduum aliud non manu factum ædificabo.
text_pt: Nós ouvimos-lhe dizer: Eu derrubarei este templo, construído por mãos de homens, e em três dias edificarei outro, não feito por mãos de homens.
text_el: ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ὅτι ἐγὼ καταλύσω τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον τὸν χειροποίητον καὶ διὰ τριῶν ἡμερῶν ἄλλον ἀχειροποίητον οἰκοδομήσω.

text_en: And their witness did not agree.
text_la: Et non erat conveniens testimonium illorum.
text_pt: E nem assim o seu testemunho era coerente.
text_el: καὶ οὐδὲ οὕτως ἴση ἦν ἡ μαρτυρία αὐτῶν.

text_en: And the high priest rising up in the midst, asked Jesus , saying: Do you answer nothing to the things that are laid to your charge by these men ?
text_la: Et exsurgens summus sacerdos in medium, interrogavit Jesum, dicens : Non respondes quidquam ad ea quæ tibi objiciuntur ab his?
text_pt: E, levantando-se o sumo sacerdote no Sinédrio, perguntou a Jesus, dizendo: Nada respondes? Que testificam estes contra ti?
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς μέσον ἐπηρώτησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν λέγων: οὐκ ἀποκρίνῃ οὐδέν τί οὗτοί σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν;

text_en: But he held his peace and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him and said to him: Are you the Christ , the Son of the Blessed God ?
text_la: Ille autem tacebat, et nihil respondit. Rursum summus sacerdos interrogabat eum, et dixit ei : Tu es Christus Filius Dei benedicti?
text_pt: Mas ele calou-se, e nada respondeu. O sumo sacerdote lhe tornou a perguntar, e disse-lhe: És tu o Cristo, Filho do Deus Bendito?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἐσιώπα καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίνατο οὐδέν. πάλιν ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ, σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ εὐλογητοῦ;

text_en: And Jesus said to him: I am. And you shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of the power of God and coming with the clouds of heaven .
text_la: Jesus autem dixit illi : Ego sum : et videbitis Filium hominis sedentem a dextris virtutis Dei, et venientem cum nubibus cæli.
text_pt: E Jesus disse-lhe: Eu o sou, e vereis o Filho do homem assentado à direita do poder de Deus, e vindo sobre as nuvens do céu.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ ὄψεσθε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ δεξιῶν καθήμενον τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ ἐρχόμενον μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

text_en: Then the high priest rending his garments, says: What need we any further witnesses ?
text_la: Summus autem sacerdos scindens vestimenta sua, ait : Quid adhuc desideramus testes?
text_pt: E o sumo sacerdote, rasgando as suas vestes, disse: Para que necessitamos de mais testemunhas?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀρχιερεὺς διαρρήξας τοὺς χιτῶνας αὐτοῦ λέγει: τί ἔτι χρείαν ἔχομεν μαρτύρων;

text_en: You have heard the blasphemy . What think you? Who all condemned him to be guilty of death.
text_la: Audistis blasphemiam : quid vobis videtur? Qui omnes condemnaverunt eum esse reum mortis.
text_pt: Vós ouvistes a blasfêmia; que vos parece? E todos o consideraram culpado de morte.
text_el: ἠκούσατε τῆς βλασφημίας: τί ὑμῖν φαίνεται; οἱ δὲ πάντες κατέκριναν αὐτὸν ἔνοχον εἶναι θανάτου.

text_en: And some began to spit on him and to cover his face and to buffet him and to say unto him: Prophesy . And the servants struck him with the palms their hands.
text_la: Et cœperunt quidam conspuere eum, et velare faciem ejus, et colaphis eum cædere, et dicere ei : Prophetiza : et ministri alapis eum cædebant.
text_pt: E alguns começaram a cuspir nele, e a cobrir-lhe o rosto, e a dar-lhe punhadas, e a dizer-lhe: Profetiza. E os servidores davam-lhe bofetadas.
text_el: Καὶ ἤρξαντό τινες ἐμπτύειν αὐτῷ καὶ περικαλύπτειν αὐτοῦ τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ κολαφίζειν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγειν αὐτῷ: προφήτευσον, καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ῥαπίσμασιν αὐτὸν ἔλαβον.

text_en: Now when Peter was in the court below, there comes one of the maidservants of the high priest .
text_la: Et cum esset Petrus in atrio deorsum, venit una ex ancillis summi sacerdotis:
text_pt: E, estando Pedro embaixo, noátrio, chegou uma das criadas do sumo sacerdote;
text_el: Καὶ ὄντος τοῦ Πέτρου κάτω ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ ἔρχεται μία τῶν παιδισκῶν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως,

text_en: And when she had seen Peter warming himself looking on him, she says: You also were with Jesus of Nazareth .
text_la: et cum vidisset Petrum calefacientem se, aspiciens illum, ait : Et tu cum Jesu Nazareno eras.
text_pt: E, vendo a Pedro, que se estava aquentando, olhou para ele, e disse: Tu também estavas com Jesus, o Nazareno.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοῦσα τὸν Πέτρον θερμαινόμενον ἐμβλέψασα αὐτῷ λέγει: καὶ σὺ μετὰ τοῦ Ναζαρηνοῦ ἦσθα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: But he denied, saying: I neither know nor understand what you say. And he went forth before the court ; and the cock crew.
text_la: At ille negavit, dicens : Neque scio, neque novi quid dicas. Et exiit foras ante atrium, et gallus cantavit.
text_pt: Mas ele negou-o, dizendo: Não o conheço, nem sei o que dizes. E saiu fora ao alpendre, e o galo cantou.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο λέγων: οὔτε οἶδα οὔτε ἐπίσταμαι σὺ τί λέγεις. καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω εἰς τὸ προαύλιον.

text_en: And again a maidservant seeing him, began to say to the standers by: This is one of them.
text_la: Rursus autem cum vidisset illum ancilla, cœpit dicere circumstantibus : Quia hic ex illis est.
text_pt: E a criada, vendo-o outra vez, começou a dizer aos que ali estavam: Este é um dos tais.
text_el: Καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη ἰδοῦσα αὐτὸν ἤρξατο πάλιν λέγειν τοῖς παρεστῶσιν ὅτι οὗτος ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐστιν.

text_en: But he denied again. And after a while they that stood by said again to Peter : Surely you are one of them; for you are also a Galilean .
text_la: At ille iterum negavit. Et post pusillum rursus qui astabant, dicebant Petro : Vere ex illis es : nam et Galilæus es.
text_pt: Mas ele o negou outra vez. E pouco depois os que ali estavam disseram outra vez a Pedro: Verdadeiramente tu és um deles, porque és também galileu, e tua fala é semelhante.
text_el: ὁ δὲ πάλιν ἠρνεῖτο. καὶ μετὰ μικρὸν πάλιν οἱ παρεστῶτες ἔλεγον τῷ Πέτρῳ: ἀληθῶς ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ: καὶ γὰρ Γαλιλαῖος εἶ.

text_en: But he began o curse and to swear , saying: I know not this man of whom you speak.
text_la: Ille autem cœpit anathematizare et jurare : Quia nescio hominem istum, quem dicitis.
text_pt: E ele começou a praguejar, e a jurar: Não conheço esse homem de quem falais.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἤρξατο ἀναθεματίζειν καὶ ὀμνύναι ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦτον ὃν λέγετε.

text_en: And immediately the cock crew again. And Peter remembered the word that Jesus had said unto him: Before the cock crow twice, you shall thrice deny me. And he began to weep,
text_la: Et statim gallus iterum cantavit. Et recordatus est Petrus verbi quod dixerat ei Jesus : Priusquam gallus cantet bis, ter me negabis. Et cœpit flere.
text_pt: E o galo cantou segunda vez. E Pedro lembrou-se da palavra que Jesus lhe tinha dito: Antes que o galo cante duas vezes, três vezes me negarás.  E, retirando-se dali, chorou.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ δευτέρου ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν. καὶ ἀνεμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τὸ ῥῆμα ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι πρὶν ἀλέκτορα δὶς φωνῆσαι τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ. καὶ ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν.

text_en: and straightway in the morning, the chief priests holding a consultation with the ancients and the scribes and the whole council, binding Jesus , led him away and delivered him to Pilate .
text_la: Et confestim mane consilium facientes summi sacerdotes cum senioribus, et scribis, et universo concilio, vincientes Jesum, duxerunt, et tradiderunt Pilato.
text_pt: E, logo ao amanhecer, os principais dos sacerdotes, com os anciãos, e os escribas, e todo o Sinédrio, tiveram conselho; e, ligando Jesus, o levaram e entregaram a Pilatos.

text_en: And Pilate asked him: Are you the king of the Jews ? But he answering, said to him: You say it.
text_la: Et interrogavit eum Pilatus : Tu es rex Judæorum? At ille respondens, ait illi : Tu dicis.
text_pt: E Pilatos lhe perguntou: Tu és o Rei dos Judeus? E ele, respondendo, disse-lhe: Tu o dizes.

text_en: And the chief priests accused him in many things.
text_la: Et accusabant eum summi sacerdotes in multis.
text_pt: E os principais dos sacerdotes o acusavam de muitas coisas; porém ele nada respondia.

text_en: And Pilate again asked him, saying: Do you answer nothing? Behold in how many things they accuse you.
text_la: Pilatus autem rursum interrogavit eum, dicens : Non respondes quidquam? vide in quantis te accusant.
text_pt: E Pilatos o interrogou outra vez, dizendo: Nada respondes? Vê quantas coisas testificam contra ti.

text_en: But Jesus still answered nothing: so that Pilate wondered.
text_la: Jesus autem amplius nihil respondit, ita ut miraretur Pilatus.
text_pt: Mas Jesus nada mais respondeu, de maneira que Pilatos se maravilhava.

text_en: Now on the festival day he was wont to release unto them one of the prisoners, whomsoever they demanded.
text_la: Per diem autem festum solebat dimittere illis unum ex vinctis, quemcumque petissent.
text_pt: Ora, no dia da festa costumava soltar-lhes um preso qualquer que eles pedissem.

text_en: And there was one called Barabbas, who was put in prison with some seditious men , who in the sedition had committed murder .
text_la: Erat autem qui dicebatur Barrabas, qui cum seditiosis erat vinctus, qui in seditione fecerat homicidium.
text_pt: E havia um chamado Barrabás, que, preso com outros amotinado- res, tinha num motim cometido uma morte.

text_en: And when the multitude had come up, they began to desire that he would do as he had ever done unto them.
text_la: Et cum ascendisset turba, cœpit rogare, sicut semper faciebat illis.
text_pt: E a multidão, dando gritos, começou a pedir que fizesse como sempre lhes tinha feito.

text_en: And Pilate answered them and said: Will you that I release to you the king of the Jews ?
text_la: Pilatus autem respondit eis, et dixit : Vultis dimittam vobis regem Judæorum?
text_pt: E Pilatos lhes respondeu, dizendo: Quereis que vos solte o Rei dos Judeus?

text_en: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him up out of envy .
text_la: Sciebat enim quod per invidiam tradidissent eum summi sacerdotes.
text_pt: Porque ele bem sabia que por inveja os principais dos sacerdotes o tinham entregado.

text_en: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas to them.
text_la: Pontifices autem concitaverunt turbam, ut magis Barabbam dimitteret eis.
text_pt: Mas os principais dos sacerdotes incitaram a multidão para que fosse solto antes Barrabás.

text_en: And Pilate again answering, says to them: What will you then that I do to the king of the Jews ?
text_la: Pilatus autem iterum respondens, ait illis : Quid ergo vultis faciam regi Judæorum?
text_pt: E Pilatos, respondendo, lhes disse outra vez: Que quereis, pois, que faça daquele a quem chamais Rei dos Judeus?

text_en: But they again cried out: Crucify him.
text_la: At illi iterum clamaverunt : Crucifige eum.
text_pt: E eles tornaram a clamar: Crucifica-o.

text_en: And Pilate says to them: Why, what evil has he done? But they cried out the more: Crucify him.
text_la: Pilatus vero dicebat illis : Quid enim mali fecit? At illi magis clamabant : Crucifige eum.
text_pt: Mas Pilatos lhes disse: Mas que mal fez? E eles cada vez clamavam mais: Crucifica-o.

text_en: And so Pilate being willing to satisfy the people, released to them Barabbas: and delivered up Jesus , when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
text_la: Pilatus autem volens populo satisfacere, dimisit illis Barabbam, et tradidit Jesum flagellis cæsum, ut crucifigeretur.
text_pt: Então Pilatos, querendo satisfazer a multidão, soltou-lhe Barrabás e, açoitado Jesus, o entregou para ser crucificado.

text_en: And the soldiers led him away into the court of the palace: and they called together the whole band.
text_la: Milites autem duxerunt eum in atrium prætorii, et convocant totam cohortem,
text_pt: E os soldados o levaram dentro à sala, que é a da audiência, e convocaram toda a coorte.
text_el: Οἱ δὲ στρατιῶται ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν ἔσω τῆς αὐλῆς, ὅ ἐστιν πραιτώριον, καὶ συγκαλοῦσιν ὅλην τὴν σπεῖραν:

text_en: And they clothed him with purple: and, platting a crown of thorns , they put it upon him.
text_la: et induunt eum purpura, et imponunt ei plectentes spineam coronam.
text_pt: E vestiram-no de púrpura, e tecendo uma coroa de espinhos, lha puseram na cabeça.
text_el: καὶ ἐνδιδύσκουσιν αὐτὸν πορφύραν καὶ περιτιθέασιν αὐτῷ πλέξαντες ἀκάνθινον στέφανον:

text_en: And they began to salute him: Hail, king of the Jews .
text_la: Et cœperunt salutare eum: Ave rex Judæorum.
text_pt: E começaram a saudá-lo, dizendo: Salve, Rei dos Judeus!
text_el: καὶ ἤρξαντο ἀσπάζεσθαι αὐτόν: χαῖρε, βασιλεῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων:

text_en: And they struck his head with a reed: and they did spit on him. And bowing their knees, they adored him.
text_la: Et percutiebant caput ejus arundine : et conspuebant eum, et ponentes genua, adorabant eum.
text_pt: E feriram-no na cabeça com uma cana, e cuspiram nele e, postos de joelhos, o adoraram.
text_el: καὶ ἔτυπτον αὐτοῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν καλάμῳ καὶ ἐνέπτυον αὐτῷ, καὶ τιθέντες τὰ γόνατα προσεκύνουν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And after they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him and put his own garments on him: and they led him out to crucify him.
text_la: Et postquam illuserunt ei, exuerunt illum purpura, et induerunt eum vestimentis suis : et educunt illum ut crucifigerent eum.
text_pt: E, havendo-o escarnecido, despiram-lhe a púrpura, e o vestiram com as suas próprias vestes; e o levaram para fora a fim de o crucificarem.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ, ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὴν πορφύραν καὶ ἐνέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ. Καὶ ἐξάγουσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα σταυρώσωσιν. αὐτόν

text_en: And they forced one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and of Rufus , to take up his cross.
text_la: Et angariaverunt prætereuntem quempiam, Simonem Cyrenæum venientem de villa, patrem Alexandri et Rufi, ut tolleret crucem ejus.
text_pt: E constrangeram um certo Simão, cireneu, pai de Alexandre e de Rufo, que por ali passava, vindo do campo, a que levasse a cruz.
text_el: καὶ ἀγγαρεύουσιν παράγοντά τινα Σίμωνα Κυρηναῖον, ἐρχόμενον ἀπ' ἀγροῦ, τὸν πατέρα Ἀλεξάνδρου καὶ Ῥούφου, ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And they bring him into the place called Golgotha , which being interpreted is, The place of Calvary .
text_la: Et perducunt illum in Golgotha locum: quod est interpretatum Calvariæ locus.
text_pt: E levaram-no ao lugar doGólgota, que se traduz por lugar da Caveira.
text_el: καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν Γολγοθᾶν τόπον, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενος κρανίου τόπος.

text_en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh. But he took it not.
text_la: Et dabant ei bibere myrrhatum vinum : et non accepit.
text_pt: E deram-lhe a beber vinho com mirra, mas ele não o tomou.
text_el: καὶ ἐδίδουν αὐτῷ ἐσμυρνισμένον οἶνον: ὃς δὲ οὐκ ἔλαβεν.

text_en: And crucifying him, they divided his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
text_la: Et crucifigentes eum, diviserunt vestimenta ejus, mittentes sortem super eis, quis quid tolleret.
text_pt: E, havendo-o crucificado, repartiram as suas vestes, lançando sobre elas sortes, para saber o que cada um levaria.
text_el: καὶ σταυροῦσιν αὐτὸν, καὶ διαμερίζονται τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, βάλλοντες κλῆρον ἐπ' αὐτὰ τίς τί ἄρῃ.

text_en: And it was the third hour : and they crucified him.
text_la: Erat autem hora tertia : et crucifixerunt eum.
text_pt: E era a hora terceira, e o crucificaram.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ὥρα τρίτη καὶ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτόν.

text_en: And the inscription of his cause was written over: THE KING OF THE JEWS.
text_la: Et erat titulus causæ ejus inscriptus : Rex Judæorum.
text_pt: E por cima dele estava escrita a sua acusação: O REI DOS JUDEUS.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ἡ ἐπιγραφὴ τῆς αἰτίας αὐτοῦ ἐπιγεγραμμένη: Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥ{*J} ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ.

text_en: And with him they crucify two thieves : the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
text_la: Et cum eo crucifigunt duos latrones : unum a dextris, et alium a sinistris ejus.
text_pt: E crucificaram com ele dois salteadores, um à sua direita, e outro à esquerda.
text_el: Καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ σταυροῦσιν δύο λῃστάς, ἕνα ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἕνα ἐξ εὐωνύμων αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the scripture was fulfilled, which says: And with the wicked he was reputed.
text_la: Et impleta est Scriptura, quæ dicit : Et cum iniquis reputatus est.
text_pt: E cumprindo-se a escritura que diz: E com os malfeitores foi contado.

text_en: And they that passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying: Vah, you who destroys the temple of God and in three days builds it up again:
text_la: Et prætereuntes blasphemabant eum, moventes capita sua, et dicentes : Vah! qui destruis templum Dei, et in tribus diebus reædificas,
text_pt: E os que passavam blasfemavam dele, meneando as suas cabeças, e dizendo: Ah! tu que derrubas o templo, e em três dias o edificas,
text_el: καὶ οἱ παραπορευόμενοι ἐβλασφήμουν αὐτὸν κινοῦντες τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν καὶ λέγοντες: οὐὰ ὁ καταλύων τὸν ναὸν καὶ οἰκοδομῶν [ἐν] τρισὶν ἡμέραις,

text_en: Save yourself, coming down from the cross .
text_la: salvum fac temetipsum descendens de cruce.
text_pt: Salva-te a ti mesmo, e desce da cruz.
text_el: σῶσον σεαυτὸν καταβὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ.

text_en: In like manner also the chief priests , mocking, said with the scribes one to another: He saved others; himself he cannot save.
text_la: Similiter et summi sacerdotes illudentes, ad alterutrum cum scribis dicebant : Alios salvos fecit; seipsum non potest salvum facere.
text_pt: E da mesma maneira também os principais dos sacerdotes, com os escribas, diziam uns para os outros, zombando: Salvou os outros, e não pode salvar-se a si mesmo.
text_el: ὁμοίως καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐμπαίζοντες πρὸς ἀλλήλους μετὰ τῶν γραμματέων ἔλεγον: ἄλλους ἔσωσεν, ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται σῶσαι:

text_en: Let Christ the king of Israel come down now from the cross , that we may see and believe . And they that were crucified with him, reviled him.
text_la: Christus rex Israël descendat nunc de cruce, ut videamus, et credamus. Et qui cum eo crucifixi erant, convitiabantur ei.
text_pt: O Cristo, o Rei de Israel, desça agora da cruz, para que o vejamos e acreditemos. Também os que com ele foram crucificados o injuriavam.
text_el: ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ καταβάτω νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ, ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ πιστεύσωμεν. καὶ οἱ συνεσταυρωμένοι σὺν αὐτῷ ὠνείδιζον αὐτόν.

text_en: And when the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole earth until the ninth hour .
text_la: Et facta hora sexta, tenebræ factæ sunt per totam terram usque in horam nonam.
text_pt: E, chegada a hora sexta, houve trevas sobre toda a terra até a hora nona.
text_el: Καὶ γενομένης ὥρας ἕκτης σκότος ἐγένετο ἐφ' ὅλην τὴν γῆν ἕως ὥρας ἐνάτης.

text_en: And at the ninth hour , Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying: Eloi , Eloi , lamma sabacthani? Which is, being interpreted: My God , My God , Why have you forsaken me?
text_la: Et hora nona exclamavit Jesus voce magna, dicens : Eloi, eloi, lamma sabacthani? quod est interpretatum : Deus meus, Deus meus, ut quid dereliquisti me?
text_pt: E, à hora nona, Jesus exclamou com grande voz, dizendo: Eloí, Eloí, lamá sabactâni? que, traduzido, é: Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste?
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἐνάτῃ ὥρᾳ ἐβόησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς φωνῇ μεγάλῃ: ελωι ελωι λαμὰ σαβαχθανι; ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον: ὁ θεός μου [ὁ θεός μου], εἰς τί ἐγκατέλιπές με;

text_en: And some of the standers by hearing, said: Behold he calls Elias .
text_la: Et quidam de circumstantibus audientes, dicebant : Ecce Eliam vocat.
text_pt: E alguns dos que ali estavam, ouvindo isto, diziam: Eis que chama por Elias.
text_el: καί τινες τῶν παρεστηκότων ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον: ἴδε Ἠλίαν φωνεῖ.

text_en: And one running and filling a sponge with vinegar and putting it upon a reed, gave him to drink, saying: Stay, let us see if Elias come to take him down.
text_la: Currens autem unus, et implens spongiam aceto, circumponensque calamo, potum dabat ei, dicens : Sinite, videamus si veniat Elias ad deponendum eum.
text_pt: E um deles correu a embeber uma esponja em vinagre e, pondo-a numa cana, deu-lho a beber, dizendo: Deixai, vejamos se virá Elias tirá-lo.
text_el: δραμὼν δέ τις γεμίσας σπόγγον ὄξους περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν, λέγων: ἄφετε ἴδωμεν εἰ ἔρχεται Ἠλίας καθελεῖν αὐτόν.

text_en: And Jesus , having cried out with a loud voice, gave up the ghost .
text_la: Jesus autem emissa voce magna expiravit.
text_pt: E Jesus, dando um grande brado, expirou.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀφεὶς φωνὴν μεγάλην ἐξέπνευσεν.

text_en: And the veil of the temple was rent in two, from the top to the bottom.
text_la: Et velum templi scissum est in duo, a summo usque deorsum.
text_pt: E o véu do templo se rasgou em dois, de alto a baixo.
text_el: καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη εἰς δύο ἀπ' ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω.

text_en: And the centurion who stood over against him, seeing that crying out in this manner he had given up the ghost said: Indeed this man was the son of God .
text_la: Videns autem centurio, qui ex adverso stabat, quia sic clamans expirasset, ait : Vere hic homo Filius Dei erat.
text_pt: E o centurião, que estava defronte dele, vendo que assim clamando expirara, disse: Verdadeiramente este homem era o Filho de Deus.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ κεντυρίων ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐξ ἐναντίας αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὕτως ἐξέπνευσεν εἶπεν: ἀληθῶς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος υἱὸς θεοῦ ἦν.

text_en: And there were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalen and Mary the mother of James the Less and of Joseph and Salome ,
text_la: Erant autem et mulieres de longe aspicientes : inter quas erat Maria Magdalene, et Maria Jacobi minoris, et Joseph mater, et Salome:
text_pt: E também ali estavam algumas mulheres, olhando de longe, entre as quais também Maria Madalena, e Maria, mãe de Tiago, o menor, e de José, e Salomé;
text_el: Ἦσαν δὲ καὶ γυναῖκες ἀπὸ μακρόθεν θεωροῦσαι, ἐν αἷς καὶ Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰακώβου τοῦ μικροῦ καὶ Ἰωσῆτος μήτηρ καὶ Σαλώμη,

text_en: who also when he was in Galilee followed him and ministered to him, and many other women that came up with him to Jerusalem .
text_la: et cum esset in Galilæa, sequebantur eum, et ministrabant ei, et aliæ multæ, quæ simul cum eo ascenderant Jerosolymam.
text_pt: As quais também o seguiam, e o serviam, quando estava na Galiléia; e muitas outras, que tinham subido com ele a Jerusalém.
text_el: αἳ ὅτε ἦν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ ἠκολούθουν αὐτῷ καὶ διηκόνουν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἄλλαι πολλαὶ αἱ συναναβᾶσαι αὐτῷ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

text_en: And when evening was now come (because it was the Parasceve , that is, the day before the sabbath ),
text_la: Et cum jam sero esset factum (quia erat parasceve, quod est ante sabbatum),
text_pt: E, chegada a tarde, porquanto era o dia da preparação, isto é, a véspera do sábado,
text_el: Καὶ ἤδη ὀψίας γενομένης, ἐπεὶ ἦν παρασκευή, ὅ ἐστιν προσάββατον,

text_en: Joseph of Arimathea , a noble counsellor, who was also himself looking for the kingdom of God , came and went in boldly to Pilate and begged the body of Jesus .
text_la: venit Joseph ab Arimathæa nobilis decurio, qui et ipse erat exspectans regnum Dei, et audacter introivit ad Pilatum, et petiit corpus Jesu.
text_pt: Chegou José de Arimatéia, senador honrado, que também esperava o reino de Deus, e ousadamente foi a Pilatos, e pediu o corpo de Jesus.
text_el: ἐλθὼν Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας εὐσχήμων βουλευτής, ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν προσδεχόμενος τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, τολμήσας εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς τὸν Πιλᾶτον καὶ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: But Pilate wondered that he should be already dead. And sending for the centurion , he asked him if he were already dead.
text_la: Pilatus autem mirabatur si jam obiisset. Et accersito centurione, interrogavit eum si jam mortuus esset.
text_pt: E Pilatos se maravilhou de que já estivesse morto. E, chamando o centurião, perguntou-lhe se já havia muito que tinha morrido.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἐθαύμασεν εἰ ἤδη τέθνηκεν, καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν κεντυρίωνα ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν εἰ ἤδη ἀπέθανεν:

text_en: And when he had understood it by the centurion , he gave the body to Joseph .
text_la: Et cum cognovisset a centurione, donavit corpus Joseph.
text_pt: E, tendo-se certificado pelo centurião, deu o corpo a José;
text_el: καὶ γνοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ κεντυρίωνος ἐδωρήσατο τὸ πτῶμα τῷ Ἰωσήφ.

text_en: And Joseph , buying fine linen and taking him down, wrapped him up in the fine linen and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewed out of a rock. And he rolled a stone to the door of the sepulchre .
text_la: Joseph autem mercatus sindonem, et deponens eum involvit sindone, et posuit eum in monumento quod erat excisum de petra, et advolvit lapidem ad ostium monumenti.
text_pt: O qual comprara um lençol fino, e, tirando-o da cruz, o envolveu nele, e o depositou num sepulcro lavrado numa rocha; e revolveu uma pedra para a porta do sepulcro.
text_el: καὶ ἀγοράσας σινδόνα, καθελὼν αὐτὸν ἐνείλησεν τῇ σινδόνι καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐν μνήματι ὃ ἦν λελατομημένον ἐκ πέτρας, καὶ προσεκύλισεν λίθον ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τοῦ μνημείου.

text_en: And Mary Magdalen and Mary the mother of Joseph, beheld where he was laid.
text_la: Maria autem Magdalene et Maria Joseph aspiciebant ubi poneretur.
text_pt: E Maria Madalena e Maria, mãe de José, observavam onde o punham.
text_el: ἡ δὲ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰωσῆτος ἐθεώρουν ποῦ τέθειται.

text_en: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalen and Mary the mother of James and Salome bought sweet spices, that coming, they might anoint Jesus .
text_la: Et cum transisset sabbatum, Maria Magdalene, et Maria Jacobi, et Salome emerunt aromata ut venientes ungerent Jesum.
text_pt: E, passado o sábado, Maria Madalena, e Maria, mãe de Tiago, e Salomé, compraram aromas para irem ungi-lo.
text_el: Καὶ διαγενομένου τοῦ σαββάτου [ἡ] Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ [τοῦ] Ἰακώβου καὶ Σαλώμη ἠγόρασαν ἀρώματα, ἵνα ἐλθοῦσαι ἀλείψωσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: And very early in the morning, the first day of the week , they come to the sepulchre , the sun being now risen.
text_la: Et valde mane una sabbatorum, veniunt ad monumentum, orto jam sole.
text_pt: E, no primeiro dia da semana, foram ao sepulcro, de manhã cedo, ao nascer do sol.
text_el: καὶ λίαν πρωῒ [τῇ] μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων ἔρχονται ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον, ἀνατείλαντος τοῦ ἡλίου.

text_en: And they said one to another: Who shall roll us back the stone from the door of the sepulchre ?
text_la: Et dicebant ad invicem : Quis revolvet nobis lapidem ab ostio monumenti?
text_pt: E diziam umas às outras: Quemnos revolverá a pedra da porta do sepulcro?
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἑαυτάς: τίς ἀποκυλίσει ἡμῖν τὸν λίθον ἐκ τῆς θύρας τοῦ μνημείου;

text_en: And looking, they saw the stone rolled back. For it was very great.
text_la: Et respicientes viderunt revolutum lapidem. Erat quippe magnus valde.
text_pt: E, olhando, viram que já a pedra estava revolvida; e era ela muito grande.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβλέψασαι θεωροῦσιν ὅτι ἀνακεκύλισται ὁ λίθος: ἦν γὰρ μέγας σφόδρα.

text_en: And entering into the sepulchre , they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed with a white robe: and they were astonished.
text_la: Et introëuntes in monumentum viderunt juvenem sedentem in dextris, coopertum stola candida, et obstupuerunt.
text_pt: E, entrando no sepulcro, viram um jovem assentado à direita, vestido de uma roupa comprida, branca; e ficaram espantadas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελθοῦσαι εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον εἶδον νεανίσκον καθήμενον ἐν τοῖς δεξιοῖς περιβεβλημένον στολὴν λευκήν, καὶ ἐξεθαμβήθησαν.

text_en: Who says to them: Be not affrighted, you seek Jesus of Nazareth , who was crucified. He is risen: he is not here. Behold the place where they laid him.
text_la: Qui dicit illis : Nolite expavescere : Jesum quæritis Nazarenum, crucifixum : surrexit, non est hic, ecce locus ubi posuerunt eum.
text_pt: Ele, porém, disse-lhes: Não vos assusteis; buscais a Jesus Nazareno, que foi crucificado; já ressuscitou, não está aqui; eis aqui o lugar onde o puseram.
text_el: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐταῖς: μὴ ἐκθαμβεῖσθε. Ἰησοῦν ζητεῖτε τὸν Ναζαρηνὸν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον: ἠγέρθη, οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε: ἴδε ὁ τόπος ὅπου ἔθηκαν αὐτόν.

text_en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter that he goes before you into Galilee . There you shall see him, as he told you.
text_la: Sed ite, dicite discipulis ejus, et Petro, quia præcedit vos in Galilæam : ibi eum videbitis, sicut dixit vobis.
text_pt: Mas ide, dizei a seus discípulos, e a Pedro, que ele vai adiante de vós para a Galiléia; ali o vereis, como ele vos disse.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ὑπάγετε εἴπατε τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ Πέτρῳ ὅτι προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν: ἐκεῖ αὐτὸν ὄψεσθε, καθὼς εἶπεν ὑμῖν.

text_en: But they going out, fled from the sepulchre : for a trembling and fear had seized them. And they said nothing to any man : for they were afraid.
text_la: At illæ exeuntes, fugerunt de monumento : invaserat enim eas tremor et pavor : et nemini quidquam dixerunt : timebant enim.
text_pt: E, saindo elas apressadamente, fugiram do sepulcro, porque estavam possuídas de temor e assombro; e nada diziam a ninguém porque temiam.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθοῦσαι ἔφυγον ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου: εἶχεν γὰρ αὐτὰς τρόμος καὶ ἔκστασις, καὶ οὐδενὶ οὐδὲν εἶπαν: ἐφοβοῦντο γάρ.

text_en: But he rising early the first day of the week , appeared first to Mary Magdalen ; out of whom he had cast seven devils .
text_la: Surgens autem mane prima sabbati, apparuit primo Mariæ Magdalene, de qua ejecerat septem dæmonia.
text_pt: E Jesus, tendo ressuscitado na manhã do primeiro dia da semana, apareceu primeiramente a Maria Madalena, da qual tinha expulsado sete demônios.
text_el: [[Ἀναστὰς δὲ πρωῒ πρώτῃ σαββάτου ἐφάνη πρῶτον Μαρίᾳ τῇ Μαγδαληνῇ, παρ'' ἧς ἐκβεβλήκει ἑπτὰ δαιμόνια. πάντα δὲ τὰ παρηγγελμένα τοῖς περὶ τὸν Πέτρον συντόμως ἐξήγγειλαν μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα καὶ αὐτὸς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς καὶ ἄχρι δύσεως ἐξαπέστειλεν δι' αὐτῶν τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἄφθαρτον κήρυγμα τῆς αἰωνίου σωτηρίας ἀμήν

text_en: She went and told them that had been with him, who were mourning and weeping.
text_la: Illa vadens nuntiavit his, qui cum eo fuerant, lugentibus et flentibus.
text_pt: E, partindo ela, anunciou-o àqueles que tinham estado com ele, os quais estavam tristes, e chorando.
text_el: ἐκείνη πορευθεῖσα ἀπήγγειλεν τοῖς μετ' αὐτοῦ γενομένοις, πενθοῦσι καὶ κλαίουσιν.

text_en: And they hearing that he was alive and had been seen by her, did not believe .
text_la: Et illi audientes quia viveret, et visus esset ab ea, non crediderunt.
text_pt: E, ouvindo eles que vivia, e que tinha sido visto por ela, não o creram.
text_el: κἀκεῖνοι ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ζῇ καὶ ἐθεάθη ὑπ' αὐτῆς ἠπίστησαν.

text_en: And after that he appeared in another shape to two of them walking, as they were going into the country.
text_la: Post hæc autem duobus ex his ambulantibus ostensus est in alia effigie, euntibus in villam:
text_pt: E depois manifestou-se de outra forma a dois deles, que iam de caminho para o campo.
text_el: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα δυσὶν ἐξ αὐτῶν περιπατοῦσιν ἐφανερώθη ἐν ἑτέρᾳ μορφῇ, πορευομένοις εἰς ἀγρόν.

text_en: And they going told it to the rest: neither did they believe them.
text_la: et illi euntes nuntiaverunt ceteris : nec illis crediderunt.
text_pt: E, indo estes, anunciaram-no aos outros, mas nem ainda estes creram.
text_el: κἀκεῖνοι ἀπελθόντες ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς λοιποῖς: οὐδὲ ἐκείνοις ἐπίστευσαν.

text_en: At length he appeared to the eleven as they were at table: and he upbraided them with their incredulity and hardness of heart, because they did not believe them who had seen him after he was risen again .
text_la: Novissime recumbentibus illis undecim apparuit : et exprobravit incredulitatem eorum et duritiam cordis : quia iis, qui viderant eum resurrexisse, non crediderunt.
text_pt: Finalmente apareceu aos onze, estando eles assentados juntamente, e lançou-lhes em rosto a sua incredulidade e dureza de coração, por não haverem crido nos que o tinham visto já ressuscitado.
text_el: Ὕστερον [δὲ] ἀνακειμένοις αὐτοῖς τοῖς ἕνδεκα ἐφανερώθη, καὶ ὠνείδισεν τὴν ἀπιστίαν αὐτῶν καὶ σκληροκαρδίαν, ὅτι τοῖς θεασαμένοις αὐτὸν ἐγηγερμένον [ἐκ νεκρῶν] οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν.

text_en: And he said to them: Go into the whole world and preach the gospel to every creature.
text_la: Et dixit eis : Euntes in mundum universum prædicate Evangelium omni creaturæ.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Ide por todo omundo, pregai o evangelho a toda criatura.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: πορευθέντες εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἅπαντα κηρύξατε τὸ εὐαγγέλιον πάσῃ τῇ κτίσει.

text_en: He that believes and is baptized shall be saved: but he that believes not shall he condemned.
text_la: Qui crediderit, et baptizatus fuerit, salvus erit : qui vero non crediderit, condemnabitur.
text_pt: Quem crer e for batizado será salvo; mas quem não crer será condenado.
text_el: ὁ πιστεύσας καὶ βαπτισθεὶς σωθήσεται, ὁ δὲ ἀπιστήσας κατακριθήσεται.

text_en: And these signs shall follow them that believe : In my name they shall cast out devils . They shall speak with new tongues .
text_la: Signa autem eos qui crediderint, hæc sequentur : in nomine meo dæmonia ejicient : linguis loquentur novis:
text_pt: E estes sinais seguirão aos que crerem: Em meu nome expulsarão os demônios; falarão novas línguas;
text_el: σημεῖα δὲ τοῖς πιστεύσασιν ἀκολουθήσει ταῦτα: ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου δαιμόνια ἐκβαλοῦσιν, γλώσσαις λαλήσουσιν,

text_en: They shall take up serpents: and if they shall drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them. They shall lay their hand upon the sick: and they shall recover.
text_la: serpentes tollent : et si mortiferum quid biberint, non eis nocebit : super ægros manus imponent, et bene habebunt.
text_pt: Pegarão nas serpentes; e, se beberem alguma coisa mortífera, não lhes fará dano algum; e porãoas mãos sobre os enfermos, e os curarão.
text_el: [καὶ ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν] ὄφεις ἀροῦσιν, κἂν θανάσιμόν τι πίωσιν οὐ μὴ αὐτοὺς βλάψῃ, ἐπὶ ἀρρώστους χεῖρας ἐπιθήσουσιν καὶ καλῶς ἕξουσιν.

text_en: And the Lord Jesus , after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven and sits on the right hand of God .
text_la: Et Dominus quidem Jesus postquam locutus est eis, assumptus est in cælum, et sedet a dextris Dei.
text_pt: Ora, o Senhor, depois de lhes ter falado, foi recebido no céu, e assentou-se à direita de Deus.
text_el: ὁ μὲν οὖν κύριος [Ἰησοῦς] μετὰ τὸ λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς ἀνελήμφθη εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But they going forth preached every where: the Lord working withal, and confirming the word with signs that followed.
text_la: Illi autem profecti prædicaverunt ubique, Domino cooperante, et sermonem confirmante, sequentibus signis.
text_pt: E eles, tendo partido, pregaram por todas as partes, cooperando com eles o Senhor, e confirmando a palavra com os sinais que se seguiram. Amém.
text_el: ἐκεῖνοι δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἐκήρυξαν πανταχοῦ, τοῦ κυρίου συνεργοῦντος καὶ τὸν λόγον βεβαιοῦντος διὰ τῶν ἐπακολουθούντων σημείων.]]
